chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 1. Ucwaningo Lokuphila | 1.0 Isingeniso
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 1. The Study of Life | 1.0 Introduction
chapterContent:
Uma ubuka usemkhathini, uMhlaba awunikezi zinkomba mayelana nokuhlukahluka kokuphila okukuwo. Izinhlobo zokuqala zokuphila eMhlabeni kucatshangwa ukuthi ziyizinto ezincane ezazikhona iminyaka eyizigidigidi olwandle ngaphambi kokuba kuvele izitshalo nezilwane. Izilwane ezincelisayo, izinyoni, nezimbali esizibonayo ezikhathini zanamuhla ziyizinhlobo zamuva nje, ezivela eminyakeni eyizigidi eziyi-130 kuya kwezingama-200 edlule. Eqinisweni, eminyakeni engu-300,000 edlule kuphela lapho abantu baqala ukubukeka njengathi namuhla.

 Izinto eziphilayo ziyavela ngokuphendulana. Esinye sezibonelo ezinhle kakhulu yizinto eziphilayo ezibangela izifo, okumele zivumelane ukuze zinqobe ukuzivikela kwezinto eziphilayo ezithelelanayo. Esinye sezilo eziphilayo esiye savela ukuze sigxile ekuthelelekeni kubantu yiPlasmodium, into ebangela umalaleveva. Izazi zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa inqubo yesayensi ukuze zifunde ngezwe kanye nezinto eziphilayo ezihlala kulo. Isibonelo, abantu bebelokhu besola isikhathi eside ukuthi abantu abanohlobo lwegazi O banamathuba amancane okufa ngenxa kamalaleveva onzima. Manje, ithimba lososayensi likwazile ukuchaza ukuthi kungani. Ngokuhlola idatha evela ezivivinyweni eziningana, nangokusebenzisa kokubili ukucabanga okubangelwayo kanye nokucatshangelwayo, ososayensi baphetha ngokuthi igazi lohlobo lwe-A kanye ne-B lisabela nephrotheni ekhishwe yiPlasmodium. Lokhu kusabela kubangela ukugula okukhulu. Kodwa-ke, igazi lohlobo lwe-O alisabelani nephrotheni
question1: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukuthi kungani izinto ezincane zibalulekile emlandweni wokuphila eMhlabeni?
answer1: Cishe zaziphakathi kwezinhlobo zokuqala zokuphila futhi zazikhona izigidigidi zeminyaka ngaphambi kokuba kuvele izitshalo nezilwane.
distractor1a: Zavela kuphela ngemva kokuba izilwane ezincelisayo nezinyoni sezivele zavela.
distractor1b: Babeyizinto eziphilayo zokuqala ezihlala emhlabeni njengezitshalo eziqhakazayo
distractor1c: Zavela ngemva kokuba abantu bethuthukise izici zomzimba zesimanje
question2: Yisiphi isibonelo esibonisa kangcono ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ziyavela ngokuphendulana?
answer2: Isidalwa esibangela izifo siyajwayela ukunqoba ukuzivikela komnikazi waso esimthelela
distractor2a: Idwala lishintsha isimo ngemva kokuchayeka emagagasini olwandle
distractor2b: Iplanethi ihambahamba izungeza ilanga ngendlela ebikezelwayo
distractor2c: Ikhemikhali iyaqina lapho izinga lokushisa lehla ngaphansi kwephuzu layo lokubanda
question3: Esibonelweni sikamalaleveva, iyiphi indima edlalwa yiPlasmodium?
answer3: Yisidalwa esibangela umalaleveva futhi esiye savela sathelela abantu
distractor3a: Luhlobo lweseli legazi lomuntu elibhubhisa umalaleveva
distractor3b: Kuyiprotheni etholakala egazini lohlobo lwe-O kuphela
question4: Kungani abantu abanegazi lohlobo O bengase bangabi namathuba amaningi okufa ngenxa yomalaleveva onzima?
answer4: Igazi lohlobo lwe-O alisabelani neprotheyini ye-Plasmodium ngendlela efanayo nezinhlobo zegazi ze-A ne-B
distractor4a: Igazi lohlobo O livimbela iPlasmodium ukuthi ingene emzimbeni womuntu ngokuphelele
distractor4b: Igazi lohlobo O libangela i-Plasmodium ukuba ibe yiseli lesitshalo elingenangozi
distractor4c: Igazi lohlobo lwe-O alinawo amaseli noma amaprotheni angasebenzisana nezinto eziphilayo
question5: Iyiphi indlela yokuphenya ekhombisa kangcono inqubo yesayensi echazwe esahlukweni?
answer5: Ososayensi bahlola idatha yokuhlola futhi basebenzisa ukucabanga ukuchaza amaphethini obunzima bomalaleveva
distractor5a: Ososayensi bayamukela incazelo ngaphandle kobufakazi ngoba izwakala inengqondo
distractor5b: Ososayensi bayakugwema ukuqhathanisa idatha evela ezivivinyweni ezahlukene
distractor5c: Ososayensi bathembele kuphela ekuqageleni futhi abahloli izincazelo ezingaba khona

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 1. Ucwaningo Lokuphila | 1.1 Isayensi Yebhayoloji | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 1. The Study of Life | 1.1 The Science of Biology | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
I-Biology yisayensi efunda ngezinto eziphilayo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo kanye nendawo ezikuyo. Inqubo yesayensi izama ukuchaza nokuqonda uhlobo lwendawo yonke ngezindlela ezinengqondo. Isayensi inemikhakha eminingi; leyo mikhakha ehlobene nomhlaba ongokoqobo, okuhlanganisa ne-biology, ibhekwa njengesayensi yemvelo. Zonke isayensi yemvelo zilandela imithetho yekhemistri kanye ne-physics. Isibonelo, lapho ufunda i-biology, kufanele ukhumbule ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zilalela imithetho ye-thermodynamics ngenkathi zisebenzisa amandla amahhala nezinto ezivela endaweni ezungezile ukuze zenze izinqubo zokuphila ezihlolwa ezahlukweni ezilandelayo, njenge-metabolism kanye nokuzala.

 Izinhlobo ezimbili zokucabanga okunengqondo zisetshenziswa kwisayensi: ukucabanga okubangelwayo kanye nokucabanga okubangelwayo. Ukucabanga okubangelwayo kusebenzisa imiphumela ethile ukukhiqiza izimiso zesayensi ezijwayelekile. Ukucabanga okubangelwayo kusebenzisa ukucabanga okunengqondo ukubikezela imiphumela ngokusebenzisa izimiso zesayensi noma imikhuba. Indlela yesayensi iyinqubo yesinyathelo ngesinyathelo equkethe: ukwenza ukuqaphela, ukuchaza inkinga, ukubeka imibono, ukuhlola le mibono ngokuklama nokwenza uphenyo, kanye nokuthola iziphetho kusuka kudatha nemiphumela. Ososayensi babe sebedlulisela imiphumela yabo emphakathini wesayensi. Imibono yesayensi ingabuyekezwa njengoba ulwazi olusha luqoqwa.

 Okuqukethwe okuvezwe kulesi sigaba kusekela izinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda zihlanganisa okuqukethwe kolwazi olubalulekile nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa. Lezi zinhloso zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, kanye nokuhlangenwe nakho okusekelwe ekuphenyweni kwelebhu, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®.

 I-Big Idea 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zigcine i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.1 Zonke izinhlelo eziphilayo zidinga ukufaka njalo amandla amahhala.

 Ukuzijwayeza Kwesayensi
6.4 Umfundi angenza izimangalo kanye nezibikezelo mayelana nezehlakalo zemvelo ngokusekelwe emibonweni yesayensi namamodeli

 Izinhloso Zokufunda
2.3 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubikezela ukuthi izinguquko ekutholakaleni kwamandla amahhala zithinta kanjani izinto eziphilayo, inani labantu kanye nezindawo zemvelo.

 Kuyini i-biology? Ngamagama alula, i-biology isifundo sokuphila. Lokhu kuyincazelo ebanzi kakhulu ngoba ububanzi be-biology bukhulu. Izazi zezinto eziphilayo zingase zitadishe noma yini kusukela embonweni omncane noma ongaphansi kwe-microscopic weseli kuya ezindaweni zemvelo kanye neplanethi yonke ephilayo (Isithombe 1.2). Uma ulalela izindaba zansuku zonke, uzobona ngokushesha ukuthi zingaki izici ze-biology ezixoxwa ngazo nsuku zonke. Isibonelo, izihloko zezindaba zakamuva zifaka phakathi ukuqubuka kwe-Escherichia coli (Isithombe 1.3) ekungcolisweni kwesipinashi kanye ne-Salmonella ebhotela lamantongomane. Emhlabeni wonke, abacwaningi abaningi bazibophezele ekutholeni izindlela zokuvikela iplanethi, ukuxazulula izinkinga zemvelo, kanye nokunciphisa imiphumela yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu. Yonke le mizamo eyahlukahlukene ihlobene nezici ezahlukene zesifundo se-biology
question1: Iyini inhloso eyinhloko ye-biology njengesifundo sesayensi?
answer1: Ucwaningo lwezinto eziphilayo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo kanye nendawo ezizungezile
question2: Kungani izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo kufanele zilalele imithetho yekhemistri kanye nefiziksi?
answer2: Ngoba zonke izinto eziphilayo ziyingxenye yendawo yonke ebonakalayo futhi zilawulwa yimithetho yemvelo
distractor2a: Ngoba izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zingadala imithetho emisha yemvelo
distractor2b: Ngoba izinto eziphilayo zikhona ngaphandle komhlaba wemvelo
distractor2c: Ngoba i-biology ithatha indawo yemithetho yekhemistri nefiziksi
question3: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukucabanga okubangelwa yi-inductive?
answer3: Ukusebenzisa okubonwe ngokuqondile ukuthuthukisa izimiso zesayensi ezibanzi
distractor3a: Ukusebenzisa umthetho wesayensi ukubikezela umphumela othize
question4: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ukucabanga okusekelwe ebufakazini?
answer4: Ukusebenzisa izimiso zesayensi ezisunguliwe ukubikezela imiphumela ethile
distractor4c: Ukunganaki ulwazi lwesayensi lwangaphambilini lapho wenza izibikezelo
question5: Yisiphi isinyathelo esivame ukwenzeka kuqala endleleni yesayensi?
question6: Kungani imibono yesayensi ibhekwa njengengabuyekezwa?
answer6: Ubufakazi obusha bungase buholele ososayensi ekushintsheni izincazelo ezikhona
distractor6a: Imibono isekelwe ngokuphelele emibonweni yomuntu siqu
distractor6c: Imibono ayibe isanembile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubufakazi buyini
question7: Ngokusho kwe-AP Biology Big Idea 2, yini edingwa izinhlelo eziphilayo ukuze zikhule futhi zizalane?
answer7: Ukufakwa okuqhubekayo kwamandla amahhala nezinto ezidingekayo
distractor7b: Ukukhanya kwelanga kuphela kungakhathaliseki uhlobo lwesidalwa
question8: Izinguquko ekutholakaleni kwamandla amahhala zingathinta kanjani imvelo?
answer8: Zingathonya ukusinda, ukukhula, kanye nokuzala kwezinto eziphilayo ngaphakathi kwesimiso sezinto eziphilayo
distractor8a: Zithinta kuphela izingxenye ezingaphili zezindawo zemvelo
distractor8c: Zithinta amaseli ngamanye kuphela hhayi izinhlelo ezinkulu
question9: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sendaba yezinto eziphilayo okuxoxwa ngayo emhlabeni wonke?
question10: Yini ehlanganisa ububanzi bezinto eziphilayo?
answer10: Amazinga asukela kuma-molecule namaseli kuya ezindaweni zemvelo kanye ne-biosphere
distractor10c: Izitshalo nezilwane kuphela ezibonakala ngamehlo enyama
question11: Ukuqubuka kokungcola kwe-Escherichia coli ekudleni kuyisibonelo saliphi icandelo lebhayoloji?
answer11: Ucwaningo lwezilokazane ezincane kanye nomthelela wazo empilweni yabantu
question12: Yini ehlukanisa isayensi yemvelo kweminye imikhakha yokufunda?
answer12: Bafuna ukuqonda umhlaba wemvelo ngobufakazi, ukubuka, nokuhlola

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 1. Ucwaningo Lokuphila | 1.1 Isayensi Yebhayoloji | Inqubo Yesayensi
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 1. The Study of Life | 1.1 The Science of Biology | The Process of Science
chapterContent:
I-biology iyisayensi, kodwa iyini ngempela isayensi? Ucwaningo lwe-biology luhlanganyelani nezinye izifundo zesayensi? Isayensi (kusukela kwelesiLatini isayensi, okusho ulwazi) ingachazwa njengolwazi oluhlanganisa amaqiniso ajwayelekile noma ukusebenza kwemithetho ejwayelekile, ikakhulukazi uma itholwa futhi ivivinywa yindlela yesayensi. Kusobala kule ncazelo ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwendlela yesayensi kudlala indima enkulu kwisayensi. Indlela yesayensi iyindlela yocwaningo enezinyathelo ezichaziwe ezifaka phakathi ukuhlolwa kanye nokubuka ngokucophelela.

 Izinyathelo zendlela yesayensi zizohlolwa ngokuningiliziwe kamuva, kodwa esinye sezici ezibaluleke kakhulu zale ndlela ukuhlolwa kwezimvo ngokusebenzisa ukuhlolwa okuphindaphindwayo. I-hypothesis iyincazelo ephakanyisiwe yesenzakalo, esingahlolwa. Nakuba ukusebenzisa indlela yesayensi kuhlobene nesayensi, akwanele ekunqumeni ukuthi iyini isayensi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi kulula kakhulu ukusebenzisa indlela yesayensi ezifundweni ezifana nefiziksi kanye nekhemistri, kodwa uma kukhulunywa ngezifundo ezifana nokuvubukula, i-psychology, kanye ne-geology, indlela yesayensi ayisebenzi kangako njengoba kuba nzima ukuphinda ukuhlolwa.

 Lezi zindawo zokufunda ziseyisayensi, nokho. Cabanga nge-archaeology—yize umuntu engakwazi ukwenza ukuhlolwa okuphindaphindwayo, izimvo zingase zibe okusekelwayo. Isibonelo, isazi semivubukulo singacabanga ukuthi kwakukhona isiko lasendulo ngokusekelwe ekutholeni ucezu lwebumba. Kungenziwa eminye imibono mayelana nezici ezahlukahlukene zalesi siko, futhi le mibono ingatholakala ilungile noma ingamanga ngokusekelwa okuqhubekayo noma ukuphikisana okuvela kwezinye izinto ezitholiwe. I-hypothesis ingaba yi-theory eqinisekisiwe. I-theory iyincazelo evivinyiwe neqinisekisiwe yokubonwa noma izenzakalo. Isayensi ingachazwa kangcono njengezinkambu zokufunda ezizama ukuqonda uhlobo lwendawo yonke
answer1: Ukuqonda amaqiniso ajwayelekile kanye nemithetho yemvelo ngobufakazi kanye nophenyo
distractor1a: Ukudala izincazelo ngokusekelwe ezinkolelweni zomuntu siqu kuphela
question2: Iyini indlela yesayensi?
answer2: Inqubo ehlelekile yophenyo ehlanganisa ukuqaphela, ukuhlolwa kwe-hypothesis, kanye nokuhlaziywa kwemiphumela
question3: Yisiphi isici esibaluleke kakhulu kumbono wesayensi?
answer3: Kumelwe kuhlolwe ngokubuka noma ngophenyo
distractor3a: Kumelwe ukuthi sekuvele kuboniswe ukuthi kuyiqiniso
question4: Iyini inkolelo-mbono?
question5: Kungani izivivinyo eziphindaphindwayo zibalulekile kwisayensi?
answer5: Zivumela imiphumela ukuthi iqinisekiswe futhi zandise ukuzethemba eziphethweni
question6: Kungani imikhakha efana nokuvubukula ingasabhekwa njengesayensi?
answer6: Basebenzisa ubufakazi futhi bahlole imibono noma ngabe ukuhlolwa okuphindaphindwayo kunzima
question7: Umvubukuli uthola ucezu lwebumba futhi usikisela isiko lasendulo elake lahlala kule ndawo. Lesi siphakamiso siyisibonelo salokhu okulandelayo:
question8: Abavubukuli bangayihlola kanjani imibono mayelana namasiko asendulo?
answer8: Ngokuqhathanisa imibono ecatshangelwayo nobufakazi obengeziwe kanye nokutholakele
question9: Iyini inkolelo-mbono yesayensi?
answer9: Incazelo evivinywe kahle futhi esekelwa kakhulu ngokubona noma izenzakalo
question10: Yisiphi isitatimende esichaza kangcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinkolelo-mbono nemibono?
answer10: Ubufakazi obuphindaphindwayo obusekela imibono bungasiza ekuthuthukisweni kwemibono yesayensi
distractor10b: Imibono kanye nemibono isho into efanayo ncamashi
question11: Yimuphi umkhakha ongabhekana nezinselele ekwenzeni izivivinyo eziphindaphindwayo?
question12: Yisiphi isitatimende esivumelana kakhulu nokucabanga kwesayensi?
answer12: Izincazelo zesayensi zingabuyekezwa uma ubufakazi obusha butholakala
distractor12c: Ososayensi bayayishaya indiva imibono engavumelani nemibono yamanje
question13: Yini ehlukanisa isayensi nenkolelo elula?
answer13: Isayensi incike ebufakazini, ekuhlolweni, nasekucabangeni okunengqondo

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 1. Ucwaningo Lokuphila | 1.1 Isayensi Yebhayoloji | Inqubo Yesayensi | Isayensi Yemvelo
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 1. The Study of Life | 1.1 The Science of Biology | The Process of Science | Natural Sciences
chapterContent:
Yini obungalindela ukuyibona emnyuziyamu wesayensi yemvelo? Amaxoxo? Izitshalo? Amathambo e-dinosaur? Imibukiso mayelana nendlela ubuchopho obusebenza ngayo? Iplanethiyamu? Amagugu namaminerali? Noma, mhlawumbe konke okungenhla? Isayensi ihlanganisa imikhakha eyahlukahlukene njengezinkanyezi, i-biology, isayensi yamakhompyutha, i-geology, i-logic, i-physics, i-chemistry, kanye nezibalo (Isithombe 1.4). Kodwa-ke, leyo mikhakha yesayensi ehlobene nomhlaba ongokoqobo kanye nezenzakalo nezinqubo zayo zibhekwa njengesayensi yemvelo. Ngakho-ke, umnyuziyamu wesayensi yemvelo ungase ube nanoma yiziphi izinto ezibalwe ngenhla.
Akukho ukuvumelana okuphelele uma kukhulunywa ngokuchaza ukuthi isayensi yemvelo ihlanganisa ini, nokho. Kwabanye ochwepheshe, isayensi yemvelo i-astronomy, i-biology, i-chemistry, isayensi yomhlaba, kanye ne-physics. Ezinye izazi zikhetha ukuhlukanisa isayensi yemvelo ibe yisayensi yokuphila, efunda izinto eziphilayo futhi efaka i-biology, kanye nesayensi yemvelo, efunda izinto ezingaphili futhi efaka i-astronomy, i-geology, i-physics, kanye ne-chemistry. Ezinye izifundo ezifana ne-biophysics kanye ne-biochemistry zakha kokubili isayensi yokuphila kanye neyomzimba futhi zixubile. Isayensi yemvelo ngezinye izikhathi ibizwa ngokuthi isayensi eqinile” ngoba ithembele ekusetshenzisweni kwedatha yokulinganisa; isayensi yezenhlalo efunda umphakathi kanye nokuziphatha kwabantu cishe izosebenzisa ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi ukuqhuba uphenyo kanye nokutholakele.

 Akumangazi ukuthi isayensi yemvelo yebhayoloji inamagatsha amaningi noma imikhakha engaphansi. Izazi zebhayoloji zamaseli zifunda isakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi weseli, kuyilapho izazi zebhayoloji ezifunda i-anatomy zihlola isakhiwo sento yonke ephilayo. Nokho, labo sosayensi bebhayoloji abafunda i-physiology bagxila ekusebenzeni kwangaphakathi kwento ephilayo. Ezinye izindawo zebhayoloji zigxila ezinhlotsheni ezithile zezinto eziphilayo kuphela. Isibonelo, izazi zezitshalo zihlola izitshalo, kuyilapho izazi zezilwane zigxile ezilwaneni

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 1. Ukutadisha Ukuphila | 1.1 Isayensi Yebhayoloji | Inqubo Yesayensi | Ukuqonda Kwesayensi
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 1. The Study of Life | 1.1 The Science of Biology | The Process of Science | Scientific Reasoning
chapterContent:
Into eyodwa ifana kuzo zonke izinhlobo zesayensi: umgomo wokugcina wokwazi. Ilukuluku kanye nophenyo yizona zinto eziqhuba intuthuko yesayensi. Ososayensi bafuna ukuqonda umhlaba nendlela osebenza ngayo. Ukuze benze lokhu, basebenzisa izindlela ezimbili zokucabanga okunengqondo: ukucabanga okuqondisayo kanye nokucabanga okuqondile.

 Ukucabanga okuqondisayo kuyindlela yokucabanga okunengqondo esebenzisa ukuqaphela okuhlobene ukuze kufinyelelwe esiphethweni esijwayelekile. Lolu hlobo lokucabanga luvame kakhulu kwisayensi echazayo. Usosayensi wezinto eziphilayo njengososayensi wezinto eziphilayo wenza ukuqaphela futhi akuqophe. Le datha ingaba ngekhwalithi noma ngenani, futhi idatha eluhlaza ingafakwa ngemidwebo, izithombe, izithombe, noma amavidiyo. Kusukela ekubonweni okuningi, usosayensi angaphetha iziphetho (ukuqonda) ngokusekelwe ebufakazini. Ukucabanga okuqondisayo kuhilela ukwakha ukujwayelekile okutholwe ngokuqaphela ngokucophelela kanye nokuhlaziywa kwedatha eningi. Izifundo zobuchopho zinikeza isibonelo. Kulolu hlobo locwaningo, ubuchopho obuningi obuphilayo buyabonwa ngenkathi abantu benza umsebenzi othize, njengokubuka izithombe zokudla. Ingxenye yobuchopho ekhanyisa `phakathi kwalo msebenzi ibikezelwa ukuthi iyingxenye elawula impendulo ekushukumiseni okukhethiwe, kulokhu, izithombe zokudla. Ukukhanya `kwezindawo ezahlukene zobuchopho kubangelwa ukumuncwa ngokweqile kwezinto eziphuma kushukela ezisebenzisa imisebe yizindawo ezisebenzayo zobuchopho. Ukwanda kwe-radioactivity okubangelwa yi-scanner kubonwa yi-scanner. Ngemuva kwalokho, abacwaningi bangavuselela leyo ngxenye yobuchopho ukuze babone ukuthi izimpendulo ezifanayo ziyaphuma yini.

 Ukucabanga okuncishisiwe noma ukuncishiswa uhlobo lwe-logic olusetshenziswa kwisayensi esekelwe ku-hypothesis. Esizathwini sokuncishiswa, iphethini yokucabanga ihamba ngakolunye uhlangothi uma kuqhathaniswa nokucabanga okuncishisiwe. Ukucabanga okuncishisiwe kuyindlela yokucabanga okunengqondo esebenzisa isimiso noma umthetho jikelele ukubikezela imiphumela ethile. Kusukela kulezo zimiso ezijwayelekile, usosayensi anganquma futhi abikezele imiphumela ethile engaba semthethweni inqobo nje uma izimiso ezijwayelekile zisebenza. Izifundo zokushintsha kwesimo sezulu zingabonisa lolu hlobo lokucabanga. Isibonelo, ososayensi bangabikezela ukuthi uma isimo sezulu siba sifudumele esifundeni esithile, khona-ke ukusatshalaliswa kwezitshalo nezilwane kufanele kushintshe. Lezi zibikezelo zenziwe futhi zahlolwa, futhi kutholakale izinguquko eziningi ezinjalo, njengokuguqulwa kwezindawo ezilimekayo zezolimo, ngoshintsho olusekelwe emazingeni okushisa.

 Zombili izinhlobo zokucabanga okunengqondo Ukucabanga kuhlobene nezindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko zocwaningo lwesayensi: isayensi echazayo kanye nesayensi esekelwe kumbono. Isayensi echazayo (noma yokuthola), evame ukuba yindlela yokufundisa, ihlose ukubuka, ukuhlola, nokuthola, kuyilapho isayensi esekelwe kumbono, evame ukuba yindlela yokucubungula, iqala ngombuzo noma inkinga ethile kanye nempendulo noma ikhambi elingahlolwa. Umngcele phakathi kwalezi zinhlobo ezimbili zocwaningo uvame ukufiphala, futhi imizamo eminingi yesayensi ihlanganisa zombili izindlela. Umngcele ofiphele uba sobala lapho ucabanga ngokuthi ukubuka kungaholela kalula kangakanani emibuzweni ethile. Isibonelo, indoda ethile ngawo-1940 yaphawula ukuthi imbewu ye-burr eyayinamathele ezingutsheni zayo nasebusweni benja yayo yayinesakhiwo esincane se-hook. Lapho ihlolisisa kahle, yathola ukuthi idivayisi yokubamba ye-burr yayithembeke kakhulu kune-zipper. Ekugcineni yakha inkampani futhi yakhiqiza i-hook-and-loop fastener evame ukusetshenziswa kuma-sneakers angenantambo kanye nama-braces ezemidlalo. Isayensi echazayo kanye nesayensi esekelwe kumbono kungxoxo eqhubekayo

Izazi zezinto eziphilayo zifunda umhlaba ophilayo ngokubuza imibuzo ngawo nangokufuna izimpendulo ezisekelwe kwisayensi. Le ndlela ivamile nakwezinye isayensi futhi ivame ukubizwa ngokuthi indlela yesayensi. Indlela yesayensi yayisetshenziswa ngisho nasezikhathini zasendulo, kodwa yaqala ukubhalwa nguSir Francis Bacon waseNgilandi (1561–1626) (Isithombe 1.5), owasungula izindlela zokufundisa zesayensi. Indlela yesayensi ayisetshenziswa kuphela izazi zezinto eziphilayo kodwa ingasetshenziswa cishe kuzo zonke izinkambu zokufunda njengendlela enengqondo nenengqondo yokuxazulula izinkinga.
Inqubo yesayensi ivame ukuqala ngokubuka (ngokuvamile inkinga okufanele ixazululwe) okuholela embuzweni. Ake sicabange ngenkinga elula eqala ngokubuka bese sisebenzisa indlela yesayensi ukuxazulula inkinga. Ngolunye usuku ngoMsombuluko ekuseni, umfundi ufika ekilasini futhi uthola ngokushesha ukuthi ikilasi lifudumele kakhulu. Lokho kuwukubuka okuchaza inkinga: ikilasi lifudumele kakhulu. Umfundi ube esebuza umbuzo: Kungani ikilasi lifudumele kangaka?”

I-hypothesis yesibili ingaba, Ikilasi lifudumele ngoba kukhona ukungasebenzi kwamandla, ngakho-ke i-air conditioner ayisebenzi.”

 Uma i-hypothesis isikhethiwe, umfundi angenza isibikezelo. Isibikezelo sifana ne-hypothesis kodwa ngokuvamile sinefomethi ethi Uma . . . khona-ke . . . ” Isibonelo, isibikezelo se-hypothesis yokuqala singaba, Uma umfundi evula i-air conditioner, ikilasi ngeke lisashisa kakhulu.”

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 1. Ucwaningo Lokuphila | 1.1 Isayensi Yebhayoloji | Indlela Yesayensi | Ukuhlola I-Hypothesis
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 1. The Study of Life | 1.1 The Science of Biology | The Scientific Method | Testing a Hypothesis
chapterContent:
I-hypothesis evumelekile kumele ihlolwe. Kufanele futhi ibe yinto engelona iqiniso, okusho ukuthi ingaphikiswa ngemiphumela yokuhlolwa. Okubalulekile, isayensi ayisho ukuthi ifakazela `noma yini ngoba ukuqonda kwesayensi kuhlala kungashintsha ngolwazi olwengeziwe. Lesi sinyathelo - ukuvuleleka emibonweni ephikisayo - yisona esihlukanisa isayensi nengeyona isayensi. Ukuba khona kwezinto ezingaphezu kwemvelo, isibonelo, akuvivinywa futhi akunakwenzeka. Ukuze kuhlolwe umbono, umcwaningi uzokwenza ukuhlolwa okukodwa noma ngaphezulu okuklanyelwe ukususa umbono owodwa noma ngaphezulu. Ukuhlolwa ngakunye kuzoba nokuguquguquka okukodwa noma ngaphezulu kanye nokulawula okukodwa noma ngaphezulu. Ukuguquguquka kuyinoma iyiphi ingxenye yokuhlolwa engahluka noma ishintshe ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa. Iqembu lokulawula liqukethe zonke izici zeqembu lokuhlola ngaphandle kokuthi alinikezwa ukukhohlisa okucatshangelwayo. Ngakho-ke, uma imiphumela yeqembu lokuhlola ihlukile eqenjini lokulawula, umehluko kumele ube ngenxa yokukhohlisa okucatshangelwayo, kunokuba kube yinto ethile yangaphandle. Bheka okuguquguqukayo kanye nokulawula ezibonelweni ezilandelayo. Ukuze kuhlolwe umbono wokuqala, umfundi uzothola ukuthi umoya opholile uvuliwe. Uma umoya opholile uvuliwe kodwa ungasebenzi, kufanele kube nesinye isizathu, futhi lo mbono kufanele wenqatshwe. Ukuze kuhlolwe umbono wesibili, umfundi angahlola ukuthi izibani ekilasini ziyasebenza. Uma kunjalo, akukho ukwehluleka kwamandla futhi lo mbono kufanele wenqatshwe. Umbono ngamunye kufanele uhlolwe ngokwenza izivivinyo ezifanele. Qaphela ukuthi ukwenqaba umbono owodwa akunqumi ukuthi eminye imibono ingamukelwa noma cha; kumane kususa umbono owodwa ongewona osebenzayo (bheka lesi sibalo). Ukusebenzisa indlela yesayensi, imibono engahambisani nedatha yokuhlola iyenqatshwa.

 Ngenkathi lesi sibonelo sekilasi elifudumele” sisekelwe emiphumeleni yokubuka, eminye imibono kanye nokuhlolwa kungaba nezilawuli ezicacile. Isibonelo, umfundi angase aye ekilasini ngoMsombuluko futhi aqaphele ukuthi wayenobunzima bokugxila enkulumweni. Okunye ukuqaphela ukuchaza lokhu kungenzeka ukuthi, Uma ngidla isidlo sasekuseni ngaphambi kwekilasi, ngikwazi kangcono ukunaka.” Umfundi angase aklame ukuhlolwa ngokulawula ukuhlola le mbono.

 Kwisayensi esekelwe kumbono, imiphumela ethile ibikezelwa kusukela esimisweni esijwayelekile. Lolu hlobo lokucabanga lubizwa ngokuthi ukucabanga okususelwe kokujwayelekile: ukukhishwa kuphuma kokujwayelekile kuya kokuthile. Kodwa okuphambene nenqubo kungenzeka futhi: ngezinye izikhathi, ososayensi bafinyelela esiphethweni esijwayelekile kusukela ekubonweni okuningana okuqondile. Lolu hlobo lokucabanga lubizwa ngokuthi ukucabanga okususelwe kokunye, futhi luvela kokuthile kuya kokuthile okujwayelekile. Ukucabanga okususelwe kokunye kanye nokususelwe kokunye kuvame ukusetshenziswa ndawonye ukuthuthukisa ulwazi lwesayensi (bheka lesi sibalo). Eminyakeni yamuva nje indlela entsha yokuhlola imibono iye yathuthuka ngenxa yokukhula okukhulu kwedatha efakwe kudathabheyisi ezahlukene. Kusetshenziswa ama-algorithm ekhompyutha kanye nokuhlaziywa kwezibalo kwedatha kudathabheyisi, insimu entsha yalokho okubizwa ngokuthi ucwaningo lwedatha (okubizwa nangokuthi ocwaningweni lwe-silico) inikeza izindlela ezintsha zokuhlaziya idatha kanye nokuchazwa kwazo. Lokhu kuzokhulisa isidingo sochwepheshe kokubili ku-biology kanye nesayensi yekhompyutha, ithuba lomsebenzi elithembisayo.
Indlela yesayensi ingase ibonakale iqine kakhulu futhi ihlelekile. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi, yize ososayensi bevame ukulandela lokhu ukulandelana, kukhona ukuguquguquka. Ngezinye izikhathi ukuhlolwa kuholela eziphethweni ezisekela ushintsho endleleni yokwenza izinto; ngokuvamile, ukuhlolwa kuletha imibuzo yesayensi emisha ngokuphelele empikiswaneni. Izikhathi eziningi, isayensi ayisebenzi ngendlela eqondile; kunalokho, ososayensi bahlala bethola iziphetho futhi benze ukujwayelana, bethola amaphethini njengoba ucwaningo lwabo luqhubeka. Ukucabanga kwesayensi kuyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kunalokho okushiwo yindlela yesayensi yodwa. Phawula futhi ukuthi indlela yesayensi ingasetshenziswa ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezingezona ezesayensi ngempela.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 1. Ucwaningo Lokuphila | 1.1 Isayensi Yebhayoloji | Izinhlobo Ezimbili Zesayensi: Isayensi Eyisisekelo Nesayensi Esetshenziswayo
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 1. The Study of Life | 1.1 The Science of Biology | Two Types of Science: Basic Science and Applied Science
chapterContent:
Umphakathi wesayensi ubulokhu uphikisana eminyakeni embalwa edlule mayelana nokubaluleka kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zesayensi. Ingabe kubalulekile ukuphishekela isayensi ukuze nje uthole ulwazi, noma ingabe ulwazi lwesayensi lunenzuzo kuphela uma singalusebenzisa ekuxazululeni inkinga ethile noma ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zethu? Lo mbuzo ugxile emehluko phakathi kwezinhlobo ezimbili zesayensi: isayensi eyisisekelo nesayensi esetshenziswayo.

 Isayensi eyisisekelo noma isayensi emsulwa ifuna ukwandisa ulwazi kungakhathaliseki ukusetshenziswa kwesikhathi esifushane kwalolo lwazi. Ayigxilile ekuthuthukiseni umkhiqizo noma insizakalo enenzuzo yomphakathi noma yezentengiselwano ngokushesha. Umgomo osheshayo wesayensi eyisisekelo ulwazi ngenxa yolwazi, nakuba lokhu akusho ukuthi, ekugcineni, kungase kungabi nomphumela wokusetshenziswa okusebenzayo.

 Ngokuphambene nalokho, isayensi esetshenziswayo noma ubuchwepheshe,” ihlose ukusebenzisa isayensi ukuxazulula izinkinga zomhlaba wangempela, okwenza kube nokwenzeka, isibonelo, ukuthuthukisa isivuno sesivuno, ukuthola ikhambi lesifo esithile, noma ukusindisa izilwane ezisongelwa yinhlekelele yemvelo (Isithombe 1.8). Kusayensi esetshenziswayo, inkinga ivame ukuchazelwa umcwaningi.
Abanye abantu bangase babheke isayensi esetshenziswayo njengewusizo `nesayensi eyisisekelo njengengenamsebenzi.`Umbuzo laba bantu abangase bawubuze kusosayensi okhuthaza ukutholakala kolwazi ungaba, Kungani?`Nokho, ukubheka ngokucophelela umlando wesayensi kwembula ukuthi ulwazi oluyisisekelo luye lwaholela ekusetshenzisweni okuningi okuphawulekayo okunenani elikhulu. Ososayensi abaningi bacabanga ukuthi ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwesayensi kuyadingeka ngaphambi kokuba kuthuthukiswe isicelo; ngakho-ke, isayensi esetshenziswayo incike emiphumeleni ekhiqizwa ngesayensi eyisisekelo. Abanye ososayensi bacabanga ukuthi sekuyisikhathi sokuqhubekela phambili kusuka kwisayensi eyisisekelo bese kuthola izixazululo zezinkinga zangempela. Zombili izindlela ziyasebenza. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi kunezinkinga ezidinga ukunakwa okusheshayo; nokho, izixazululo ezimbalwa ezingatholakala ngaphandle kosizo lwesisekelo solwazi olubanzi olukhiqizwa ngesayensi eyisisekelo.

 Isibonelo esisodwa sendlela isayensi eyisisekelo nesetshenziswayo engasebenzisana ngayo ukuxazulula izinkinga ezisebenzayo senzeka ngemuva kokutholakala kwesakhiwo se-DNA kwaholela ekuqondeni izindlela zama-molecule ezilawula ukuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA. Izintambo ze-DNA, ezihlukile kuwo wonke umuntu, zitholakala emaseli ethu, lapho zinikeza khona imiyalelo edingekayo empilweni. Ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA, i-DNA yenza amakhophi amasha ayo, ngaphambi nje kokuba iseli lihlukane. Ukuqonda izindlela zokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA kwenze ososayensi bakwazi ukuthuthukisa amasu elebhu asetshenziswa manje ukuhlonza izifo zofuzo. Ngaphandle kwesayensi eyisisekelo, akunakwenzeka ukuthi isayensi esetshenziswayo ingaba khona.

 Esinye isibonelo sokuxhumana phakathi kocwaningo oluyisisekelo nolusetshenziswayo yi-Human Genome Project, ucwaningo lapho i-chromosome ngayinye yomuntu yahlaziywa futhi yadwetshwa khona ukuze kutholakale ukulandelana okunembile kwama-subunit e-DNA kanye nendawo eqondile ye-gene ngayinye. (I-gene iyiyunithi eyisisekelo yofuzo emelelwa yingxenye ethile ye-DNA ekhomba i-molecule esebenzayo.) Ezinye izinto eziphilayo eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu nazo ziye zafundwa njengengxenye yalo msebenzi ukuze kuqondwe kangcono ama-chromosome abantu. I-Human Genome Project (Isithombe 1.9) ithembele ocwaningweni oluyisisekelo olwenziwe ngezinto eziphilayo ezilula, futhi kamuva, nge-genome yomuntu. Umgomo obalulekile ekugcineni waba ukusebenzisa idatha yocwaningo olusetshenziswayo, ukufuna ukwelashwa kanye nokuxilongwa kwasekuqaleni kwezifo ezihlobene nofuzo.

 Ngenkathi imizamo yocwaningo kokubili kwisayensi eyisisekelo kanye nesayensi esetshenziswayo ivame ukuhlelwa ngokucophelela, kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi okunye okutholiwe kwenziwa ngengozi, okungukuthi, ngengozi enenhlanhla noma isimanga senhlanhla. I-Penicillin yatholakala lapho isazi sezinto eziphilayo u-Alexander Fleming ngephutha eshiya isidlo se-petri samagciwane e-Staphylococcus sivulekile. Isikhunta esingafuneki sakhula esitsheni, sabulala amabhaktheriya. Isikhunta satholakala saba yiPenicillium, futhi kwatholakala umuthi omusha wokulwa namagciwane. Ngisho nasezweni lesayensi elihlelekile kakhulu, inhlanhla—uma ihlanganiswa nengqondo eqaphelayo nenelukuluku—ingaholela ekuthuthukisweni okungalindelekile

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 1. Ucwaningo Lokuphila | 1.1 Isayensi Yebhayoloji | Ukubika Umsebenzi Wesayensi
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 1. The Study of Life | 1.1 The Science of Biology | Reporting Scientific Work
chapterContent:
Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ucwaningo lwesayensi luyisayensi eyisisekelo noma isayensi esetshenziswayo, ososayensi kumele babelane ngokutholakele kwabo ukuze abanye abacwaningi bandise futhi bakhe phezu kokutholakele kwabo. Ukubambisana nabanye ososayensi—lapho behlela, beqhuba, futhi behlaziya imiphumela—kubalulekile ocwaningweni lwesayensi. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, izici ezibalulekile zomsebenzi wososayensi ukuxhumana nontanga nokusabalalisa imiphumela kontanga. Ososayensi bangabelana ngemiphumela ngokuyethula emhlanganweni wesayensi noma engqungqutheleni, kodwa le ndlela ingafinyelela kuphela abambalwa abakhethiwe abakhona. Esikhundleni salokho, ososayensi abaningi bethula imiphumela yabo emibhalweni ebuyekezwe ontanga enyatheliswa emaphephabhukwini esayensi. Imibhalo ebuyekezwe ontanga amaphepha esayensi abuyekezwa ozakwabo bososayensi, noma ontanga. Laba ozakwabo ngabantu abafanelekile, ngokuvamile ochwepheshe endaweni efanayo yocwaningo, abahlulela ukuthi umsebenzi wososayensi ufanele yini ukushicilelwa. Inqubo yokubuyekezwa kontanga isiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ucwaningo oluchazwe ephepheni lesayensi noma esiphakamisweni sesibonelelo luyilokuqala, lubalulekile, lunengqondo, futhi luphelele. Iziphakamiso zesibonelelo, eziyizicelo zokuxhaswa ngocwaningo, nazo zingaphansi kokubuyekezwa kontanga. Ososayensi bashicilela umsebenzi wabo ukuze abanye ososayensi bakwazi ukuphinda bakhiqize izivivinyo zabo ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanayo noma ezihlukile ukuze bandise okutholakele.

 Iphepha lesayensi lihlukile kakhulu ekubhaleni okuqanjiwe. Nakuba ubuciko budingeka ukuze kuklanywe izivivinyo, kuneziqondiso eziqinile uma kukhulunywa ngokwethula imiphumela yesayensi. Okokuqala, ukubhala kwesayensi kumele kube kufushane, kube kufushane, futhi kube nenembile. Iphepha lesayensi kudingeka libe lifushane kodwa libe nemininingwane eyanele ukuvumela ontanga ukuthi baphinde bakhiqize izivivinyo.

 Iphepha lesayensi liqukethe izingxenye eziningana ezithile—isingeniso, izinto zokwakha kanye nezindlela, imiphumela, kanye nengxoxo. Lesi sakhiwo ngezinye izikhathi sibizwa ngokuthi ifomethi ye-IMRaD”. Ngokuvamile kunezingxenye zokuvuma kanye nezinkomba kanye nesifinyezo (isifinyezo esifushane) ekuqaleni kwephepha. Kungase kube nezingxenye ezengeziwe kuye ngohlobo lwephepha kanye nejenali lapho lizoshicilelwa khona; isibonelo, amanye amaphepha okubuyekeza adinga uhlaka.

 Isingeniso siqala ngolwazi olufushane, kodwa olubanzi, oluyi-bac kg mayelana nalokho okwaziwayo ensimini. Isingeniso esihle sinikeza nesizathu somsebenzi; siqinisekisa umsebenzi owenziwe futhi siphinde sikhulume kafushane ngesiphetho sephepha, lapho kuzokwethulwa khona umbono noma umbuzo wocwaningo oqhuba ucwaningo. Isingeniso sibhekisela emsebenzini wesayensi oshicilelwe wabanye futhi ngenxa yalokho sidinga izingcaphuno ezilandela isitayela sejenali. Ukusebenzisa umsebenzi noma imibono yabanye ngaphandle kokucaphuna okufanele kubhekwa njengokweba.

 Isigaba sezinto zokwakha kanye nezindlela sihlanganisa incazelo ephelele nenembile yezinto ezisetshenzisiwe, kanye nendlela namasu asetshenziswa abacwaningi ukuqoqa idatha. Incazelo kufanele ibe ephelele ngokwanele ukuvumela omunye umcwaningi ukuthi aphinde ukuhlolwa futhi athole imiphumela efanayo, kodwa Akudingeki kube yinto ephindaphindwayo. Lesi sigaba sizophinde sihlanganise ulwazi lokuthi kwenziwa kanjani izilinganiso nokuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zokubala kanye nokuhlaziywa kwezibalo okusetshenziswe ukuhlola idatha eluhlaza. Nakuba isigaba sezinto zokwakha kanye nezindlela sinikeza incazelo enembile yokuhlolwa, asixoxi ngazo.

 Amanye amajenali adinga isigaba semiphumela esilandelwa isigaba sengxoxo, kodwa kuvame kakhulu ukuhlanganisa kokubili. Uma ijenali ingavumeli ukuhlanganiswa kwezigaba zombili, isigaba semiphumela simane silandisa okutholakele ngaphandle kokuchazwa okwengeziwe. Imiphumela yethulwa ngamathebula noma amagrafu, kodwa akukho lwazi oluphindwe kabili okufanele luvezwe. Esigabeni sengxoxo, umcwaningi uzochaza imiphumela, achaze ukuthi iziguquguquko zingahlobana kanjani, futhi azame ukuchaza okubonwe. Kubalulekile ukwenza usesho olubanzi lwezincwadi ukuze kubekwe imiphumela kumongo wocwaningo lwesayensi olushicilelwe ngaphambilini. Ngakho-ke, izingcaphuno ezifanele zifakiwe kulesi sigaba futhi.

 Okokugcina, isigaba sesiphetho sifingqa ukubaluleka kokutholakele kokuhlolwa. Ngenkathi iphepha lesayensi cishe liphendule umbuzo owodwa noma eminingi yesayensi eshiwo, noma yiluphi ucwaningo oluhle kufanele luholele eminye imibuzo. Ngakho-ke, iphepha lesayensi elenziwe kahle lishiya iminyango ivulekile ukuze umcwaningi nabanye baqhubeke futhi bandise okutholakele.

 Izihloko zokubuyekeza azilandeli ifomethi ye-IMRAD ngoba azivezi okutholakele kwesayensi kokuqala, noma izincwadi eziyinhloko; kunalokho, zifingqa futhi ziphawule okutholakele okushicilelwe njengezincwadi eziyinhloko futhi ngokuvamile zifaka izingxenye eziningi zokubhekisela.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 1. Ukutadisha Ukuphila | 1.2 Izindikimba Nemibono Yebhayoloji | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 1. The Study of Life | 1.2 Themes and Concepts of Biology | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ikharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology ihlelwe ngezindikimba ezine ezinkulu ezibizwa ngokuthi i-Big Ideas ezisebenza kuwo wonke amazinga enhlangano yezinto eziphilayo—kusukela kuma-molecule namaseli kuya kubantu nasezindaweni eziphilayo. I-Big Idea ngayinye ikhomba imiqondo eyinhloko ebizwa ngokuthi i-Enduring Understandings, kanye ne-Essential Knowledges, kanye nezibonelo ezisekelayo. Izincazelo ezilula zichaza ukugxila kwe-Big Idea ngayinye: I-Big Idea 1, i-Evolution; I-Big Idea 2, Amandla kanye ne-Homeostasis; I-Big Idea 3, Ulwazi kanye Nokuxhumana; kanye ne-Big Idea 4, Izinhlelo kanye Nokuxhumana. I-Evolution ichaza kokubili ubunye kanye nokwehlukahluka kokuphila, i-Big Idea 1, futhi zonke izinto eziphilayo zidinga amandla nama-molecule ukuze zenze imisebenzi yokuphila, njengokukhula nokuzala, i-Big Idea 2. Izinhlelo eziphilayo nazo zigcina, zidlulise, futhi ziphendule olwazini, kusukela ekulandeleni kwe-DNA kuya ekushukumiseni kwezinzwa kanye nokuziphatha, i-Big Idea 3. Zonke izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo ziyasebenzisana, futhi lokhu kusebenzisana kuphumela ezimpahleni ezivelelayo kanye nezici ezihlukile empilweni, i-Big Idea 4.

 Isifundo se-AP® Biology esiklanywe kabusha sigcizelela nemikhuba yokuphenya abafundi okufanele bayiqonde. Uphenyo lwesayensi luvame ukusebenzisa uchungechunge lwezinyathelo zokuthola ulwazi olusha. Indlela yesayensi iqala ngokubuka bese ilandela ngombono ocacile ukuchaza okubonwayo; bese kwenziwa izivivinyo ukuze kuhlolwe umbono ocacile, kuqoqwe imiphumela, futhi kufinyelelwe eziphethweni ezivela kudatha. Uhlelo lwe-AP® luhlonze izigaba eziyisikhombisa ezinkulu zeMikhuba Yesayensi, ezingachazwa ngemisho emifushane: ukusebenzisa izethulo namamodeli ukuxhumana ngolwazi nokuxazulula izinkinga; ukusebenzisa izibalo ngendlela efanele; ukuzibandakanya ekubuzeni imibuzo; ukuhlela nokusebenzisa amasu okuqoqwa kwedatha; ukuhlaziya nokuhlola idatha; ukusekela izincazelo zesayensi; kanye nemiqondo exhumanisayo. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe nomunye noma ngaphezulu weMikhuba Yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe kulesi sigaba zisekela imiqondo kanye neMigomo Yokufunda echazwe ku-Big Idea 1 ye-AP® Biology Curriculum. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe ku-Curriculum Framework zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu weMikhuba Yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso Enkulu 1
Inqubo yokuziphendukela kwemvelo iqhuba ukuhlukahluka nobunye bokuphila.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 1.B
Izinto eziphilayo zixhunyaniswe yimigqa yozalo oluvela kubazali abafanayo.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.B.1 Izinto eziphilayo zabelana ngezinqubo eziningi eziyisisekelo ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezavela futhi zasakazeka kabanzi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo namuhla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
3.1 Umfundi angabuza imibuzo yesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.14 Umfundi uyakwazi ukubuza imibuzo yesayensi ekhomba ngokunembile izakhiwo ezibalulekile zezinqubo zokuphila ezihlanganisiwe, eziyisisekelo ezinikeza ukuqonda ngomlando wokuphila eMhlabeni.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
1.B.1 Izinto eziphilayo zabelana ngezinqubo eziningi eziyisisekelo ezigciniwe kanye nezici ezavela futhi zasakazeka kabanzi phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo namuhla.

 Umkhuba Wesayensi
5.3 Umfundi angahlola ubufakazi obunikezwa amasethi edatha maqondana nombuzo othile wesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
1.18 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuhlola ubufakazi obunikezwa yisethi yedatha ehambisana nomuthi we-phylogenetic noma i-cladogram nje ukunquma umlando wokuziphendukela kwemvelo kanye ne-speciation.

 I-Biology yisayensi efunda impilo, kodwa iyini ngempela impilo? Lokhu kungase kuzwakale njengombuzo oyisiwula onempendulo esobala, kodwa akulula ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuchaza impilo. Isibonelo, igatsha le-biology elibizwa ngokuthi i-virology lifunda amagciwane, abonisa ezinye zezici zezinto eziphilayo kodwa azinazo ezinye. Kuvela ukuthi nakuba amagciwane angahlasela izinto eziphilayo, abangele izifo, futhi aze azale, awahlangabezani nezindinganiso ezisetshenziswa izazi zezinto eziphilayo ukuchaza impilo. Ngenxa yalokho, izazi zezinto eziphilayo azizona izazi zezinto eziphilayo, uma sikhuluma iqiniso. Ngokufanayo, ezinye izazi zezinto eziphilayo zifunda ngokuvela kwamangqamuzana okuqala okwadala ukuphila; njengoba izehlakalo ezandulela ukuphila zingezona izehlakalo zezinto eziphilayo, laba ososayensi nabo bakhishwe ku-biology ngomqondo oqinile waleli gama.

 Kusukela ekuqaleni kwayo, i-biology ibilokhu ilwa nemibuzo emithathu: Yiziphi izakhiwo ezihlanganyelwe ezenza into iphile”? Futhi uma sesiyazi ukuthi into iyaphila, sithola kanjani amazinga anengqondo okuhleleka esakhiweni sayo? Futhi, ekugcineni, lapho sibhekene nokuhlukahluka okumangalisayo kokuphila, sizihlela kanjani izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinto eziphilayo ukuze siziqonde kangcono? Njengoba izinto ezintsha eziphilayo zitholakala nsuku zonke, izazi zezinto eziphilayo ziyaqhubeka nokufuna izimpendulo zale mibuzo neminye.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 1. Ucwaningo Lokuphila | 1.2 Izindikimba Nemibono Yebhayoloji | Izakhiwo Zokuphila
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 1. The Study of Life | 1.2 Themes and Concepts of Biology | Properties of Life
chapterContent:
Zonke izinto eziphilayo zinezimpawu noma imisebenzi eminingana ebalulekile: ukuhleleka, ukuzwela noma ukusabela endaweni ezungezile, ukuzala, ukuzivumelanisa nezimo, ukukhula kanye nentuthuko, ukulawulwa/i-homeostasis, ukucubungula amandla, kanye nokuziphendukela kwemvelo. Uma zibhekwa ndawonye, lezi zici eziyisishiyagalombili zisebenza ukuchaza impilo.

 Ukuhleleka
Izinto eziphilayo ziyizakhiwo ezihlelekile kakhulu, ezihambisanayo eziqukethe iseli elilodwa noma ngaphezulu. Ngisho nezinto eziphilayo ezilula kakhulu, ezineseli elilodwa ziyinkimbinkimbi ngokumangalisayo: ngaphakathi kweseli ngalinye, ama-athomu akha ama-molecule; lawa enza ama-organelle eseli kanye nezinye izinto ezifakiwe zamaseli. Ezintweni eziphilayo eziningi (Isithombe 1.10), amaseli afanayo akha izicubu. Izicubu, nazo, ziyasebenzisana ukudala izitho (izakhiwo zomzimba ezinomsebenzi ohlukile). Izitho zisebenza ndawonye ukwakha izinhlelo zezitho.

 Ukuzwela noma Ukusabela Ekushukumiseni
Izinto eziphilayo zisabela ezintweni ezihlukahlukene. Isibonelo, izitshalo zingagoba ziye emthonjeni wokukhanya, zikhuphuke ezindongeni nasezindongeni, noma ziphendule ekuthinteni (Isithombe 1.11). Ngisho nama-bacteria amancane angahamba aye noma asuke kumakhemikhali (inqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-chemotaxis) noma ukukhanya (i-phototaxis). Ukuya esikhuthazweni kubhekwa njengokusabela okuhle, kanti ukusuka esikhuthazweni kubhekwa njengokusabela okungekuhle.

 Ukuzalela
Izinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa zizala ngokuphinda i-DNA yazo kuqala, bese ziyihlukanisa ngokulinganayo njengoba iseli lilungiselela ukuhlukana ukuze lakhe amaseli amabili amasha. Izinto eziphilayo eziningi zivame ukukhiqiza amangqamuzana akhethekile okuzala azokwakha abantu abasha. Lapho kuzalela, izakhi zofuzo eziqukethe i-DNA zidluliselwa enzalweni yesidalwa. Lezi zakhi zofuzo ziqinisekisa ukuthi inzalo izoba ngeyohlobo olufanayo futhi izoba nezici ezifanayo, njengosayizi nesimo.

 Ukuzivumelanisa nezimo
Zonke izinto eziphilayo zibonisa ukulingana `nendawo yazo. Izazi zezinto eziphilayo zibhekisela kulokhu kufaneleka njengokuzivumelanisa nezimo, futhi kuwumphumela wokuziphendukela kwemvelo ngokukhetha kwemvelo, okusebenza kuzo zonke izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezizalanayo. Izibonelo zokuzivumelanisa nezimo ziyahlukahluka futhi zihlukile, kusukela ku-Archaea engamelani nokushisa ehlala ezindaweni ezishisayo ezibilayo kuya kubude bolimi lwenundu elidla umpe olufana nosayizi wembali elidla kuyo. Zonke izizivumelanisa nezimo zithuthukisa amandla okuzala abantu abazibonisayo, okuhlanganisa nekhono labo lokusinda ukuze bazale. Ukuzivumelanisa nezimo akuhlali njalo. Njengoba indawo ishintsha, ukukhethwa kwemvelo kubangela izici zabantu emphakathini ukuthi zilandele lezo zinguquko.

 Ukukhula Nokuthuthukiswa
Izinto eziphilayo ziyakhula futhi zithuthuke ngokulandela imiyalelo ethile ebhalwe yizakhi zazo zofuzo. Lezi zakhi zofuzo zinikeza imiyalelo ezoqondisa ukukhula nokuthuthukiswa kwamaseli, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi intsha yohlobo (Isithombe 1.12) izokhula ibonise izici eziningi ezifanayo nabazali bayo.

 Ukulawulwa/I-Homeostasis
Ngisho nezinto eziphilayo ezincane kakhulu ziyinkimbinkimbi futhi zidinga izindlela eziningi zokulawula ukuxhumanisa ngaphakathi imisebenzi, isabela ezicini, futhi ibhekane nokucindezeleka kwemvelo. I-Homeostasis (ngokoqobo, isimo esizinzile) ibhekisela endaweni yangaphakathi ezinzile edingekayo ukuze kulondolozwe impilo. Izibonelo ezimbili zemisebenzi yangaphakathi elawulwayo emzimbeni ukuthuthwa kwezakhamzimba kanye nokugeleza kwegazi. Izitho zomzimba (amaqembu ezicubu ezisebenza ndawonye) zenza imisebenzi ethile, njengokuthwala umoya-mpilo emzimbeni wonke, ukususa imfucuza, ukuletha izakhamzimba kuwo wonke amaseli, nokupholisa umzimba.
Ukuze asebenze kahle, amaseli adinga izimo ezifanele njengokushisa okufanele, i-pH, kanye nokuhlushwa okufanele kwamakhemikhali ahlukahlukene. Nokho, lezi zimo zingase zishintshe kusukela komunye umzuzu kuya komunye. Izinto eziphilayo ziyakwazi ukugcina izimo zangaphakathi ze-homeostatic ngaphakathi kwebanga elincane cishe njalo, naphezu kwezinguquko zemvelo, ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokulawula. Isibonelo, into eziphilayo idinga ukulawula izinga lokushisa lomzimba ngenqubo yokushisa. Izinto eziphilayo ezihlala ezindaweni ezibandayo, njengebhere eliyi-polar (Isithombe 1.13), zinezakhiwo zomzimba ezizisiza ukuthi zikwazi ukumelana namazinga okushisa aphansi futhi zilondoloze ukushisa komzimba. Izakhiwo ezisiza kulolu hlobo lokuvikela zihlanganisa uboya, izimpaphe, ama-blubber, namafutha. Ezimweni ezishisayo, izinto eziphilayo zinezindlela (ezifana nokujuluka kubantu noma ukuhefuzela ezinjeni) ezizisiza ukuthi zikhiphe ukushisa komzimba okweqile.

 Ukucubungula Amandla
Zonke izinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa umthombo wamandla emisebenzini yazo yokugaya ukudla. Ezinye izinto eziphilayo zibamba amandla elangeni bese ziwaguqula abe amandla amakhemikhali ekudleni; ezinye zisebenzisa amandla amakhemikhali kuma-molecule eziwathatha njengokudla (Isithombe 1.14).

 Ukuziphendukela kwemvelo
Ukuhlukahluka kokuphila eMhlabeni kuwumphumela wokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo, noma izinguquko ezingahleliwe ezintweni ezizuzwa njengefa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kuvumela ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zikwazi ukuzivumelanisa nendawo eshintshayo. Izinto eziphilayo ezishintsha izici ezifanele indawo ezungezile zizoba nempumelelo enkulu yokuzala, ngaphansi kwamandla okukhetha kwemvelo

chapterContent:
Izinto eziphilayo zihlelekile futhi zakhiwe kahle kakhulu, zilandela uhlu olungahlolwa ngesikali kusukela kokuncane kuya kokukhulu. I-athomu iyiyunithi encane kakhulu futhi eyisisekelo yento egcina izakhiwo zento.. Yakhiwa yi-nucleus ezungezwe ama-electron. Ama-athomu akha ama-molecule. I-molecule isakhiwo samakhemikhali esakhiwa okungenani ama-athomu amabili abanjwe ndawonye ngesibopho samakhemikhali esisodwa noma ngaphezulu. Ama-molecule amaningi abalulekile ngokwebhayoloji ama-macromolecule, ama-molecule amakhulu avame ukwakheka yi-polymerization (i-polymer iyi-molecule enkulu enziwa ngokuhlanganisa amayunithi amancane abizwa ngokuthi ama-monomers, alula kune-macromolecule). Isibonelo se-macromolecule yi-deoxyribonucleic acid (i-DNA) (Isithombe 1.15), equkethe imiyalelo yesakhiwo nokusebenza kwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo.

 Amanye amaseli aqukethe ama-aggregates ama-macromolecule azungezwe ama-membrane; lawa abizwa ngokuthi ama-organelle. Ama-organelle ayizakhiwo ezincane ezikhona ngaphakathi kwamaseli. Izibonelo zama-organelle zifaka phakathi ama-mitochondria nama-chloroplast, enza imisebenzi ebalulekile: amandla enqubo ye-mitochondria ukunika amandla iseli, kuyilapho ama-chloroplast evumela izitshalo eziluhlaza ukusebenzisa amandla atholakala elangeni ukwenza ushukela. Zonke izinto eziphilayo zenziwe ngamaseli; iseli ngokwalo liyunithi encane kakhulu yesakhiwo nomsebenzi ezintweni eziphilayo. (Lesi sidingo yingakho amagciwane engabhekwa njengaphilayo: awakhiwanga ngamaseli. Ukuze enze amagciwane amasha, kufanele ahlasele futhi athathe indlela yokuzala yeseli eliphilayo; yilapho kuphela lapho engathola khona izinto azidingayo ukuze azale.) Ezinye izinto eziphilayo zakhiwa iseli elilodwa kanti ezinye zinamangqamuzana amaningi. Amaseli ahlukaniswa njenge-prokaryotic noma i-eukaryotic. Ama-Prokaryotes yizinto eziphilayo ezineseli elilodwa noma ezihlala ndawonye ezingenayo i-nuclei eboshwe yi-membrane; ngokuphambene nalokho, amaseli e-eukaryotes anama-organelle aboshwe yi-membrane kanye ne-nucleus eboshwe yi-membrane.

 Ezintweni eziphilayo ezinkulu, amaseli ahlangana ukwenza izicubu, okuyiqembu lamaseli afanayo enza imisebenzi efanayo noma ehlobene. Izitho ziyiqoqo lezicubu eziqoqwe ndawonye zenza umsebenzi ojwayelekile. Izitho zomzimba azikho ezilwaneni kuphela kodwa nasezitshalweni. Uhlelo lwezitho zomzimba luyizinga eliphakeme lokuhleleka eliqukethe izitho ezihlobene nokusebenza. Izilwane ezincelisayo zinezinhlelo eziningi zezitho zomzimba. Isibonelo, uhlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi luthutha igazi emzimbeni futhi luye futhi lubuya emaphashini; luhlanganisa izitho ezifana nenhliziyo nemithambo yegazi. Izinto eziphilayo ziyizinto eziphilayo ngazinye. Isibonelo, umuthi ngamunye ehlathini uyinto ephilayo. Ama-prokaryotes aneseli elilodwa kanye nama-eukaryotes aneseli elilodwa nawo abhekwa njengezinto eziphilayo futhi ngokuvamile abizwa ngokuthi ama-microorganisms.

 Zonke izinhlobo ezihlala endaweni ethile zibizwa ngokuthi abantu. Isibonelo, ihlathi lingafaka izihlahla eziningi zephayini. Zonke lezi zihlahla zephayini zimelela inani lezihlahla zephayini kuleli hlathi. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zingahlala endaweni efanayo. Isibonelo, ihlathi elinezihlahla zephayini lihlanganisa inani lezitshalo eziqhakazayo kanye nezinambuzane kanye nezinhlobo ezincane. Umphakathi yisamba sabantu abahlala endaweni ethile. Isibonelo, zonke izihlahla, izimbali, izinambuzane, kanye nezinye izinhlobo ehlathini zakha umphakathi wehlathi. Ihlathi ngokwalo liyi-ecosystem. I-ecosystem yakhiwa yizo zonke izinto eziphilayo endaweni ethile kanye nezingxenye ezingaphili ze-abiotic, ezingaphili zaleyo ndawo njenge-nitrogen enhlabathini noma emanzini emvula. Ezingeni eliphezulu lokuhleleka (Isithombe 1.16), i-biosphere iyiqoqo lazo zonke i-ecosystem, futhi imelela izindawo zokuphila emhlabeni. Ihlanganisa umhlaba, amanzi, ngisho nomkhathi ngezinga elithile.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 1. Ucwaningo Lokuphila | 1.2 Izindikimba Nemibono Yebhayoloji | Ukuhlukahluka Kokuphila
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 1. The Study of Life | 1.2 Themes and Concepts of Biology | The Diversity of Life
chapterContent:
Iqiniso lokuthi i-biology, njengesayensi, inobubanzi obungaka lihlobene nokuhlukahluka okukhulu kokuphila emhlabeni. Umthombo walokhu kuhlukahluka ukuziphendukela kwemvelo, inqubo yokushintsha kancane kancane lapho kuvela khona izinhlobo ezintsha ezivela ezinhlotsheni ezindala. Izazi ze-biology eziziphendukela kwemvelo zifunda ngokuvela kwezinto eziphilayo kukho konke kusukela ezweni elincane kuya ezindaweni zemvelo.

 Ukuvela kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zokuphila eMhlabeni kungafingqwa esihlahleni se-phylogenetic (Isithombe 1.17). Umuthi we-phylogenetic uwumdwebo obonisa ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo phakathi kwezinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ngokusekelwe kokufana nokwehluka kwezakhi zofuzo noma izici zomzimba noma kokubili. Umuthi we-phylogenetic wakhiwe ngama-node namagatsha. Ama-node angaphakathi amelela okhokho futhi angamaphuzu ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo lapho, ngokusekelwe ebufakazini besayensi, kucatshangwa ukuthi ukhokho uhlukene ukuze akhe izinhlobo ezimbili ezintsha. Kwezinye izihlahla ze-phylogenetic, ubude begatsha ngalinye bungase bulingane nesikhathi esidlulile kusukela ekuhlukaneni.

 Ukuxhumana Kokuziphendukela Kwemvelo
UCarl Woese kanye Nomuthi We-Phylogenetic
Esikhathini esidlule, izazi zezinto eziphilayo zazihlanganisa izinto eziphilayo zibe imibuso eyisithupha—izilwane, izitshalo, isikhunta, i-protista, i-archea, kanye namabhaktheriya. Uhlelo lokuhlela lwalusekelwe kakhulu ezicini zomzimba, ngokungafani ne-physiology, i-biochemistry, noma i-molecular biology, konke okusetshenziswa yizinhlelo zesimanje. Umsebenzi wokuqala wesazi sezinto ezincane saseMelika uCarl Woese ekuqaleni kwawo-1970 ukhombisile, nokho, ukuthi impilo eMhlabeni iguquke ngezigaba ezintathu, manje ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-domain—Ama-Bacteria, ama-Archaea, kanye nama-Eukarya. Amabili okuqala angamaseli e-prokaryotic anama-microbes angenayo i-membrane-enclosed nuclei kanye nama-organelles. Isizinda sesithathu siqukethe ama-eukaryotes futhi sihlanganisa ama-microorganisms e-unicellular kanye nama-multicellular kanye nemibuso emine yokuqala (ngaphandle kwamabhaktheriya). UWoese uchaze i-Archaea njengesizinda esisha, futhi lokhu kwaholela esihlahleni esisha se-taxonomic (Isithombe 1.17). Izinto eziphilayo eziningi ezingaphansi kwesizinda se-Archaea zihlala ngaphansi kwezimo ezimbi kakhulu futhi zibizwa ngokuthi ama-extremophiles. Ukuze akhe isihlahla sakhe, uWoese wasebenzisa ubudlelwano bezakhi zofuzo kunokufana okusekelwe ku-morphology (isimo).

 Umuthi kaWoese wakhiwe ngokulandelana okuqhathanisayo kwezakhi zofuzo ezisatshalaliswa yonke indawo, ezikhona kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo, futhi ezilondolozwe (okusho ukuthi lezi zakhi zofuzo azizange zishintshe ngokuphelele ekuziphendukeleni kwemvelo). Indlela kaWoese yayishintshashintsha ngoba ukuqhathanisa izici zomzimba akwanele ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwama-prokaryote abonakala efana kakhulu naphezu kokuhlukahluka kwawo okukhulu kwamakhemikhali kanye nokuguquguquka kwezakhi zofuzo (Isithombe 1.18). Ukuqhathanisa ukulandelana kwe-rRNA kwanikeza i-Woese idivayisi ebucayi eyembula ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwama-prokaryote, futhi eyaqinisekisa ukuhlukaniswa kwama-prokaryote ezindaweni ezimbili: amabhaktheriya kanye nama-archaea.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 1. Ukutadisha Ukuphila | 1.2 Izindikimba Nemibono Yebhayoloji | Amagatsha Okutadisha Ibhayoloji
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 1. The Study of Life | 1.2 Themes and Concepts of Biology | Branches of Biological Study
chapterContent:
Ububanzi bebhayoloji bubanzi ngakho-ke buqukethe amagatsha amaningi kanye nemikhakha engaphansi. Izazi zebhayoloji zingaphishekela enye yalezo mikhakha engaphansi futhi zisebenze ensimini egxile kakhulu. Isibonelo, i-molecular biology kanye ne-biochemistry zifunda izinqubo zebhayoloji ezingeni lama-molecule kanye namakhemikhali, okuhlanganisa nokusebenzisana phakathi kwama-molecule njenge-DNA, i-RNA, kanye namaprotheni, kanye nendlela ezilawulwa ngayo. I-Microbiology, isifundo sama-microorganism, isifundo sesakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi wezinto eziphilayo ezingenakubonwa ngeso lenyama. Kuyigatsha elibanzi ngokwalo, futhi kuye ngesihloko socwaningo, kukhona nezazi ze-microbial physiology, izazi ze-ecology, kanye nezakhi zofuzo, phakathi kwabanye.

 Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi
Usosayensi Wezobunhloli
Isayensi Yezobunhloli ukusetshenziswa kwesayensi ukuphendula imibuzo ehlobene nomthetho. Izazi zebhayoloji kanye namakhemikhali kanye nezazi ze-biochem bangaba ososayensi bezobunhloli. Ososayensi bezobunhloli banikeza ubufakazi besayensi ukuze busetshenziswe ezinkantolo, futhi umsebenzi wabo uhilela ukuhlola izinto zokulandelela ezihlobene nobugebengu. Intshisekelo kwisayensi yezobunhloli ikhule eminyakeni embalwa edlule, mhlawumbe ngenxa yemidlalo yethelevishini ethandwayo equkethe ososayensi bezobunhloli emsebenzini. Futhi, ukuthuthukiswa kwamasu e-molecule kanye nokusungulwa kwezizindalwazi ze-DNA kuye kwandisa izinhlobo zomsebenzi ososayensi be-forensic abangazifeza. Umsebenzi wabo uhilela ukuhlaziya amasampula anjengezinwele, igazi, kanye nolunye uketshezi lomzimba kanye nokucubungula i-DNA (Isithombe 1.20) etholakala ezindaweni eziningi ezahlukene kanye nezinto zokwakha. Ososayensi be-forensic bahlaziya nobunye ubufakazi be-biology obushiywe ezindaweni zobugebengu, njengezibungu zezinambuzane noma izinhlamvu ze-pollen. Abafundi abafuna ukuphishekela imisebenzi kwisayensi ye-forensic cishe kuzodingeka bathathe izifundo ze-chemistry kanye ne-biology kanye nezinye izifundo zezibalo ezijulile.

 Enye insimu yokufunda nge-biology, i-neurobiology, ifunda i-biology yesimiso sezinzwa, futhi nakuba ibhekwa njengegatsha le-biology, ibuye iqashelwe njengensimu yokufunda ye-interdisciplinary eyaziwa ngokuthi i-neuroscience. Ngenxa yemvelo yayo ye-interdisciplinary, le ngxenye ye-subdisciplinary ifunda imisebenzi ehlukene yesistimu yezinzwa isebenzisa izindlela ze-molecule, ze-cellular, ze-developmental, ze-medical, kanye ne-computational.

 I-Paleontology, elinye igatsha le-biology, isebenzisa ama-fossil ukutadisha umlando wempilo (Isithombe 1.21). I-Zoology kanye ne-botany yizifundo zezilwane nezitshalo, ngokulandelana. Izazi zezinto eziphilayo zingaba ngochwepheshe be-biotechnologists, izazi ze-ecologists, noma izazi ze-physiology, ukubala izindawo ezimbalwa nje. Lesi yisibonelo esincane nje semikhakha eminingi izazi zezinto eziphilayo ezingayiphishekela.

 I-Biology iyisiphetho sempumelelo yesayensi yemvelo kusukela ekuqaleni kwayo kuze kube namuhla. Ngokujabulisayo, yisiqalo sesayensi esanda kuvela, njenge-biology yomsebenzi wobuchopho, ubunjiniyela bezakhi zofuzo zezinto eziphilayo ezenziwe ngokwezifiso, kanye ne-biology yokuziphendukela kwemvelo esebenzisa amathuluzi elebhu e-molecular biology ukulandelela izigaba zokuqala zokuphila emhlabeni. Ukuskena kwezihloko zezindaba—kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kubika ngokugonywa, uhlobo olusanda kutholakala, ukusebenzisa izidakamizwa kwezemidlalo, noma ukudla okuguqulwe izakhi zofuzo—kubonisa indlela i-biology esebenza futhi ibalulekile ngayo emhlabeni wethu wansuku zonke.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 1. Ucwaningo Lokuphila | 1.4 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 1. The Study of Life | 1.4 Chapter Summary
chapterContent:
1.1 Isayensi Yebhayoloji

 Ibhayoloji yisayensi efunda izinto eziphilayo kanye nokusebenzisana kwazo kanye nezindawo ezizungezile. Isayensi izama ukuchaza nokuqonda uhlobo lwendawo yonke ngokuphelele noma ngokwengxenye ngezindlela ezinengqondo. Isayensi inemikhakha eminingi; leyo mikhakha ehlobene nomhlaba ongokoqobo kanye nezenzakalo zayo ibhekwa njengesayensi yemvelo.

 Isayensi ingaba eyisisekelo noma esetshenziswayo. Umgomo oyinhloko wesayensi eyisisekelo ukwandisa ulwazi ngaphandle kokulindela ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwesikhathi esifushane kwalolo lwazi. Umgomo oyinhloko wocwaningo olusetshenziswayo, nokho, ukuxazulula izinkinga ezingokoqobo.

 Izinhlobo ezimbili zokucabanga okunengqondo ziyasetshenziswa kwisayensi. Ukucabanga okubangelwayo kusebenzisa imiphumela ethile ukukhiqiza izimiso zesayensi ezijwayelekile. Ukucabanga okubangelwayo kuyindlela yokucabanga okunengqondo ebikezela imiphumela ngokusebenzisa izimiso ezijwayelekile. Intambo evamile kulo lonke ucwaningo lwesayensi ukusetshenziswa kwendlela yesayensi, inqubo esekelwe ezinyathelweni equkethe ukwenza ukuqaphela, ukuchaza inkinga, ukubeka imibono, ukuhlola le mibono, nokufinyelela isiphetho esisodwa noma ngaphezulu. Ukuhlola kusebenzisa izilawuli ezifanele. Ososayensi bethula imiphumela yabo emaphepheni esayensi abuyekezwe ontanga ashicilelwe kumajenali esayensi. Iphepha locwaningo lwesayensi liqukethe izingxenye eziningana ezichazwe kahle: isingeniso, izinto zokwakha kanye nezindlela, imiphumela, kanye, ekugcineni, ingxoxo yokuphetha. Amaphepha okubuyekeza afingqa ucwaningo olwenziwe ensimini ethile esikhathini esithile.

 1.2 Izindikimba kanye Nemibono Yebhayoloji

 Ibhayoloji yisayensi yokuphila. Zonke izinto eziphilayo zabelana ngezakhiwo eziningana ezibalulekile njengokuhleleka, ukuzwela noma ukusabela ezishukumisweni, ukuzala, ukukhula kanye nentuthuko, ukulawulwa, i-homeostasis, kanye nokucubungula amandla. Izinto eziphilayo ziyizingxenye ezihlelekile kakhulu zesigaba esihlanganisa ama-athomu, ama-molecule, ama-organelle, amaseli, izicubu, izitho, kanye nezinhlelo zezitho. Izinto eziphilayo, zona, ziqoqwe njengezinhlobo zabantu, imiphakathi, izimiso zemvelo, kanye ne-biosphere. Ukwehlukahluka okukhulu kokuphila namuhla kwavela ezintweni eziphilayo zokhokho ezingahlukahlukene kakhulu eminyakeni eyizigidigidi. Umdwebo obizwa ngokuthi umuthi we-phylogenetic ungasetshenziswa ukukhombisa ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo phakathi kwezinto eziphilayo.

 Ibhayoloji ibanzi kakhulu futhi ihlanganisa amagatsha amaningi kanye nezifundo ezincane. Izibonelo zifaka phakathi i-molecular biology, i-microbiology, i-neurobiology, i-zoology, kanye ne-botany, phakathi kwezinye

question5: Yikuphi kwalokhu okulandelayo okuyisibonelo sokucabanga okusekelwe ebufakazini?

distractor5c: Izilwane ezincane zilahlekelwa ukushisa okukhulu kunezilwane ezinkulu. Umuntu ubengeke alindele ukuthola amagundane asendle ezinsikeni

answer9: I-Biosphere, i-ecosystem, umphakathi, inani labantu, izinto eziphilayo

question12: Ingabe izibalo ziyisayensi yemvelo? Chaza isizathu sakho
answer12: Cha, akuyona isayensi yemvelo. Izibalo zigxile ekuqondeni ubudlelwano bezibalo kanye nokubala, okuwusizo kwisayensi yemvelo kodwa okuhlukile
distractor12a: Cha, akuyona isayensi yemvelo ngoba ayisetshenziswa ekufundweni komhlaba wemvelo.
distractor12b: Yebo, kuyisayensi yemvelo. Izibalo ziphathelene nokuqinisekisa idatha yokuhlola
distractor12c: Yebo, kuyisayensi yemvelo. Isebenzisa izilinganiso zamakhemikhali nezomzimba
question13: Nakuba indlela yesayensi isetshenziswa iningi lesayensi, ingasetshenziswa nasezimweni zansuku zonke. Usebenzisa indlela yesayensi, hlela lezi zinyathelo ngokulandelana okufanele: Uma imoto ingaqali inkinga ingase ibe sebhethrini. Imoto ayiqali. Ngemva kokushintsha ibhethri, imoto iqala ukusebenza. Imoto kufanele iqale ngemva kokushaja ibhethri noma ukushintsha ibhethri. Imoto ayiqali ngoba ibhethri selifile. Imoto ayiqali ngisho nangemva kokushaja ibhethri, ibhethri kumele ukuthi liyeke ukusebenza.
question14: Funda imibuzo elandelayo. Yiziphi izitatimende ezizibophezela ocwaningweni kusetshenziswa indlela yesayensi? Ingabe i-macaroni noshizi kunambitheka kakhulu kunesobho le-broccoli? chapterContent:
Zonke izinto eziphilayo, okuhlanganisa nezinto eziphilayo, zakhiwe yizinhlanganisela ezahlukene zezinto eziphilayo. Ezinye zezinto eziphilayo eziningi kakhulu zihlanganisa ikhabhoni, i-hydrogen, i-nitrogen, i-oxygen, i-sulfur, ne-phosphorus. Lezi zinto zakha ama-molecule amakhulu ezinto eziphilayo—ama-nucleic acid, amaprotheni, ama-carbohydrate, nama-lipid—okuyizinto eziyisisekelo zezinto eziphilayo. Izazi zezinto eziphilayo zifunda la ma-molecule abalulekile ukuze ziqonde izakhiwo zawo ezihlukile ezinquma imisebenzi yazo ekhethekile.

 Zonke izinqubo zezinto eziphilayo zilandela imithetho yefiziksi nekhemistri. Ngakho-ke, ukuze uqonde ukuthi izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenza kanjani, kubalulekile ukuqonda ifiziksi nekhemistri eyisisekelo. Isibonelo, ukugeleza kwegazi ngaphakathi kohlelo lokujikeleza kwegazi kulandela imithetho yefiziksi elawula izindlela zokugeleza koketshezi. Imithetho yamakhemikhali inquma ukuqhekeka kwama-molecule okudla amakhulu, ayinkimbinkimbi abe ama-molecule amancane kanye nokuguqulwa kwawo abe amandla agcinwe ku-adenosine triphosphate (ATP). Ama-molecule e-polar, ukwakheka kwezibopho ze-hydrogen, kanye nezakhiwo zamanzi eziphumayo kuyisihluthulelo sokuqonda izinqubo zokuphila. Ukuqaphela izakhiwo zama-acid nezisekelo kubalulekile ukuqonda izinqubo ezahlukene zezinto eziphilayo njengokugaya ukudla. Ngakho-ke, izisekelo zefiziksi nekhemistri ziyisisekelo sokuthola ukuqonda ngezinqubo zezinto eziphilayo.

 Isibonelo sendlela ukuqonda izinqubo zamakhemikhali okunganikeza ngayo ukuqonda ngenqubo yezinto eziphilayo ucwaningo lwamuva mayelana nokuphazamiseka kwemizwa yesizini (i-SAD). Lolu hlobo lokucindezeleka luthinta abantu abangafika ku-10% ekwindla nasebusika. Izimpawu zifaka phakathi ukuthambekela kokudla ngokweqile, ukulala ngokweqile, ukuntuleka kwamandla, kanye nobunzima bokugxila emisebenzini. Manje ososayensi bathole ukuthi i-SAD ayibangelwa nje kuphela ukuntuleka kwevithamini D, kodwa futhi ivame kakhulu kubantu abanesikhumba esimnyama. Bheka Umfanekiso 2.1

chapterContent:
Izinhlelo eziphilayo zilalela imithetho yekhemistri kanye nefiziksi. Izinto ezikhona ziyinoma yini ethatha isikhala nobunzima. Izinto ezingu-92 ezenzeka ngokwemvelo zinezakhiwo ezihlukile, futhi inhlanganisela yazo ehlukahlukene yakha ama-molecule, ahlangana ukwakha ama-organelle, amaseli, izicubu, uhlelo lwezitho, kanye nezinto eziphilayo. Ama-athomu, aqukethe ama-proton, ama-neutron, nama-electron, angamayunithi amancane kakhulu ezinto ezigcina zonke izici zawo futhi azinzile kakhulu lapho amagobolondo awo angaphandle noma ama-valence electron equkethe inani elikhulu lama-electron. Ama-electron angadluliselwa, abelwane, noma abangele ukungafani kweshaja phakathi kwama-athomu ukudala izibopho, kufaka phakathi izibopho ze-ionic, i-covalent, kanye ne-hydrogen, kanye nokusebenzisana kwe-van der Waals. Ama-Isotopes ayizinhlobo ezahlukene zento enezinombolo ezahlukene zama-neutron ngenkathi egcina inani elifanayo lama-proton; ama-isotope amaningi, njenge-carbon-14, anemisebe.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe kulesi sigaba zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 ye-AP® Biology Curriculum Framework. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe kuHlaka Lwezifundo zinikeza isisekelo esicacile sesifundo se-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2

 Ezingeni layo eliyisisekelo, impilo yakhiwe yizinto. Izinto ziyinoma iyiphi into ethatha isikhala futhi inobunzima. Izinto ziyizinhlobo ezihlukile zezinto ezinezakhiwo ezithile zamakhemikhali nezomzimba ezingenakuhlukaniswa zibe izinto ezincane ngokusabela okuvamile kwamakhemikhali. Kunezinto eziyi-118, kodwa ezingu-98 kuphela ezenzeka ngokwemvelo. Izinto ezisele zenziwa emalabhorethri futhi azizinzile.

 Isici ngasinye sichazwa uphawu lwaso lwamakhemikhali, oluyinhlamvu eyodwa enkulu noma, lapho uhlamvu lokuqala seluthathwe `yinye into, inhlanganisela yezinhlamvu ezimbili. Ezinye izakhi zilandela igama lesiNgisi lesakhi, njengo-C wekhabhoni kanye no-Ca we-calcium. Izimpawu zamakhemikhali zezinye izakhi zivela emagameni azo esiLatini; isibonelo, uphawu lwe-sodium ngu-Na, olubhekisela ku-natrium, igama lesiLatini le-sodium.

 Izakhi ezine ezivamile kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo yi-oxygen (O), i-carbon (C), i-hydrogen (H), kanye ne-nitrogen (N). Ezweni elingaphili, izakhi zitholakala ngezilinganiso ezahlukene, kanti ezinye izakhi ezivamile ezintweni eziphilayo azivamile emhlabeni wonke (Isithombe 2.1.1). Isibonelo, umkhathi ucebile nge-nitrogen ne-oxygen kodwa uqukethe ikhabhoni ne-hydrogen encane, kuyilapho ungqimba lomhlaba, yize luqukethe i-oxygen kanye nenani elincane le-hydrogen, lune-nitrogen ne-carbon encane. Naphezu kokwehluka kwazo ngobuningi, zonke izakhi kanye nokusabela kwamakhemikhali phakathi kwazo kuthobela imithetho efanayo yamakhemikhali neyomzimba kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ziyingxenye yezwe eliphilayo noma elingaphili.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Samakhemikhali Sokuphila | 2.1 Ama-Athomu, Ama-Isotope, Ama-Ion, Nama-Molecule: Amabhulokhi Okwakha | Isakhiwo Se-Athomu
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.1 Atoms, Isotopes, Ions, and Molecules: The Building Blocks | The Structure of the Atom
chapterContent:
Ukuze siqonde ukuthi izakhi zihlangana kanjani, kumele siqale sixoxe ngesakhi esincane kakhulu noma ibhlogo lokwakha lesakhi, i-athomu. I-athomu iyiyunithi encane kakhulu yento egcina zonke izakhi zamakhemikhali zesakhi. Isibonelo, i-athomu eyodwa yegolide inazo zonke izakhi zegolide, njengokusabela kwayo kwamakhemikhali. Uhlamvu lwegolide lumane luyinani elikhulu kakhulu lama-athomu egolide abunjwe abe ngesimo semali futhi aqukethe inani elincane lezinye izakhi ezaziwa ngokuthi ukungcola. Ama-athomu egolide awakwazi ukuhlukaniswa abe yinto encane ngenkathi esagcina izakhi zegolide.

 I-athomu yakhiwe yizifunda ezimbili: i-nucleus, engaphakathi kwe-athomu futhi equkethe ama-proton nama-neutron, kanye nesifunda esingaphandle se-athomu esibamba ama-electron ayo azungeza i-nucleus, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.2. Ama-athomu aqukethe ama-proton, ama-electron, nama-neutron, phakathi kwezinye izinhlayiya ezingaphansi kwe-athomu. I-isotope evame kakhulu ye-hydrogen (H) iyona kuphela ehlukile futhi yenziwe nge-proton eyodwa ne-electron eyodwa engenama-neutron.

 Ama-Proton nama-neutron anesisindo esifanayo cishe, cishe angu-1.67 × 10-24 amagremu . Ososayensi bachaza ngokunganaki leli nani lesisindo njengeyunithi eyodwa yesisindo se-athomu (amu) noma i-Dalton eyodwa (Isithombe 2.2.1). Nakuba kufana ngesisindo, ama-proton nama-neutron ahlukile ekushajweni kwawo kagesi. I-proton ishajwa kahle kanti i-neutron ayishajwa. Ngakho-ke, inani lama-neutron ku-athomu linikela kakhulu esisindo sayo, kodwa hhayi ekushajweni kwayo. Ama-electron mancane kakhulu ngesisindo kunama-proton, anesisindo esingu-9.11 × 10-28 amagremu kuphela, noma cishe u-1/1800 weyunithi yesisindo se-athomu. Ngakho-ke, awanikeli okuningi esisindo se-athomu sento. Ngakho-ke, lapho ucabangela isisindo se-athomu, kuyinto evamile ukunganaki isisindo sanoma yimaphi ama-electron bese ubala isisindo se-athomu ngokusekelwe enanini lama-proton nama-neutron kuphela. Nakuba kungebona abanikeli ababalulekile ebuningini, ama-electron anikela kakhulu ekushajweni kwe-athomu, njengoba i-electron ngayinye ineshaja engemihle elingana neshaja engemihle ye-proton. Kuma-athomu angashajwanga, angathathi hlangothi, inani lama-electron azungeza i-nucleus lilingana nenani lama-proton ngaphakathi kwe-nucleus. Kula ma-athomu, amashaja amahle nangalungile ayakhiphana, okuholela ku-athomu engenashaja eningi.

 Uma kubalwa ubukhulu bama-proton, ama-neutron, nama-electron, iningi levolumu ye-athomu—elingaphezu kwamaphesenti angu-99—empeleni, liyisikhala esingenalutho. Ngalo lonke leli sikhala esingenalutho, umuntu angabuza ukuthi kungani izinto ezibizwa ngokuthi eziqinile zingadluli nje komunye nomunye. Isizathu sokuthi azidluli ukuthi ama-electron azungeze wonke ama-athomu ashaja kabi futhi amashaja amabi ayaxoshana.

chapterContent: Ama-athomu ento ngayinye aqukethe inani elihlukile lama-proton nama-electron. Inani lama-proton linquma inombolo ye-athomu yento futhi lisetshenziselwa ukuhlukanisa into eyodwa kwenye. Inani lama-neutron liyaguquguquka, okuholela kuma-isotope, okuyizinhlobo ezahlukene ze-athomu efanayo ehluka kuphela enanini lama-neutron anawo. Ndawonye, inani lama-proton kanye nenani lama-neutron linquma inombolo yesisindo sento (Isithombe 2.3). Qaphela ukuthi umnikelo omncane wesisindo esivela kuma-electron awunakwa ekubaleni inombolo yesisindo. Lokhu kulinganiselwa kwesisindo kungasetshenziswa ukubala kalula ukuthi mangaki ama-neutron i-element enayo ngokumane ukhiphe inani lama-proton enombolweni yesisindo. Njengoba ama-isotope ento ethile ezoba nezinombolo zesisindo ezihlukile kancane, ososayensi banquma nesisindo se-athomu, okuyisilinganiso esibalwe sesisindo se-athomu sama-isotope ayo avela ngokwemvelo. Ngokuvamile, inombolo ephumayo iqukethe ingxenye. Isibonelo, isisindo se-athomu se-chlorine (Cl) singama-35.45 ngoba i-chlorine yakhiwe ngama-isotope amaningana, amanye (iningi) anesisindo se-athomu esingu-35 (ama-proton angu-17 nama-neutron angu-18) kanti amanye anesisindo se-athomu esingu-37 (ama-proton angu-17 nama-neutron angu-20)

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Samakhemikhali Sokuphila | 2.1 Ama-Athomu, Ama-Isotopes, Ama-Ion, Nama-Molecule: Amabhulokhi Okwakha | Ama-Isotopes
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.1 Atoms, Isotopes, Ions, and Molecules: The Building Blocks | Isotopes
chapterContent:
Ama-Isotope ayizinhlobo ezahlukene zesakhi esinenani elifanayo lama-proton kodwa inani elihlukile lama-neutron. Ezinye izakhi—njenge-carbon, i-potassium, ne-uranium—zinama-isotope avela ngokwemvelo. I-Carbon-12 iqukethe ama-proton ayisithupha, ama-neutron ayisithupha, nama-electron ayisithupha; ngakho-ke, inenani lesisindo esingu-12 (ama-proton ayisithupha nama-neutron ayisithupha). I-Carbon-14 iqukethe ama-proton ayisithupha, ama-neutron ayisishiyagalombili, nama-electron ayisithupha; isisindo sayo se-athomu singama-14 (ama-proton ayisithupha nama-neutron ayisishiyagalombili). Lezi zinhlobo ezimbili ezihlukile ze-carbon ziyi-isotopes. Amanye ama-isotope angakhipha ama-neutron, ama-proton, nama-electron, futhi athole ukwakheka okuzinzile kwe-athomu (izinga eliphansi lamandla angase abe khona); lawa ama-isotope anemisebe, noma ama-radioisotopes. Ukubola kwemisebe (i-carbon-14 elahlekelwa ama-neutron ukuze ekugcineni abe yi-nitrogen-14) kuchaza ukulahleka kwamandla okwenzeka lapho i-nucleus ye-athomu engazinzile ikhipha imisebe.

 Ukuxhumana Kokuvela Kokuguquka
Ukuqomisana Kwekhabhoni
Ikhabhoni ivame ukuba khona emkhathini ngesimo segesi amakhilogremu njengekhabhoni dioksijini ne-methane. Ikhabhoni-14 (14C) iyi-radioisotope eyenzeka ngokwemvelo edalwa emkhathini kusuka ku-atmospheric 14N (nitrogen) ngokungezwa kwe-neutron kanye nokulahlekelwa yi-proton ngenxa yemisebe ye-cosmic. Lena inqubo eqhubekayo, ngakho-ke kudalwa ama-14C engeziwe njalo. Njengoba into ephilayo ihlanganisa ama-14C ekuqaleni njengekhabhoni dioksijini eqinisiwe enkambisweni ye-photosynthesis, inani elilinganiselwe lama-14C emzimbeni wayo lilingana nokuhlushwa kwama-14C emkhathini. Lapho into ephilayo ifa, ayisadli ama-14C, ngakho-ke isilinganiso esiphakathi kwama-14C no-12C sizoncipha njengoba ama-14C ebola kancane kancane abe yi-14N ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-beta decay—ukukhishwa kwama-electron noma ama-positron. Lokhu kubola kukhipha amandla enkambisweni ehamba kancane.

 Ngemva kweminyaka ecishe ibe ngu-5,730, ingxenye yokuqala kokuhlushwa kwe-14C izobe isiguqulwe yaba yi-14N. Isikhathi esithathayo ukuze ingxenye yokuhlushwa kokuqala kwe-isotope ibole ibuyele esimweni sayo esizinzile sibizwa ngokuthi i-half-life yayo. Ngenxa yokuthi i-half-life ye-14C yinde, isetshenziswa kuze kube manje ezintweni ezaziphila ngaphambili njengamathambo amadala noma ukhuni. Uma kuqhathaniswa isilinganiso sokuhlushwa kwe-14C okutholakala entweni nenani le-14C elitholwe emoyeni, inani le-isotope elingakaboli linganqunywa. Ngokusekelwe kuleli nani, ubudala bezinto, njenge-pygmy mammoth eboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.4, bungabalwa ngokunemba uma bungadluli eminyakeni engaba ngu-50,000. Ezinye izakhi zinama-isotope anezimpilo ezihlukene ze-half. Isibonelo, i-40K (potassium-40) inokuphila kwengxenye yeminyaka eyizigidigidi eziyi-1.25, kanti i-235U (Uranium 235) inokuphila kwengxenye yeminyaka engaba yizigidi ezingama-700. Ngokusebenzisa i-radiometric dating, ososayensi bangafunda iminyaka yezinsalela noma ezinye izinsalela zezinto eziphilayo eziphelile ukuze baqonde ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ziguquke kanjani ezinhlotsheni zangaphambilini.

chapterContent:
Izinto ezahlukene zihlelwe futhi ziboniswe kuthebula lezinto eziphindaphindwayo. Laklanywa ngusokhemisi waseRussia uDmitri Mendeleev (1834–1907) ngo-1869, leli thebula lihlanganisa izinto, nakuba zihlukile, ezabelana ngezakhiwo ezithile zamakhemikhali nezinye izinto. Izakhiwo zezinto zinomthwalo wemfanelo ngesimo sazo somzimba ekushiseni kwegumbi: zingaba amagesi, izinto eziqinile, noma uketshezi. Izinto nazo zinokusabela kwamakhemikhali okuthile, ikhono lokuhlangana nokubopha ngamakhemikhali.

 Etafuleni lezinto eziphindaphindwayo, eliboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.5, izinto zihlelwe futhi ziboniswe ngokwenombolo yazo ye-athomu futhi zihlelwe ochungechungeni lwemigqa namakholomu ngokusekelwe ezimpahleni zamakhemikhali nezomzimba ezabiwe. Ngaphezu kokunikeza inombolo ye-athomu yento ngayinye, ithebula lezinto eziphindaphindwayo liphinde libonise isisindo se-athomu sento. Uma ubheka ikhabhoni, isibonelo, kuvela uphawu lwayo (C) negama, kanye nenombolo yayo ye-athomu eyisithupha (ekhoneni eliphezulu kwesobunxele) kanye nesisindo sayo se-athomu esingu-12.01.

 Ithebula le-periodic lihlanganisa izakhi ngokwezakhiwo zamakhemikhali. Umehluko ekusebenzeni kwamakhemikhali phakathi kwezakhi usekelwe enanini kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwendawo kwama-electron e-athomu. Ama-athomu asabela ngamakhemikhali futhi ahlangane akha ama-molecule. Ama-molecule angama-athomu amabili noma ngaphezulu ahlanganiswe ngamakhemikhali ndawonye. Ngokunengqondo, lapho ama-athomu amabili ehlangana ngamakhemikhali ukuze akhe i-molecule, ama-electron awo, akha isifunda esingaphandle kakhulu se-athomu ngayinye, ahlangana kuqala njengoba ama-athomu akha isibopho samakhemikhali.
