chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Samakhemikhali Sokuphila | 2.1 Ama-Athomu, Ama-Isotope, Ama-Ion, Nama-Molecule: Amabhulokhi Okwakha | Amagobolondo E-Electron kanye Nemodeli Ye-Bohr
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.1 Atoms, Isotopes, Ions, and Molecules: The Building Blocks | Electron Shells and the Bohr Model
chapterContent:
Kufanele kugcizelelwe ukuthi kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwenani lama-proton entweni ethile, inombolo ye-athomu ehlukanisa into eyodwa kwenye, kanye nenani lama-electron elinayo. Kuwo wonke ama-athomu angathathi hlangothi kagesi, inani lama-electron lifana nenani lama-proton. Ngakho-ke, into ngayinye, okungenani uma ingathathi hlangothi kagesi, inenombolo ephawulekayo yama-electron alingana nenombolo yayo ye-athomu.

 Imodeli yokuqala ye-athomu yasungulwa ngo-1913 ngusosayensi waseDenmark uNiels Bohr (1885–1962). Imodeli ye-Bohr ikhombisa i-athomu njenge-nucleus ephakathi equkethe ama-proton nama-neutron, nama-electron emagobolondweni e-electron noma amazinga wamandla ebangeni elithile ukusuka ku-nucleus, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.6. La mazinga wamandla aqokwa yinombolo kanye nophawu n.” Isibonelo, i-1n imelela izinga lokuqala lamandla eliseduze kakhulu ne-nucleus.

 Ama-electron agcwalisa ama-orbital ngokulandelana okufanayo: aqala agcwalise ama-orbital aseduze kakhulu ne-nucleus, bese eqhubeka nokugcwalisa ama-orbital akhulisa amandla kude ne-nucleus. Uma kune-orbital eziningi zamandla alinganayo, azogcwaliswa nge-electron eyodwa ezingeni ngalinye lamandla ngaphambi kokuba kufakwe i-electron yesibili. Ama-electron asezingeni lamandla angaphandle anquma ukuzinza kwamandla kwe-athomu kanye nokuthambekela kwayo ekwakheni izibopho zamakhemikhali namanye ama-athomu ukwakha ama-molecule.

 Ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile, ama-athomu agcwalisa amagobolondo angaphakathi kuqala, okuvame ukuholela enanini eliguquguqukayo lama-electron egobolondo elingaphandle. Igobolondo elingaphakathi kakhulu linama-electron amabili e-valence kodwa amagobolondo amabili alandelayo e-electron angaba nama-electron ayisishiyagalombili e-valence. Lokhu kwaziwa ngokuthi umthetho we-octet, othi, ngaphandle kwegobolondo elingaphakathi kakhulu, ama-athomu azinza kakhulu ngamandla uma enama-electron ayisishiyagalombili egobolondo lawo le-valence, igobolondo le-electron elingaphandle kakhulu. Izibonelo zamanye ama-athomu angathathi hlangothi kanye nokulungiselelwa kwawo kwe-electron ziboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.7. I-Helium inegobolondo eliphelele le-electron yangaphandle, elinama-electron amabili agcwalisa igobolondo layo lokuqala nelokuphela kwalo. Ngokufanayo, i-neon inegobolondo eliphelele le-2n eliqukethe ama-electron ayisishiyagalombili. Ngokuphambene nalokho, i-chlorine ne-sodium zinesikhombisa kanye ne-one emagobolondweni azo angaphandle, ngokulandelana, kodwa ngokwethiyori beziyozinza kakhulu ngamandla uma zilandela umthetho we-octet futhi zinama-electron ayisishiyagalombili e-valence..

 Ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlelwa kwethebula le-periodic kusekelwe enanini eliphelele lama-proton (nama-electron) kusisiza sazi ukuthi ama-electron asatshalaliswa kanjani phakathi kwamagobolo. Ithebula le-periodic lihlelwe ngamakholomu nemigqa ngokusekelwe enanini lama-electron nokuthi la ma-electron atholakala kuphi. Bheka ezinye zezinto ezisekholomu yesokudla etafuleni etafuleni le-periodic (Isithombe 2.5). Ama-athomu angu-18 eqembu i-helium (He), i-neon (Ne), kanye ne-argon (Ar) wonke agcwalise amagoboloni e-electron angaphandle, okwenza kungadingeki ukuthi abelane ngama-electron namanye ama-athomu ukuze athole ukuzinza; azinzile kakhulu njengama-athomu angawodwa. Ukungahlangani kwawo kuye kwaholela ekutheni aqanjwe ngokuthi Amagesi angasebenzi (noma amagesi amahle). Qhathanisa lokhu nezinto zeqembu 1 kukholamu engakwesobunxele. Lezi zinto, okuhlanganisa i-hydrogen (H), i-lithium (Li), kanye ne-sodium (Na), zonke zine-electron eyodwa emagobolondweni azo angaphandle. Lokho kusho ukuthi zingafinyelela ukwakheka okuzinzile kanye negobolondo langaphandle eligcwele ngokunikela noma ngokwabelana nge-electron eyodwa nenye i-athomu noma i-molecule efana namanzi. I-hydrogen izonikela noma yabelane nge-electron yayo ukuze ifinyelele lokhu kulungiselelwa, kuyilapho i-lithium ne-sodium zizonikela nge-electron yazo ukuze zizinzile. Ngenxa yokulahlekelwa yi-electron eshajeke kabi, ziba ama-ion ashajeke kahle. Izinto zeqembu 17, okuhlanganisa i-fluorine ne-chlorine, zinama-electron ayisikhombisa emagobolondweni azo angaphandle, ngakho-ke zivame ukugcwalisa leli gobolondo nge-electron evela kwamanye ama-athomu noma ama-molecule, okwenza ama-ion ashajeke kabi. Izinto zeqembu 14, lapho ikhabhoni ibaluleke kakhulu ezinhlelweni eziphilayo, zinama-electron amane egobolondweni lazo langaphandle ezivumela ukuthi zenze izibopho eziningana ze-covalent (okuxoxwe ngazo ngezansi) namanye ama-athomu. Ngakho-ke, amakholomu ethebula le-periodic amelela isimo esingaba khona sokwabelana kwamagobolondo e-electron angaphandle alezi zinto esinomthwalo wemfanelo wezimpawu zawo zamakhemikhali ezifanayo.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Samakhemikhali Sokuphila | 2.1 Ama-Athomu, Ama-Isotope, Ama-Ion, Nama-Molecule: Amabhulokhi Okwakha | Ama-Electron Orbitals
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.1 Atoms, Isotopes, Ions, and Molecules: The Building Blocks | Electron Orbitals
chapterContent:
Nakuba kuwusizo ukuchaza ukusabela kanye nokubopha kwamakhemikhali kwezinto ezithile, imodeli ye-Bohr ye-athomu ayibonisi ngokunembile ukuthi ama-electron asatshalaliswa kanjani ngokwendawo azungeze i-nucleus. Awayijikelezi i-nucleus njengoba umhlaba ujikeleza ilanga, kodwa atholakala kuma-orbital e-electron. Lezi zimo eziyinkimbinkimbi zivela eqinisweni lokuthi ama-electron aziphathi njengezinhlayiya nje kuphela, kodwa futhi njengamagagasi. Izibalo zezibalo ezivela kuma-quantum mechanics ezaziwa ngokuthi imisebenzi yamagagasi zingabikezela ngaphakathi kwezinga elithile lokungenzeka ukuthi i-electron ingaba khona nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Indawo lapho i-electron itholakala khona kakhulu ibizwa ngokuthi i-orbital yayo.

 Khumbula ukuthi imodeli ye-Bohr ibonisa ukwakheka kwegobolondo le-electron le-athomu. Ngaphakathi kwegobolondo ngalinye le-electron kukhona ama-subshell, futhi i-subshell ngayinye inenani elithile lama-orbital aqukethe ama-electron. Nakuba kungenakwenzeka ukubala ngqo ukuthi i-electron itholakala kuphi, ososayensi bayazi ukuthi cishe itholakala ngaphakathi kwendlela yayo ye-orbital. Ama-subshell aqokwe uhlamvu s, p, d, kanye no-f. I-subshell s iyindilinga ngesimo futhi ine-orbital eyodwa. Igobolondo eliyinhloko i-1n line-orbital eyodwa kuphela ye-s, engabamba ama-electron amabili. Igobolondo eliyinhloko i-2n line-subshell eyodwa ye-s kanye ne-p eyodwa, futhi lingabamba ama-electron ayisishiyagalombili. I-subshell ye-p inama-orbital amathathu anomumo we-dumbbell, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 2.8. Ama-subshell d kanye ne-f anezimo eziyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu futhi aqukethe ama-orbital amahlanu kanye nesikhombisa, ngokulandelana. Lawa awaboniswanga emfanekisweni. Igobolondo eliyinhloko i-3n linama-subshell angu-s, p, kanye ne-d futhi lingabamba ama-electron angu-18. Igobolondo eliyinhloko i-4n linama-orbital angu-s, p, d kanye ne-f futhi lingabamba ama-electron angu-32. Ukusuka kude ne-nucleus, inani lama-electron kanye nama-orbital atholakala emazingeni amandla liyakhula. Uma iqhubekela phambili kusuka ku-athomu eyodwa kuya kwenye etafuleni le-periodic, isakhiwo se-electron singasethwa ngokufaka i-electron eyengeziwe ku-orbital elandelayo etholakalayo.

 I-orbital eseduze kakhulu ne-nucleus, ebizwa ngokuthi i-orbital ye-1s, ingabamba ama-electron amabili. Le orbital ilingana negobolondo elingaphakathi le-electron lemodeli ye-Bohr ye-athomu. Ibizwa ngokuthi i-orbital ye-1s ngoba iyindilinga ezungeze i-nucleus. I-orbital ye-1s iyona orbital eseduze kakhulu ne-nucleus, futhi ihlala igcwaliswa kuqala, ngaphambi kokuba noma iyiphi enye i-orbital igcwaliswe. I-hydrogen ine-electron eyodwa; ngakho-ke, inendawo eyodwa kuphela ngaphakathi kwe-orbital ye-1s ehlalwa. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-1s1, lapho i-1 ebhalwe ngaphezulu ibhekisela ku-electron eyodwa ngaphakathi kwe-orbital ye-1s. I-Helium inama-electron amabili; ngakho-ke, ingagcwalisa ngokuphelele i-orbital ye-1s ngama-electron ayo amabili. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-1s2, kubhekiselwa kuma-electron amabili e-helium ku-orbital ye-1s. Etafuleni le-periodic Umfanekiso 2.5, i-hydrogen ne-helium yizona zinto ezimbili kuphela emgqeni wokuqala (isikhathi); lokhu kungenxa yokuthi zinama-electron kuphela egobolondweni lazo lokuqala, i-orbital ye-1s. I-Hydrogen ne-helium yizona zinto ezimbili kuphela ezine-1s futhi azikho ezinye i-orbital ze-electron esimweni sokungathathi hlangothi kukagesi.

 Igobolondo lesibili le-electron lingase libe nama-electron ayisishiyagalombili. Leli gobolondo liqukethe elinye i-orbital eliyindilinga kanye nama-p orbital amathathu anomumo we-dumbbell”, ngalinye lawo lingabamba ama-electron amabili, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.8. Ngemva kokuba i-orbital ye-1s igcwalisiwe, igobolondo lesibili le-electron liyagcwaliswa, okokuqala ligcwalisa i-orbital yalo ye-2s bese kuba ama-p orbital amathathu. Lapho ligcwalisa ama-p orbital, ngalinye lithatha i-electron eyodwa; uma i-p orbital ngayinye ine-electron, isibili singangezwa. I-Lithium (Li) iqukethe ama-electron amathathu ahlala emagobolondweni okuqala nawesibili. Ama-electron amabili agcwalisa i-orbital ye-1s, kanti i-electron yesithathu bese igcwalisa i-orbital ye-2s. Ukuma kwayo kwe-electron kungu-1s22s1. I-Neon (Ne), ngakolunye uhlangothi, inama-electron ayishumi: amabili ase-orbital yayo engaphakathi ye-1s kanti ayisishiyagalombili agcwalisa igobolondo layo lesibili (amabili ngalinye kuma-2s nama-p orbital amathathu); ngakho-ke, iyigesi engasebenzi futhi izinzile ngamandla njenge-athomu eyodwa engeke yakhe isibopho samakhemikhali namanye ama-athomu. Izinto ezinkulu zine-orbital eyengeziwe, ezakha igobolondo lesithathu le-electron. Ngenkathi imiqondo ye-electron Amagobolondo nama-orbital ahlobene kakhulu, ama-orbital anikeza incazelo enembile kakhulu yokuma kwama-electron e-athomu ngoba imodeli ye-orbital ichaza izimo ezahlukene kanye nokuqondiswa okukhethekile kwazo zonke izindawo ama-electron angase ahlale kuzo.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Samakhemikhali Sokuphila | 2.1 Ama-Athomu, Ama-Isotope, Ama-Ion, Nama-Molecule: Amabhulokhi Okwakha | Ukusabela Kwamakhemikhali Nama-Molecule
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.1 Atoms, Isotopes, Ions, and Molecules: The Building Blocks | Chemical Reactions and Molecules
chapterContent:
Zonke izakhi zizinzile kakhulu uma igobolondo lazo elingaphandle ligcwele ama-electron ngokomthetho we-octet. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi kuyathandeka ngamandla ukuthi ama-athomu abe kulolo hlobo futhi kuwenza azinze. Kodwa-ke, njengoba kungezona zonke izakhi ezinama-electron anele ukugcwalisa amagobolondo azo angaphandle, ama-athomu akha izibopho zamakhemikhali namanye ama-athomu ngaleyo ndlela athole ama-electron awadingayo ukuze afinyelele ukwakheka okuzinzile kwama-electron. Lapho ama-athomu amabili noma ngaphezulu ebophana ngamakhemikhali, isakhiwo samakhemikhali esiphumelayo siyi-molecule. I-molecule yamanzi ejwayelekile, i-H2O, yakhiwa ama-athomu amabili e-hydrogen kanye ne-athomu elilodwa le-oxygen; lawa ahlangana ndawonye ukuze akhe amanzi, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.9. Ama-athomu angakha ama-molecule ngokunikela, ukwamukela, noma ukwabelana ngama-electron ukuze agcwalise amagobolondo awo angaphandle.

 Ukusabela kwamakhemikhali kwenzeka lapho ama-athomu amabili noma ngaphezulu ebophana ndawonye ukuze akhe ama-molecule noma lapho ama-athomu ahlanganisiwe ehlukana. Izinto ezisetshenziswa ekuqaleni kokusabela kwamakhemikhali zibizwa ngokuthi ama-reactants (ngokuvamile atholakala ohlangothini lwesobunxele lwe-equation yamakhemikhali), kanti izinto ezitholakala ekugcineni kokusabela zaziwa ngokuthi imikhiqizo (ngokuvamile etholakala ohlangothini lwesokudla lwe-equation yamakhemikhali). Umcibisholo uvame ukudwetshwa phakathi kwama-reactants nemikhiqizo ukukhombisa isiqondiso sokusabela kwamakhemikhali; lesi siqondiso asihlali siyindlela eyodwa. Ukuze kudalwe i-molecule yamanzi eboniswe ngenhla, i-chemical equation izoba yilokhu:

 2⁢H + O → H2O
Isibonelo sokusabela okulula kwamakhemikhali ukuqhekeka kwama-molecule e-hydrogen peroxide, ngalinye lawo liqukethe ama-athomu amabili e-hydrogen ahlanganiswe nama-athomu amabili e-oxygen (H2O2). I-reactant hydrogen peroxide ihlukaniswa ibe ngamanzi, equkethe i-athomu elilodwa le-oxygen eliboshwe nama-athomu amabili e-hydrogen (H2O), kanye ne-oxygen, equkethe ama-athomu amabili e-oxygen ahlanganisiwe (O2). Kulesi sibalo esingezansi, ukusabela kufaka phakathi ama-molecule amabili e-hydrogen peroxide nama-molecule amabili amanzi. Lesi yisibonelo se-chemical equation elinganiselayo, lapho inani lama-athomu ento ngayinye lifana ohlangothini ngalunye lwe-equation. Ngokomthetho wokulondolozwa kwezinto, inani lama-athomu ngaphambi nangemva kokusabela kwamakhemikhali kufanele lilingane, kangangokuthi azikho ama-athomu, ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile, adalwe noma abhujiswe.

 2H2⁢O2⁢ (hydrogen peroxide) → 2H2⁢O (amanzi) + O2 (umoya-mpilo)
Ngisho noma zonke izithasiselo kanye nemikhiqizo yalesi senzo kungama-molecule (i-athomu ngayinye ihlala ixhunywe okungenani kwenye i-athomu eyodwa), kulokhu kusabela i-hydrogen peroxide namanzi kuphela abamele i-com amakhilogremu : aqukethe ama-athomu ezinhlobo ezingaphezu kweyodwa ze-element. I-oxygen yama-molecule, ngakolunye uhlangothi, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 2.10, iqukethe ama-athomu amabili e-oxygen ahlanganiswe kabili futhi awahlukaniswa njenge-compound kodwa njenge-molecule ye-homonuclear.

 Ezinye izimpendulo zamakhemikhali, njengalezo eziboniswe ngenhla, zingaqhubeka ngendlela eyodwa kuze kube yilapho zonke izimpendulo seziphelile. Izibalo ezichaza lezi zimpendulo ziqukethe umcibisholo oqondile futhi azinakuguqulwa. Izimpendulo eziguqukayo yilezo ezingaya kunoma iyiphi indlela. Ekuphenduleni okuguquguqukayo, izimpendulo ziguqulwa zibe imikhiqizo, kodwa lapho ukuhlushwa komkhiqizo kudlula umkhawulo othile (isici sempendulo ethile), eminye yale mikhiqizo izoguqulwa ibe yizimpendulo; kuleli qophelo, ukuqokwa kwemikhiqizo kanye nezimpendulo kuyaguqulwa. Lokhu kuya phambili naphambili kuyaqhubeka kuze kube yilapho ibhalansi ethile ehlobene phakathi kwezimpendulo kanye nemikhiqizo kwenzeka—isimo esibizwa ngokuthi ukulingana. Lezi zimo zokusabela okuguquguqukayo zivame ukubonakaliswa yi-equation yamakhemikhali enomcibisholo onekhanda eliphindwe kabili okhomba kokubili ama-reactants kanye nemikhiqizo.

 Isibonelo, egazini lomuntu, ama-ion e-hydrogen amaningi (H+) abopha kuma-ion e-bicarbonate (HCO3-) akha isimo sokulingana ne-carbonic acid (H2CO3). Uma i-carbonic acid ingezwa kulolu hlelo, amanye awo angaguqulwa abe ama-ion e-bicarbonate kanye ne-hydrogen.

 HCO−⁢+H+—H2⁢CO3
Nokho, ekuphenduleni kwezinto eziphilayo, ukulingana akuvamile ukutholakala ngoba amazinga ama-reactants noma imikhiqizo noma kokubili ashintsha njalo, ngokuvamile ngomkhiqizo wokusabela okukodwa okuba yi-reactant kwenye. Ukubuyela esibonelweni sama-ion e-hydrogen amaningi egazini, ukwakheka kwe-carbonic acid kuzoba yisiqondiso esikhulu sokusabela. Kodwa-ke, i-carbonic acid ingashiya umzimba njengegesi ye-carbon dioxide (ngokuphefumula) esikhundleni sokuguqulwa ibuyele ku-ion ye-bicarbonate, ngaleyo ndlela iqhube ukusabela ngakwesokudla ngomthetho wamakhemikhali owaziwa ngokuthi umthetho wesenzo esikhulu. Lokhu kusabela kubalulekile ekugcineni i-homeostasis yegazi lethu.

 HCO−⁢ + H+ — H2⁢CO3⁢ ↔ CO2⁢ + H2O

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Samakhemikhali Sokuphila | 2.1 Ama-Athomu, Ama-Isotope, Ama-Ion, Nama-Molecule: Amabhulokhi Okwakha | Ama-Ion kanye Nezibopho Ze-Ionic
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.1 Atoms, Isotopes, Ions, and Molecules: The Building Blocks | Ions and Ionic Bonds
chapterContent:
Amanye ama-athomu azinza kakhulu uma ethola noma elahlekelwa yi-electron (noma mhlawumbe amabili) bese enza ama-ion. Lokhu kugcwalisa igobolondo lawo langaphandle lama-electron futhi kuwenze azinze ngamandla. Ngenxa yokuthi inani lama-electron alilingani nenani lama-proton, i-ion ngayinye ineshaja ehlanzekile. Ama-cation angama-ion amahle akhiwa ngama-electron alahlekile. Ama-ion angalungile akhiwa ngokuthola ama-electron futhi abizwa ngokuthi ama-anion. Ama-anion aqanjwa ngokuthi igama lawo eliyisisekelo lishintshwa libe sekupheleni ngo--ide”: i-anion ye-chlorine ibizwa ngokuthi i-chloride, kanti i-anion yesulfure ibizwa ngokuthi i-sulfide, isibonelo.

 Lokhu kuhamba kwama-electron kusuka kwesinye isici kuya kwesinye kubizwa ngokuthi ukudluliselwa kwama-electron. Njengoba uMfanekiso 2.11 ubonisa, i-sodium (Na) ine-electron eyodwa kuphela egobolondweni layo langaphandle lama-electron. Kuthatha amandla amancane ukuze i-sodium inikele ngaleyo electron eyodwa kunaleyo eyenzayo ukuze yamukele amanye ama-electron ayisikhombisa ukuze igcwalise igobolondo langaphandle. Uma i-sodium ilahlekelwa yi-electron, manje inama-proton ayi-11, ama-neutron ayi-11, kanye nama-electron ayi-10 kuphela, okuyishiya ineshaja iyonke engu-+1. Manje ibizwa ngokuthi i-sodium ion. I-Chlorine (Cl) esimweni sayo samandla esiphansi kakhulu (esibizwa ngokuthi isimo somhlabathi) inama-electron ayisikhombisa egobolondweni layo langaphandle. Futhi, i-chlorine iyonga amandla kakhulu ukuze ithole i-electron eyodwa kunokulahlekelwa ayisikhombisa. Ngakho-ke, ivame ukuthola i-electron ukuze idale i-ion enama-proton ayi-17, ama-neutron ayi-17, kanye nama-18 ama-electron, okwenza kube nokushaja okune-neti negative (–1). Manje sekubizwa ngokuthi i-chloride ion. Kulesi sibonelo, i-sodium izonikela nge-electron yayo eyodwa ukuze ikhiphe igobolondo layo, futhi i-chlorine izokwamukela leyo electron ukuze igcwalise igobolondo layo. Womabili ama-ion manje ahlangabezana nomthetho we-octet futhi anamagobolondo aphelele angaphandle. Ngenxa yokuthi inani lama-electron alisalingani nenani lama-proton, ngalinye manje seliyi-ion futhi line-+1 (sodium cation) noma i-–1 (chloride anion). Qaphela ukuthi lokhu kuthengiselana kuvame ukwenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa: ukuze i-athomu ye-sodium ilahlekelwe yi-electron, kumele ibe khona lapho kukhona umamukeli ofanele njenge-athomu ye-chlorine.

 Izibopho ze-Ionic zakhiwa phakathi kwama-ion anamacala aphikisanayo. Isibonelo, ama-ion e-sodium ashajwe kahle kanye nama-ion e-chloride ashajwe kabi ahlangana ndawonye ukwenza amakristalu e-sodium chloride, noma usawoti wetafula, okudala i-molecule yekristalu ene-zero net charge.

 Amanye amasawoti abizwa ngokuthi ama-electrolyte ku-physiology (kufaka phakathi i-sodium, i-potassium, ne-calcium), ama-ion adingekayo ekushukumeni kwemizwa ukuqhutshwa kwemisipha, ukufinyela kwemisipha kanye nokulinganisela kwamanzi. Iziphuzo eziningi zezemidlalo kanye nezithako zokudla zinikeza lawa ma-ion ukuze athathe indawo yalawo alahleka emzimbeni ngokujuluka ngesikhathi sokuzivocavoca.

chapterContent:
Enye indlela umthetho we-octet ongafezwa ngayo iwukwabelana ngama-electron phakathi kwama-athomu ukuze kwakheke izibopho ze-covalent. Lezi zibopho zivame kakhulu kunezibopho ze-ionic kuma-molecule ezinto eziphilayo. Izibopho ze-covalent zivame ukutholakala kuma-molecule e-organic asekelwe ku-carbon, njenge-DNA namaprotheni ethu. Izibopho ze-covalent zitholakala nasema-molecule angaphili njenge-H2O, i-CO2, ne-O2. Ipheya elilodwa, amabili, noma amathathu ama-electron angabiwa, okwenza izibopho ezilodwa, ezimbili, kanye nezithathu, ngokulandelana. Izibopho ze-covalent eziningi phakathi kwama-athomu amabili, kulapho ukuxhumana kwawo kuqina khona. Ngakho-ke, izibopho ezintathu zinamandla kakhulu.

 Amandla amazinga ahlukene okubopha kwe-covalent kungenye yezizathu eziyinhloko ezenza izinto eziphilayo zibe nesikhathi esinzima ekutholeni i-nitrogen ukuze isetshenziswe ekwakheni ama-molecule azo, yize i-nitrogen yama-molecule, i-N2, iyigesi eningi kakhulu emkhathini. I-nitrogen yama-molecule iqukethe ama-athomu amabili e-nitrogen ahlanganiswe kathathu komunye nomunye futhi, njengakuwo wonke ama-molecule, ukwabelana kwala mapheya amathathu ama-electron phakathi kwama-athomu amabili e-nitrogen kuvumela ukugcwaliswa kwamagobolondo awo angaphandle e-electron, okwenza i-molecule izinze kakhulu kune-athomu ngayinye ye-nitrogen. Lokhu kubopha okuphindwe kathathu okuqinile kwenza kube nzima ngezinhlelo eziphilayo ukuhlukanisa le nitrogen ukuze ziyisebenzise njengezakhi zamaprotheni kanye ne-DNA.

 Ukwakheka kwama-molecule amanzi kunikeza isibonelo sokubopha kwe-covalent. Ama-athomu e-hydrogen kanye ne-oxygen ahlangana ukwakha ama-molecule amanzi ahlanganiswa ngezibopho ze-covalent, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.9. I-electron evela ku-hydrogen ihlukanisa isikhathi sayo phakathi kwegobolondo langaphandle elingaphelele lama-athomu e-hydrogen kanye negobolondo langaphandle elingaphelele lama-athomu e-oxygen. Ukuze kugcwaliswe ngokuphelele igobolondo langaphandle le-oxygen, elinama-electron ayisithupha egobolondo lalo langaphandle kodwa elingaba lizinzile kakhulu ngama-eight, kudingeka ama-electron amabili (elilodwa elivela ku-athomu ngayinye ye-hydrogen): yingakho ifomula eyaziwayo i-H2O. Ama-electron abiwa phakathi kwezinto ezimbili ukuze kugcwaliswe igobolondo langaphandle lalo ngalinye, okwenza zombili izinto ziqine kakhudlwana.

Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zezibopho ze-covalent: i-polar kanye ne-nonpolar. Esibophweni se-covalent se-polar (Isithombe 2.12) ama-electron abiwa ngokungalingani ngama-athomu njengoba ama-electron edonswa kakhulu ku-nucleus eyodwa kunenye. Ngenxa yokusatshalaliswa okungalingani kwama-electron phakathi kwama-athomu ezinto ezahlukene, kuvela ishaja encane (δ+) noma encane (δ–). Le shaja engaphelele iyisici esibalulekile samanzi futhi ichaza izici eziningi zayo.

 Amanzi ayi-molecule ye-polar, lapho ama-athomu e-hydrogen ethola ishaja engaphelele kanye ne-oxygen ishaja engaphelele. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba i-nucleus ye-athomu ye-oxygen ikhanga kakhulu kuma-electron ama-athomu e-hydrogen kunokuba i-nucleus ye-hydrogen injalo kuma-electron e-oxygen. Ngakho-ke i-oxygen ine-electronegativity ephezulu kune-hydrogen futhi ama-electron abiwe achitha isikhathi esiningi eduze kwe-nucleus ye-oxygen kunaseduze ne-nucleus yama-athomu e-hydrogen, okunikeza ama-athomu e-oxygen kanye ne-hydrogen ishaja engaphelele kanye ne-positive, ngokulandelana. Enye indlela yokusho lokhu ukuthi amathuba okuthola i-electron ehlanganyelwe eduze kwe-nucleus ye-oxygen angcono kakhulu kunokuyithola eduze kwe-nucleus ye-hydrogen. Noma ngabe yikuphi, i-electronegativity ehlobene ye-athomu inegalelo ekuthuthukisweni kwamacala angaphelele noma nini lapho into eyodwa ine-electronegative kakhulu kunenye, futhi amacala akhiqizwa yilawa ma-polar bond angasetshenziswa ekwakhekeni kwama-hydrogen bond ngokusekelwe ekukhangeni kwamacala angaphelele aphambene. (Ama-hydrogen bond, okuxoxwa ngawo ngokuningiliziwe ngezansi, ayizibopho ezibuthakathaka phakathi kwama-athomu e-hydrogen ashajwe kancane nama-athomu ashajwe kancane angaphelele kwamanye ama-molecule.) Njengoba ama-macromolecule evame ukuba nama-athomu ngaphakathi kwawo ahlukile ku-electronegativity, ama-polar bond avame ukuba khona kuma-molecule e-organic.

Izibopho ze-covalent ezingezona i-polar zakha phakathi kwama-athomu amabili e-element efanayo noma phakathi kwezinto ezahlukene ezabelana ngama-electron ngokulinganayo. Isibonelo, i-molecule oxygen (O2) ayiyona i-polar ngoba ama-electron azosatshalaliswa ngokulinganayo phakathi kwama-athomu amabili e-oxygen.

 Esinye isibonelo sesibopho se-covalent esingeyona i-polar yi-methane (CH4) (Isithombe 2.12). I-Carbon inama-electron amane egobolondweni layo langaphandle futhi idinga amanye amane ukuze iwagcwalise. Ithola lawa amane kuma-athomu amane e-hydrogen, i-athomu ngayinye inikeza elilodwa, okwenza igobolo langaphandle elizinzile lama-electron ayisishiyagalombili. I-Carbon ne-hydrogen azinayo i-electronegativity efanayo kodwa ziyafana; ngakho-ke, kwakheka izibopho ezingezona i-polar. Ama-athomu e-hydrogen ngalinye lidinga i-electron eyodwa yegobolondo lalo langaphandle, eligcwaliswa lapho liqukethe ama-electron amabili. Lezi zinto zabelana ngama-electron ngokulinganayo phakathi kwama-carbon nama-athomu e-hydrogen, okudala i-molecule ye-covalent engeyona i-polar.

Izibopho ze-Ionic neze-covalent phakathi kwezinto zidinga amandla ukuze ziphuke. Izibopho ze-Ionic azinamandla njenge-covalent, okunquma ukuziphatha kwazo ezinhlelweni zezinto eziphilayo. Kodwa-ke, akuzona zonke izibopho eziyizibopho ze-ionic noma ze-covalent. Izibopho ezibuthakathaka zingakheka naphakathi kwama-molecule. Izibopho ezimbili ezibuthakathaka ezenzeka njalo yizibopho ze-hydrogen kanye nokusebenzisana kwe-van der Waals. Ngaphandle kwalezi zinhlobo ezimbili zezibopho, impilo njengoba siyazi ukuthi ibingeke ibe khona. Izibopho ze-hydrogen zinikeza eziningi zezakhiwo ezibalulekile nezisekela impilo zamanzi futhi ziqinisa izakhiwo zamaprotheni ne-DNA, isakhiwo samaseli.

 Lapho izibopho ze-covalent ezi-polar eziqukethe i-hydrogen zakha, i-hydrogen kuleyo sibopho inomshaja omuhle kancane ngoba i-electron ye-hydrogen idonswa ngamandla kakhulu kwenye into futhi isuke ku-hydrogen. Ngenxa yokuthi i-hydrogen inhle kancane, izodonswa yizindleko ezimbi eziseduze. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, kwenzeka ukusebenzisana okubuthakathaka phakathi kwe-δ+ ye-hydrogen evela ku-molecule eyodwa kanye nama-molecule δ– ukushaja kwenye i-molecule enama-athomu amaningi ane-electronegative, ngokuvamile i-oxygen noma i-nitrogen, noma ngaphakathi kwe-molecule efanayo. Lokhu kusebenzisana kubizwa ngokuthi isibopho se-hydrogen. Lolu hlobo lwesibopho luvamile futhi lwenzeka njalo phakathi kwama-molecule amanzi. Izibopho ze-hydrogen ngazinye zibuthakathaka futhi ziphuka kalula; nokho, zenzeka ngamanani amakhulu kakhulu emanzini nakuma-polymer e-organic, okudala amandla amakhulu ahlanganisiwe. Izibopho ze-hydrogen nazo zinomthwalo wokuhlanganisa ndawonye i-DNA double helix.

 Njengezibopho ze-hydrogen, ukusebenzisana kwe-van der Waals kuyizinto ezibuthakathaka noma ukusebenzisana phakathi kwama-molecule. Izinto ezikhangayo ze-Van der Waals zingenzeka phakathi kwanoma yimaphi ama-molecule amabili noma ngaphezulu futhi zincike ekushintsheni okuncane kobuningi bama-electron, okungahlali kufana eduze kwe-athomu. Ukuze lezi zinto ezikhangayo zenzeke, ama-molecule kudingeka asondelane kakhulu. Lezi zibopho—kanye nezibopho ze-ionic, ze-covalent, neze-hydrogen—zinegalelo esakhiweni esinezinhlangothi ezintathu samaprotheni emaseli ethu esidingekayo ekusebenzeni kwawo okufanele.

 Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi
Isazi Semithi Yezokwelapha
Osokhemisi bemithi banesibopho sokuthuthukiswa kwemithi emisha nokuzama ukunquma indlela yokusebenza kwemithi emidala nemisha. Bahilelekile kuzo zonke izinyathelo zenqubo yokuthuthukiswa kwemithi. Izidakamizwa zingatholakala endaweni yemvelo noma zingakhiwa elabhorethri. Ezimweni eziningi, izidakamizwa ezingatholakala emvelweni zishintshwa ngamakhemikhali elabhorethri ukuze ziphephe futhi zisebenze kangcono, futhi ngezinye izikhathi izinhlobo zokwenziwa zezidakamizwa ezithatha indawo yenguqulo etholakala emvelweni.

 Ngemva kokutholwa kokuqala noma ukwenziwa komuthi, usokhemisi ube esethuthukisa umuthi, mhlawumbe awushintshe ngamakhemikhali, awuhlole ukuze abone ukuthi umuthi uyingozi yini, bese eklama izindlela zokukhiqiza kahle okukhulu. Ngemuva kwalokho, inqubo yokuthola umuthi uvunyelwe ukusetshenziswa ngabantu iyaqala. E-United States, ukuvunyelwa kwemithi kuphathwa yi-Food and Drug Administration (FDA) futhi kuhilela uchungechunge lwezivivinyo ezinkulu ezisebenzisa abantu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umuthi awuyingozi futhi uphatha kahle isimo ohlose ukuselapha. Le nqubo ivame ukuthatha iminyaka eminingana futhi idinga ukubamba iqhaza kodokotela nososayensi, ngaphezu kosokhemisi, ukuze baqedele ukuhlolwa futhi bathole ukuvunyelwa.

 Isibonelo somuthi owatholakala ekuqaleni entweni ephilayo yi-Paclitaxel, umuthi wokulwa nomdlavuza. Lo muthi watholakala egxolweni lomuthi we-yew wasePacific. Esinye isibonelo yi-aspirin, ekuqaleni eyayihlukaniswe negxolo lomuthi we-willow. Ukuthola imithi kuvame ukusho ukuhlola amakhulu amasampula ezitshalo, isikhunta, nezinye izinhlobo zokuphila ukuze kubonwe ukuthi kukhona yini i-com amakhilogremu esebenzayo ngokwebhayoloji etholakala kuzo. Ngezinye izikhathi, umuthi wendabuko unganikeza izinkomba zemithi yesimanje zokuthi ingatholakala kuphi inhlanganisela esebenzayo. Isibonelo, ukusetshenziswa kwegxolo lomuthi we-willow ukwenza umuthi kwaziwa iminyaka eyizinkulungwane, kusukela eGibhithe lasendulo. Nokho, kwaze kwaba sekupheleni kwawo-1800 lapho i-molecule ye-aspirin, eyaziwa ngokuthi i-acetylsalicylic acid, yahlanzwa futhi yathengiswa ukuze isetshenziswe ngabantu.

 Ngezinye izikhathi, imithi eyenzelwe ukusetshenziswa okukodwa itholakala inemiphumela engalindelekile evumela ukuthi le mithi isetshenziswe ngezinye izindlela ezingahlobene. Isibonelo, umuthi we-minoxidil ekuqaleni waklanywa ukwelapha umfutho wegazi ophakeme. Lapho uhlolwa kubantu, kwaphawulwa ukuthi abantu abathatha umuthi babezokhula izinwele ezintsha. Ekugcineni umuthi waklanywa kwabesilisa nabesifazane abanezinwele ezinde ukuze babuyisele izinwele ezilahlekile.

 Umsebenzi wosokhemisi wemithi ungase uhilele umsebenzi wobuphenyi, ukuhlola, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezidakamizwa, konke ngenhloso yokwenza abantu babe nempilo enhle.

chapterContent:
Izibopho ze-Covalent zakha phakathi kwama-athomu lapho abelana ngama-electron ukuze agcwalise amagobolondo awo e-valence electron. Lapho ukwabelana kwama-electron phakathi kwama-athomu kulingana, njenge-O2 (i-oxygen) noma i-CH4 (i-methane), isibopho se-covalent kuthiwa asiyona i-polar. Kodwa-ke, lapho ama-electron abelana, kodwa hhayi ngokulinganayo ngenxa yokungafani kwe-electronegativity (ukuthambekela kokuheha ama-electron), isibopho se-covalent kuthiwa siyi-polar. I-H2O (amanzi) iyisibonelo se-molecule ye-polar. Ngenxa yokuthi i-oxygen ine-electronegative kakhulu kune-hydrogen, ama-electron adonselwa emoyeni futhi kude nama-athomu e-hydrogen; ngenxa yalokho, i-athomu ye-oxygen ithola ishaja encane engemihle futhi ama-athomu e-hydrogen ngayinye athola ishaja encane engemihle. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi ama-electron asabelana, hhayi ngokulinganayo.

 I-polarity yamanzi ivumela ukwakheka kwezibopho ze-hydrogen phakathi kwama-molecule amanzi aseduze, okuholela ezicini eziningi ezihlukile ezibalulekile ekugcineni impilo. Isibonelo, amanzi ayisisombululo esihle kakhulu ngoba izibopho ze-hydrogen zivumela ama-ion namanye ama-molecule e-polar ukuthi ancibilike emanzini. Izibopho ze-hydrogen zamanzi nazo zinegalelo emandleni awo okushisa aphezulu kanye nokushisa okuphezulu kokuhwamuka, okuholela ekuzinzeni okukhulu kwezinga lokushisa. Ukwakheka kwesibopho se-hydrogen kwenza iqhwa lingaqini njengeliqinile kuneliketshezi, okuvikela izindawo zasemanzini. Izakhiwo zamanzi ezihlangene nezinamathelayo zibonakala njengoba zikhuphuka ngaphakathi kwamapayipi e-capillary noma zihamba zikhuphukela esihlahleni esikhulu zisuka ezimpandeni ziye emaqabunga. Ukuhlushwa kwe-pH noma i-hydrogen ion yesisombululo kulawulwa kakhulu ukusiza izinto eziphilayo zigcine i-homeostasis; isibonelo, njengoba kuzohlolwa ezahlukweni ezilandelayo, ama-enzyme avuselela ukusabela kwamakhemikhali okuningi kumaseli aqondene ne-pH. Ngakho-ke, izakhiwo zamanzi zixhunywe ezinqubweni ze-biochemical kanye nezomzimba ezenziwa izinto eziphilayo. Ukuphila Emhlabeni bekuyohluka kakhulu uma lezi zakhiwo bezishintshwa—ukube impilo ibingaba khona nhlobo.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe kulesi sigaba zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 ye-AP® Biology Curriculum. Izinhloso Zokufunda ezibalwe ku-Curriculum Framework zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso Yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu weMikhuba Yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Umqondo Omkhulu 2

 Kungani ososayensi bechitha isikhathi befuna amanzi kwamanye amaplanethi? Kungani amanzi ebaluleke kangaka? Kungenxa yokuthi amanzi abalulekile empilweni njengoba siwazi. Amanzi angenye yama-molecule amaningi futhi abaluleke kakhulu empilweni eMhlabeni. Cishe amaphesenti angama-60-70 omzimba womuntu wenziwe ngamanzi. Ngaphandle kwawo, impilo njengoba siwazi ngabe ayikho.

 Ukuhlangana kwe-molecule yamanzi kanye nokuhlangana kwayo kwe-hydrogen okubangelwa yiyo kwenza amanzi abe yinto ehlukile enezakhiwo ezikhethekile ezixhumene kakhulu nezinqubo zokuphila. Ukuphila kwaqala ukuvela endaweni enamanzi, futhi iningi le-chemistry yamaseli ezinto eziphilayo kanye ne-metabolism kwenzeka ngaphakathi kokuqukethwe kwamanzi kwe-cytoplasm yeseli. Izakhiwo ezikhethekile zamanzi amandla awo okushisa aphezulu kanye nokushisa kokuhwamuka, ikhono lawo lokuncibilikisa ama-molecule e-polar, izakhiwo zawo ezihlangene nezinamathelayo, kanye nokuhlukana kwawo abe ama-ion okuholela ekukhiqizweni kwe-pH. Ukuqonda lezi zici zamanzi kusiza ekucaciseni ukubaluleka kwawo ekugcineni impilo.

chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.2 Water | Water’s Polarity
chapterContent:
Esinye sezimpawu ezibalulekile zamanzi ukuthi akhiwe ngama-molecule e-polar: i-hydrogen kanye ne-oxygen ngaphakathi kwama-molecule amanzi (H2O) kwakha izibopho ze-polar covalent. Nakuba kungekho charge eqondile ku-molecule yamanzi, i-polarity yamanzi idala i-charge encane ku-hydrogen kanye ne-charge encane engemihle ku-oxygen, okufaka isandla ezimpahleni zamanzi zokukhanga. Izindleko zamanzi zikhiqizwa ngoba i-oxygen ine-electronegative kakhulu kune-hydrogen, okwenza kube lula ukuthi i-electron ehlanganyelwe itholakale eduze kwe-nucleus ye-oxygen kune-nucleus ye-hydrogen, ngaleyo ndlela ikhiqize i-charge encane engemihle eduze kwe-oxygen.

 Ngenxa ye-polarity yamanzi, i-molecule ngayinye yamanzi idonsela amanye ama-molecule amanzi ngenxa yezindleko eziphambene phakathi kwama-molecule amanzi, okwenza izibopho ze-hydrogen. Amanzi futhi adonsela noma akhangwa amanye ama-molecule e-polar nama-ion. Into e-polar exhumana kalula noma encibilika emanzini ibizwa ngokuthi i-hydrophilic (hydro- = water”; -philic = loving”). Ngokuphambene nalokho, ama-molecule angewona ama-polar afana namafutha namafutha awasebenzisani kahle namanzi, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.14 futhi ahlukana nawo kunokuba ancibilike kuwo, njengoba sibona kuma-dressing esaladi aqukethe uwoyela noviniga (isixazululo samanzi esi-acid). Lawa ma-com angewona ama-polar amakhilogremu abizwa ngokuthi i-hydrophobic (hydro- = amanzi”; -phobic = ukwesaba”)

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Samakhemikhali Sokuphila | 2.2 Amanzi | Izimo Zamanzi: Igesi, Uketshezi, Nokuqinile
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.2 Water | Water’s States: Gas, Liquid, and Solid
chapterContent:
Ukwakheka kwezibopho ze-hydrogen kuyikhwalithi ebalulekile yamanzi aketshezi ebalulekile empilweni njengoba sazi. Njengoba ama-molecule amanzi enza izibopho ze-hydrogen komunye nomunye, amanzi athola izici ezithile zamakhemikhali ezihlukile uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye iziphuzo futhi, njengoba izinto eziphilayo zinokuqukethwe kwamanzi amaningi, ukuqonda lezi zici zamakhemikhali kuyisihluthulelo sokuqonda impilo. Emanzini aketshezi, izibopho ze-hydrogen zihlala zakhiwa futhi ziqhekeka njengoba ama-molecule amanzi eshelelana. Ukuqhekeka kwalezi zibopho kubangelwa ukunyakaza (amandla e-kinetic) kwama-molecule amanzi ngenxa yokushisa okuqukethwe ohlelweni. Lapho ukushisa kuphakanyiswa njengoba amanzi ebiliswa, amandla aphezulu e-kinetic ama-molecule amanzi abangela ukuthi izibopho ze-hydrogen ziqhekeke ngokuphelele futhi avumele ama-molecule amanzi ukuba abalekele emoyeni njengegesi (umusi noma umhwamuko wamanzi). Ngakolunye uhlangothi, lapho izinga lokushisa lamanzi lincipha futhi amanzi eqanda, ama-molecule amanzi akha isakhiwo sekristalu esigcinwa yizibopho ze-hydrogen (akukho mandla anele okuphula izibopho ze-hydrogen) okwenza iqhwa lingabi likhulu kunamanzi aketshezi, into engabonakali ekuqineni kwezinye iziphuzo.

 Ubuningi obuphansi bamanzi ngesimo sawo esiqinile bubangelwa indlela izibopho ze-hydrogen eziqondiswa ngayo njengoba ziqina: ama-molecule amanzi asunduzelwa kude uma kuqhathaniswa namanzi aqinile. Ngezinye izinto eziningi ezimanzi, ukuqina lapho izinga lokushisa lehla kuhlanganisa ukwehla kwamandla e-kinetic phakathi kwama-molecule, okuwavumela ukuthi apakishe ngokuqinile kakhulu kunasesimo soketshezi futhi anikeze okuqinile ubukhulu obukhulu kunoketshezi.

 Ubuningi obuphansi beqhwa, obuboniswe futhi obufanekiswe kuMfanekiso 2.15, kuyinto engavamile, ibangela ukuthi lintante ebusweni bamanzi aqinile, njengaseqhweni noma kuma-cubes eqhwa engilazini yamanzi eqhwa. Emachibini nasemachibini, iqhwa lizokwakheka phezu kwamanzi lidale isithiyo sokuvikela izilwane kanye nokuphila kwezitshalo echibini ekubeni ziqine. Ngaphandle kwalolu ngqimba lweqhwa elivikelayo, izitshalo nezilwane ezihlala echibini zingaqina eqhweni eliqinile futhi azikwazi ukusinda. Umphumela omubi wokuqina ezintweni eziphilayo ubangelwa ukwanda kweqhwa uma kuqhathaniswa namanzi aqinile. Amakristalu eqhwa akheka lapho eqandisiwe aphula ulwelwesi olubucayi olubalulekile ekusebenzeni kwamaseli aphilayo, awonakalise ngokungenakulungiseka. Amaseli angasinda kuphela eqandisiwe uma amanzi akuwo ethathelwa indawo okwesikhashana olunye uketshezi olufana ne-glycerol.

chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.2 Water | Water’s High Heat Capacity
chapterContent: Umthamo wokushisa ophezulu wamanzi uyisici esibangelwa ukubopha kwe-hydrogen phakathi kwama-molecule amanzi. Amanzi anamandla okushisa aphezulu kunanoma yiluphi uketshezi. Ukushisa okukhethekile kuchazwa njengomthamo wokushisa igremu elilodwa lento okumele limunce noma lilahlekelwe ukushintsha izinga lokushisa layo nge-degree Celsius eyodwa. Ngamanzi, leli nani liyikhalori elilodwa. Ngakho-ke kuthatha amanzi isikhathi eside ukushisa kanye nesikhathi eside ukupholisa. Eqinisweni, umthamo wokushisa othize wamanzi cishe uphindwe kahlanu kunesihlabathi. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi kungani umhlaba uphola ngokushesha kunolwandle. Ngenxa yomthamo wawo wokushisa ophezulu, amanzi asetshenziswa yizilwane ezinegazi elifudumele ukusabalalisa ukushisa ngokulinganayo emizimbeni yazo: asebenza ngendlela efanayo nohlelo lokupholisa lwemoto, athutha ukushisa kusuka ezindaweni ezifudumele kuya ezindaweni ezipholile, okwenza umzimba ugcine izinga lokushisa lilingana kakhulu.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Samakhemikhali Sokuphila | 2.2 Amanzi | Ukushisa Kwamanzi Okuhwamuka
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.2 Water | Water’s Heat of Vaporization
chapterContent:
Amanzi nawo anokushisa okuphezulu kokuhwamuka, inani lamandla adingekayo ukushintsha igremu elilodwa lento ewuketshezi ibe yigesi. Kudingeka inani elikhulu lamandla okushisa (586 cal) ukuze kufezwe lolu shintsho emanzini. Le nqubo yenzeka ebusweni bamanzi. Njengoba amanzi oketshezi eshisa, ukubopha kwe-hydrogen kwenza kube nzima ukuhlukanisa ama-molecule amanzi oketshezi komunye nomunye, okudingekayo ukuze angene esigabeni sawo segesi (umusi). Ngenxa yalokho, amanzi asebenza njengesinki sokushisa noma indawo yokugcina ukushisa futhi adinga ukushisa okuningi ukuze abilise kunoketshezi olufana ne-ethanol, olukubopha kwe-hydrogen namanye ama-molecule e-ethanol kubuthakathaka kunokubopha kwe-hydrogen kwamanzi. Ekugcineni, njengoba amanzi efika endaweni yawo yokubila engu-100° Celsius (212° Fahrenheit), ukushisa kuyakwazi ukuphula izibopho ze-hydrogen phakathi kwama-molecule amanzi, futhi amandla e-kinetic (ukunyakaza) phakathi kwama-molecule amanzi awavumela ukuba aphume oketshezini njengegesi. Ngisho nalapho engaphansi kwendawo yawo yokubila, ama-molecule amanzi ngamanye athola amandla anele kwamanye ama-molecule amanzi kangangokuthi amanye ama-molecule amanzi angaphezulu angabaleka futhi aphele: le nqubo yaziwa ngokuthi ukuhwamuka.

 Iqiniso lokuthi izibopho ze-hydrogen kudingeka ziphulwe ukuze amanzi aphele lisho ukuthi kusetshenziswa inani elikhulu lamandla kule nqubo. Njengoba amanzi ephela, amandla athathwa yile nqubo, apholise indawo lapho kwenzeka khona ukuphehla. Ezintweni eziningi eziphilayo, okuhlanganisa nabantu, ukuphehla kokujuluka, okungamaphesenti angama-90 amanzi, kuvumela izinto eziphilayo ukuthi ziphole ukuze kugcinwe i-homeostasis yokushisa komzimba.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Samakhemikhali Sokuphila | 2.2 Amanzi | Izakhiwo Ze-solvent Zamanzi
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.2 Water | Water’s Solvent Properties
chapterContent:
Njengoba amanzi eyi-molecule ye-polar enamacala amancane amahle nalancane amabi, ama-ion nama-molecule e-polar angancibilika kalula kuwo. Ngakho-ke, amanzi abizwa ngokuthi i-solvent, into ekwazi ukuncibilikisa amanye ama-molecule e-polar kanye ne-ionic com amakhilogremu. Amacala ahlobene nala ma-molecule azokwakha izibopho ze-hydrogen namanzi, azungeze inhlayiya ngama-molecule amanzi. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-sphere of hydration, noma igobolondo le-hydration, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 2.16 futhi kusebenza ukugcina izinhlayiya zihlukene noma zihlakazeke emanzini.

 Lapho i-ionic com amakhilogremu ingezwa emanzini, ama-ion ngamanye asabela nezifunda ze-polar zama-molecule amanzi futhi izibopho zawo ze-ionic ziyaphazamiseka enkambisweni yokuhlukana. Ukuhlukana kwenzeka lapho ama-athomu noma amaqembu ama-athomu ehlukana nama-molecule futhi akha ama-ion. Cabanga ngosawoti wetafula (i-NaCl, noma i-sodium chloride): lapho amakristalu e-NaCl engezwa emanzini, ama-molecule e-NaCl ahlukana abe yi-Na+ kanye ne-Cl– ama-ion, kanye nama-sphere of hydration akheka azungeze ama-ion, aboniswe ku-Figure 2.16. I-ion ye-sodium eshajwe kahle izungezwe yi-charge engemihle ngokwengxenye ye-oxygen ye-molecule yamanzi. I-ion ye-chloride eshajwe kabi izungezwe yi-charge engemihle ngokwengxenye ye-hydrogen e-molecule yamanzi.

chapterContent:
Wake wagcwalisa ingilazi yamanzi phezulu bese wengeza kancane kancane amaconsi ambalwa? Ngaphambi kokuba agcwale, amanzi akha isimo esifana nedome ngaphezu komphetho wengilazi. Lawa manzi angahlala ngaphezu kwengilazi ngenxa yesakhiwo sokubumbana. Ekubumbaneni, ama-molecule amanzi ayakhangana (ngenxa yokubopha i-hydrogen), egcina ama-molecule ndawonye endaweni yokuxhumana yegesi eliwuketshezi (amanzi nomoya), yize kungekho ndawo engilazini.

 Ukuhlangana kuvumela ukuthuthukiswa kokucindezeleka kobuso, amandla ento ethile okumelana nokuqhekeka lapho ibekwa ngaphansi kokucindezeleka noma ukucindezeleka. Yingakho futhi amanzi akha amaconsi lapho ebekwa endaweni eyomile kunokuba acwecwe amandla adonsela phansi. Lapho isiqephu esincane sephepha sibekwa phezu kweconsi lamanzi, iphepha liyantanta phezu kweconsi lamanzi yize iphepha liqinile (lisinda) kunamanzi. Ukuhlangana kanye nokucindezeleka kobuso kugcina izibopho ze-hydrogen zama-molecule amanzi zingashintshi futhi zisekele into entanta phezulu. Kungenzeka ngisho nokuntanta inaliti phezu kwengilazi yamanzi uma ibekwa kahle ngaphandle kokwephula ukucindezeleka kobuso, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.17.

 Lawa mandla ahlangene ahlobene nempahla yamanzi yokunamathela, noma ukukhangana phakathi kwama-molecule amanzi namanye ama-molecule. Lokhu kukhangana ngezinye izikhathi kunamandla kunamandla ahlangene amanzi, ikakhulukazi lapho amanzi evezwa ezindaweni ezishajiwe njengalezo ezitholakala ngaphakathi kwamapayipi amancane engilazi aziwa ngokuthi amapayipi e-capillary. Ukunamathela kuyabonwa lapho amanzi ekhuphuka” ipayipi elibekwe engilazini yamanzi: qaphela ukuthi amanzi abonakala ephakeme ezinhlangothini zepayipi kunaphakathi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ama-molecule amanzi akhangwa odongeni lwengilazi olushajiwe lwe-capillary ngaphezu kokuba ethandana ngakho-ke anamathela kulo. Lolu hlobo lokunamathela lubizwa ngokuthi isenzo se-capillary, futhi luboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.18.

 Kungani amandla ahlangene nanamathelayo ebalulekile empilweni? Amandla ahlangene nanamathelayo abalulekile ekuthuthweni kwamanzi kusuka ezimpandeni kuya emaqabunga ezitshalweni. La mandla adala ukudonsa” ekholomu yamanzi. Lokhu kudonsa kuvela ekuthambekeleni kwama-molecule amanzi ahwamuka ebusweni besitshalo ukuze ahlale exhunywe kuma-molecule amanzi angaphansi kwawo, ngakho-ke ayadonswa. Izitshalo zisebenzisa lesi simo semvelo ukusiza ukuthutha amanzi kusuka ezimpandeni zawo aye emaqabunga azo. Ngaphandle kwalezi zakhiwo zamanzi, izitshalo bezingeke zikwazi ukwamukela amanzi kanye namaminerali ancibilikisiwe eziwadingayo. Kwesinye isibonelo, izinambuzane ezifana ne-water strider, eboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.19, zisebenzisa ukucindezeleka kwamanzi ukuze zihlale zintanta phezu kongqimba lwamanzi futhi zize zihlangane lapho.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Samakhemikhali Sokuphila | 2.2 Amanzi | i-pH, ama-Buffer, ama-Acid, kanye nezisekelo
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.2 Water | pH, Buffers, Acids, and Bases
chapterContent:
I-pH yesisombululo ikhombisa ubumuncu noma ubumuncu bayo.

 I-H2O(l)↔H+⁡(a⁢q)+OH-⁢(a⁢q)
Iphepha le-Litmus noma le-pH liyiphepha lokuhlunga eliphathwe ngodayi wemvelo oncibilika emanzini ngakho lingasetshenziswa njengesibonisi se-pH ukuhlola ukuthi ingakanani i-asidi (i-asidi) noma isisekelo (isisekelo) esikhona esixazululweni. Ungase usebenzise amanye ukuhlola ukuthi amanzi asechibini lokubhukuda aphathwe kahle yini. Kuzo zombili izimo, ukuhlolwa kwe-pH kulinganisa ukuhlushwa kwama-ion e-hydrogen esixazululweni esithile.

 Ama-ion e-hydrogen akhiqizwa ngokuzenzekelayo emanzini ahlanzekile ngokuhlukaniswa (i-ionization) kwephesenti elincane lama-molecule amanzi abe yinani elilinganayo lama-ion e-hydrogen (H+) nama-ion e-hydroxide (OH-). Ngenkathi ama-ion e-hydroxide egcinwa esixazululweni ngokuhlangana kwawo ne-hydrogen namanye ama-molecule amanzi, ama-ion e-hydrogen, akhiwa ama-proton angenalutho, adonseleka ngokushesha kuma-molecule amanzi ahlanganisiwe, akha ama-ion e-hydronium (H30+). Noma kunjalo, ngokwesiko, ososayensi babhekisela kuma-ion e-hydrogen kanye nokuhlushwa kwawo njengokungathi akhululekile kulesi simo emanzini ahlanzekile.

 Ukuhlushwa kwama-ion e-hydrogen ahlukana namanzi ahlanzekile kungama-ion angu-1 × 10-7 ama-moles H+ ngelitha lamanzi. Ama-Moles (mol) ayindlela yokuveza inani lento (engaba ama-athomu, ama-molecule, ama-ion, njll.), kanti i-mole eyodwa ilingana nezinhlayiya ezingu-6.02 × 1023 zale nto. Ngakho-ke, i-mole eyodwa yamanzi ilingana nama-molecule amanzi angu-6.02 × 1023. I-pH ibalwa njenge-negative ye-base 10 logarithm yalokhu kuhlushwa. I-log10 ka-1 × 10-7 ingu--7.0, kanti i-negative yale nombolo (ekhonjiswe yi-p” ye-pH) iveza i-pH engu-7.0, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-pH engathathi hlangothi. I-pH engaphakathi kwamangqamuzana omuntu negazi yizibonelo zezindawo ezimbili zomzimba lapho i-pH eseduze ne-neutral igcinwa khona.

 Ukufundwa kwe-pH okungathathi hlangothi kuvela ekuncibilikiseni ama-acid noma izisekelo emanzini. Ukusebenzisa i-logarithm engalungile ukukhiqiza izinombolo ezinhle, ukugxila okuphezulu kwama-ion e-hydrogen kuveza inombolo ephansi ye-pH, kanti amazinga aphansi ama-ion e-hydrogen abangela i-pH ephezulu. I-asidi yinto ekhulisa ukugxila kwama-ion e-hydrogen (H+) esixazululweni, ngokuvamile ngokuba ne-athomu yayo ye-hydrogen ihlukane. Isisekelo sinikeza ama-ion e-hydroxide (OH–) noma amanye ama-ion ashajeke kabi ahlangana nama-ion e-hydrogen, anciphisa ukugxila kwawo esixazululweni futhi ngaleyo ndlela aphakamise i-pH. Ezimweni lapho isisekelo sikhipha ama-ion e-hydroxide, lawa ma-ion abopha kuma-ion e-hydrogen akhululekile, akhiqize ama-molecule amanzi amasha.

 Uma i-asidi iqina, kulapho inikela kalula khona i-H+. Isibonelo, i-hydrochloric acid (HCl) ihlukana ngokuphelele ibe ama-ion e-hydrogen ne-chloride futhi ine-acid ephezulu, kanti ama-acid kujusi katamatisi noma kuviniga awahlukani ngokuphelele futhi abhekwa njengama-acid abuthakathaka. Ngokuphambene nalokho, izisekelo eziqinile yilezo zinto ezinikela kalula i-OH– noma ezithatha ama-ion e-hydrogen. I-Sodium hydroxide (NaOH) kanye nabahlanzi abaningi basekhaya bane-alkaline kakhulu futhi bakhipha i-OH– ngokushesha uma befakwa emanzini, ngaleyo ndlela bakhuphule i-pH. Isibonelo sesisombululo esiyisisekelo esibuthakathaka amanzi olwandle, ane-pH eseduze no-8.0, asondele ngokwanele ku-pH engathathi hlangothi ukuthi izinto eziphilayo zasolwandle ezivumelaniswe nale ndawo enosawoti ziyakwazi ukukhula kuyo.

 Isikali se-pH, njengoba kushiwo ngaphambili, siyi-logarithm ephambene futhi sisukela ku-0 kuya ku-14 (Isithombe 2.20). Noma yini engaphansi kuka-7.0 (kusukela ku-0.0 kuya ku-6.9) ine-acidic, kanti noma yini engaphezu kuka-7.0 (kusukela ku-7.1 kuya ku-14.0) ine-alkaline. Ukweqisa kwe-pH kunoma iyiphi indlela kusukela ku-7.0 kuvame ukubhekwa njengokungafaneleki empilweni. I-pH engaphakathi kwamaseli (6.8) kanye ne-pH egazini (7.4) kokubili kuseduze kakhulu nokungathathi hlangothi. Kodwa-ke, indawo esiswini ine-acidic kakhulu, ene-pH engu-1 kuya ku-2. Ngakho-ke amaseli esiswini asinda kanjani endaweni ene-acidic kangaka? Agcina kanjani i-pH eseduze nokungathathi hlangothi ngaphakathi kwawo? Impendulo iwukuthi awakwazi ukukwenza futhi ahlala efa. Amaseli amasha esiswini akhiqizwa njalo ukuze athathe indawo yabafileyo, agaywa yi-acid yesisu. Kulinganiselwa ukuthi ulwelwesi lwesisu somuntu lushintshwa ngokuphelele njalo ezinsukwini eziyisikhombisa kuya kweziyishumi.

 Ngakho-ke izinto eziphilayo ezidinga i-pH eseduze nokungathathi hlangothi zingadla kanjani izinto ezine-acidic neziyisisekelo (isibonelo, umuntu ephuza ujusi wewolintshi) futhi zisinde? Ama-buffer ayisihluthulelo. Ama-buffer amunca kalula i-H+ noma i-OH– eningi, egcina i-pH yomzimba igcinwe ngokucophelela ebangeni elincane elidingekayo ukuze umuntu asinde. Ukugcina i-pH yegazi engaguquki kubalulekile enhlalakahleni yomuntu. I-buffer egcina i-pH yegazi lomuntu ihilela i-carbonic acid (H2CO3), i-bicarbonate ion (HCO3–), kanye ne-carbon dioxide (CO2). Lapho ama-ion e-bicarbonate ehlangana nama-ion e-hydrogen amahhala futhi eba yi-carbonic acid, ama-ion e-hydrogen ayasuswa, okunciphisa izinguquko ze-pH. Ngokufanayo, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.21, i-carbonic acid eningi ingaguqulwa ibe yigesi ye-carbon dioxide bese ikhishwa ngamaphaphu. Lokhu kuvimbela ama-ion amaningi e-hydrogen amahhala ukuthi aqongeleleke egazini futhi kunciphise i-pH yegazi ngendlela eyingozi. Ngokufanayo, uma i-OH– eningi kakhulu ingeniswa ohlelweni, i-carbonic acid izohlangana nayo ukuze idale i-bicarbonate, yehlise i-pH. Ngaphandle kwalolu hlelo lwe-buffer, i-pH yomzimba izoshintshashintsha ngokwanele ukubeka ukusinda engozini.

 Ezinye izibonelo zama-buffer yimithi elwa nama-acid asetshenziselwa ukulwa ne-asidi eningi esiswini. Eminingi yale mithi ethengiswa ngaphandle kwemithi kadokotela isebenza ngendlela efanayo nemithi elwa nama-blood buffer, ngokuvamile ene-ion eyodwa okungenani ekwazi ukumunca i-hydrogen nokulinganisela i-pH, iletha impumuzo kulabo abahlushwa isilungulela ngemva kokudla. Izakhiwo ezihlukile zamanzi ezifaka isandla kuleli khono lokulinganisela i-pH—kanye nezinye izici zamanzi—zibalulekile ekusekeleni ukuphila eMhlabeni.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Sekhemikhali Yokuphila | 2.3 Ikhabhoni | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.3 Carbon | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Izakhiwo eziyingqayizivele zekhabhoni ziyenza ibe yingxenye ebalulekile yama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo. Ngama-electron amane e-valence, ikhabhoni ingahlangana nomoya-mpilo, i-hydrogen, kanye ne-nitrogen ukuze yakhe ama-molecule amaningi abalulekile ekusebenzeni kwamaseli. Ikhabhoni ne-hydrogen kungakha amaketanga noma amasongo e-hydrocarbon. Amaqembu asebenzayo, njenge--CH3 (methyl) kanye ne--COOH (carboxyl), amaqembu ama-athomu anikeza izakhiwo ezithile kumaketanga noma amasongo e-hydrocarbon achaza izici zawo zamakhemikhali kanye nomsebenzi wawo. Isibonelo, ukunamathela kweqembu le-carboxyl (-COOH) kwenza i-molecule ibe ne-acidic eningi, kanti ukuba khona kweqembu le-amine (NH2) kwenza i-molecule ibe lula kakhulu. (Njengoba sizohlola esahlukweni esilandelayo, ama-amino acid anamaqembu e-carboxyl kanye neqembu le-amine.) Ama-isomer angama-molecule anefomula efanayo yama-molecule (okungukuthi, izinhlobo ezifanayo nezinombolo zama-athomu), kodwa izakhiwo ezahlukene zama-molecule eziholela ezimpahleni noma emisebenzini ehlukene. (Ungadidanisi i-isomer” ne-isotope”!)

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe kulesi sigaba zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 2 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekubuzeni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. Inhloso yokufunda ihlanganisa okuqukethwe okudingekayo nomunye noma ngaphezulu kwemikhuba yesayensi eyisikhombisa.

 Inhloso enkulu 2
Izinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo zisebenzisa amandla amahhala kanye namabhlogo okwakha ama-molecule ukuze zikhule, zizale, futhi zilondoloze i-homeostasis enamandla.

 Ukuqonda Okuhlala Njalo 2.A
Ukukhula, ukuzala kanye nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo eziphilayo kudinga amandla amahhala kanye nezinto.

 Ulwazi Olubalulekile
2.A.3 Izinto eziphilayo kumele zishintshanise izinto nendawo ezikuyo ukuze zikhule, zizale futhi zilondoloze ukuhleleka.

 Isayensi Yokuzijwayeza
4.1 Umfundi angathethelela ukukhethwa kohlobo lwedatha edingekayo ukuphendula umbuzo othile wesayensi.

 Inhloso Yokufunda
2.8 Umfundi uyakwazi ukuthethelela ukukhethwa kwedatha mayelana nezinhlobo zama-molecule isilwane, isitshalo, noma i-bacterium ezizowathatha njengezithako zokwakha ezidingekayo futhi zikhishwe njengemikhiqizo yemfucuza.

 Amaseli enziwe ngama-molecule amaningi ayinkimbinkimbi abizwa ngokuthi ama-macromolecule, njengeprotheni, ama-nucleic acid (i-RNA ne-DNA), ama-carbohydrate, nama-lipid. Ama-macromolecule ayiqoqo lama-molecule e-organic (noma yiluphi uketshezi oluqukethe i-carbon, okuqinile, noma igesi) olubaluleke kakhulu empilweni. Ingxenye eyisisekelo yawo wonke la ma-macromolecule yi-carbon. I-athomu yekhabhoni inezakhiwo ezihlukile ezivumela ukuthi yakhe izibopho ze-covalent kuma-athomu amaningi ahlukene amane, okwenza lesi sakhi esiguquguqukayo sibe yindawo efanelekile yokusebenza njengesakhi esiyisisekelo sesakhiwo, noma umgogodla,” wama-macromolecule.

 Ama-athomu ekhabhoni ngamanye anegobolondo le-electron elingaphandle elingaphelele. Ngenombolo ye-athomu engu-6 (ama-electron ayisithupha nama-proton ayisithupha), ama-electron amabili okuqala agcwalisa igobolondo elingaphakathi, ashiye amane egobolondo lesibili. Ngakho-ke, ama-athomu ekhabhoni angakha izibopho ze-covalent ezifika kwezine namanye ama-athomu ukuze anelise umthetho we-octet. I-molecule ye-methane inikeza isibonelo: inefomula yamakhemikhali i-CH4. I-athomu ngayinye ye-hydrogen yayo emine yakha isibopho esisodwa se-covalent ne-athomu yekhabhoni ngokwabelana ngama-electron amabili. Lokhu kuphumela egobolondo elingaphandle eligcwele

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Samakhemikhali Sokuphila | 2.3 I-Carbon | Ama-Hydrocarbon
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.3 Carbon | Hydrocarbons
chapterContent:
Ama-hydrocarbon angama-molecule e-organic aqukethe ikhabhoni ne-hydrogen kuphela, njenge-methane (CH4) echazwe ngenhla. Sivame ukusebenzisa ama-hydrocarbon empilweni yethu yansuku zonke njengamafutha—njenge-propane ku-gas grill noma i-butane ku-lighter. Izibopho eziningi ze-covalent phakathi kwama-athomu kuma-hydrocarbon zigcina inani elikhulu lamandla, elikhishwa lapho la ma-molecule eshiswa (e-oxidized). I-Methane, uphethiloli omuhle kakhulu, iyi-molecule ye-hydrocarbon elula kakhulu, ene-athomu yekhabhoni ephakathi ehlanganiswe nama-athomu amane e-hydrogen ahlukene, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.23. I-geometry ye-molecule ye-methane, lapho ama-athomu ehlala khona ngezinga ezintathu, inqunywa ukuma kwama-electron orbitals ayo. Ama-carbon nama-athomu amane e-hydrogen akha isimo esaziwa ngokuthi i-tetrahedron, enobuso obune obungunxantathu; ngenxa yalesi sizathu, i-methane ichazwa njenge-geometry ye-tetrahedral.

 Njengomgogodla wama-molecule amakhulu ezinto eziphilayo, ama-hydrocarbon angaba khona njengezintambo zekhabhoni eziqondile, izindandatho zekhabhoni, noma inhlanganisela yakho kokubili. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibopho zekhabhoni-nekhabhoni ngazinye zingaba izibopho ze-covalent eyodwa, ezimbili, noma ezintathu, futhi uhlobo ngalunye lwesibopho luthinta i-geometry ye-molecule ngendlela ethile. Lesi simo noma ukwakheka kwama-molecule amakhulu okuphila (ama-macromolecule) kubalulekile ekusebenzeni kwawo.

chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.3 Carbon | Hydrocarbons | Hydrocarbon Chains
chapterContent: Amaketanga e-hydrocarbon akhiwa yizibopho ezilandelanayo phakathi kwama-athomu e-carbon futhi angase ahlukaniswe noma angahlukaniswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-geometry iyonke ye-molecule ishintshwa yi-geometries ehlukene yezibopho ze-covalent eyodwa, ezimbili, kanye nezintathu, eziboniswe ku-Figure 2.24. Ama-hydrocarbons i-ethane, i-ethene, kanye ne-ethyne asebenza njengezibonelo zendlela izibopho ze-carbon-to-carbon ezahlukene ezithinta ngayo i-geometry ye-molecule. Amagama awo wonke ama-molecule amathathu aqala ngesiqalo esithi eth-,” okuyisiqalo sama-carbon hydrocarbon amabili. Izijobelelo -ane,” -ene,” kanye no--yne” zibhekisela ekubeni khona kwezibopho ze-carbon-carbon eyodwa, ezimbili, noma ezintathu, ngokulandelana. Ngakho-ke, i-propane, i-propene, ne-propyne zilandela iphethini efanayo nama-molecule amathathu e-carbon, i-butane, i-butene, ne-butyne kuma-molecule amane e-carbon, njalo njalo. Izibopho ze-Double and triple zishintsha i-geometry ye-molecule: izibopho ze-single zivumela ukujikeleza eceleni kwe-axis yesibopho, kanti izibopho ze-double ziholela ekumisweni kwe-planar kanye nezibopho ze-triple zibe yi-linear. Lezi zibalo zinomthelela omkhulu ekwakhekeni i-molecule ethile engayithatha.

chapterContent: Kuze kube manje, ama-hydrocarbon esixoxe ngawo abe yi-aliphatic hydrocarbons, aqukethe amaketanga aqondile ama-athomu e-carbon, futhi ngezinye izikhathi angakha amasongo anazo zonke izibopho ezilodwa, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.25 ezibonelweni ze-cyclopentane ne-cyclohexane. Olunye uhlobo lwe-hydrocarbon, ama-hydrocarbon aromatic, luqukethe amasongo avaliwe ama-athomu e-carbon anezibopho ezilodwa nezimbili ezishintshanayo. Sithola izakhiwo zendandatho kuma-hydrocarbon e-aliphatic, aqukethe izibopho ezilodwa kuphela phakathi kwama-carbon, njengesakhiwo se-cyclohexanes (aliphatic) uma kuqhathaniswa nesakhiwo sendandatho se-benzene (aromatic) esinezibopho ezilodwa nezimbili ezishintshanayo endandatho kuMfanekiso 2.25. Izibonelo zama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo afaka indandatho ye-benzene zifaka phakathi ama-amino acid kanye ne-cholesterol kanye nezinto eziphuma kuyo, okuhlanganisa ama-hormone i-estrogen ne-testosterone. Siphinde sithole indandatho ye-benzene ku-herbicide 2,4-D. I-Benzene iyisakhi semvelo samafutha aluhlaza futhi ihlukaniswe njenge-carcinogen. Amanye ama-hydrocarbon anezingxenye ezimbili ze-aliphatic kanye ne-aromatic. I-Beta-carotene iyisibonelo se-hydrocarbon enjalo

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Samakhemikhali Sokuphila | 2.3 I-Carbon | Ama-Isomers
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.3 Carbon | Isomers
chapterContent:
Ukubekwa kwama-athomu nezibopho zamakhemikhali ngaphakathi kwama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo kubalulekile ekuqondeni ikhemikhali yawo. Ama-molecule abelana ngefomula efanayo yamakhemikhali kodwa ahlukile ekubekweni (esakhiweni) kwama-athomu awo kanye/noma izibopho zamakhemikhali aziwa ngokuthi ama-isomers. Ama-isomers esakhiwo (njenge-butane ne-isobutane eboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.26.a) ahlukile ekubekweni kwezibopho zawo ze-covalent: womabili ama-molecule anama-carbon amane nama-hydrogen ayishumi (C4H10), kodwa ukuhlelwa okuhlukile kwama-athomu ngaphakathi kwama-molecule kuholela ekwehlukeni kwezakhiwo zawo zamakhemikhali. Isibonelo, ngenxa yezakhiwo zawo zamakhemikhali ezahlukene, i-butane ifanele ukusetshenziswa njengophethiloli wezibani, kanti i-isobutane ifanele ukusetshenziswa njengesiqandisi kanye ne-propellant kuma-spray can.

 Ama-isomers e-geometric, ngakolunye uhlangothi, anokubekwa okufanayo kwezibopho zawo ze-covalent kodwa ahlukile endleleni lezi zibopho ezenziwe ngayo kuma-athomu azungezile, ikakhulukazi ezibophweni ezimbili ze-carbon-to-carbon. Ku-butene elula ye-molecule (C4H8), amaqembu amabili e-methyl (CH3) angaba kuzo zombili izinhlangothi zesibopho esiphindwe kabili esiphakathi kwe-molecule, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 2.26.b. Lapho ama-carbon eboshwe ohlangothini olufanayo lwesibopho esiphindwe kabili, lokhu kuyilungiselelo le-cis; uma ezinhlangothini eziphambene zesibopho esiphindwe kabili, kuyilungiselelo le-trans. Ekulungiselelweni kwe-trans, ama-carbon akha isakhiwo esicishe sibe yi-linear, kuyilapho ama-carbon ekulungiselelweni kwe-cis enza ukugoba (ukushintsha indlela) komgogodla we-carbon.

 Kuma-triglycerides (amafutha namafutha), izintambo ze-carbon ezinde ezaziwa ngokuthi ama-fatty acids zingase zibe nezibopho eziphindwe kabili, ezingaba kulungiselelo lwe-cis noma lwe-trans, oluboniswe ku-Figure 2.27. Amafutha anesibopho esiphindwe kabili okungenani esisodwa phakathi kwama-athomu e-carbon angamafutha angagcwalisiwe. Uma ezinye zalezi zibopho zikulungiselelo lwe-cis, ukugoba okubangelwayo kumgogodla we-carbon we-chain kusho ukuthi ama-molecule e-triglyceride awakwazi ukupakisha kahle, ngakho-ke ahlala ewuketshezi (uwoyela) ekushiseni kwegumbi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ama-triglyceride anezibopho ezimbili ze-trans (ezivame ukubizwa ngokuthi amafutha e-trans), anama-fatty acid aqondile angakwazi ukuhlangana ndawonye ekushiseni kwegumbi futhi akhe amafutha aqinile. Ekudleni kwabantu, amafutha e-trans ahlotshaniswa nengozi eyengeziwe yesifo senhliziyo, ngakho-ke abakhiqizi abaningi bokudla baye banciphisa noma bayeka ukusetshenziswa kwawo eminyakeni yamuva. Ngokungafani namafutha angagcwele, ama-triglyceride angenazibopho ezimbili phakathi kwama-athomu e-carbon abizwa ngokuthi amafutha agcwele, okusho ukuthi aqukethe wonke ama-athomu e-hydrogen atholakalayo. Amafutha agcwele ayizinto eziqinile ekushiseni kwegumbi futhi ngokuvamile avela ezilwaneni.
answer1: Ama-molecule anefomula efanayo yamakhemikhali kodwa amalungiselelo ahlukene ama-athomu kanye/noma izibopho zamakhemikhali

question23: Bheka uMfanekiso 2.26 kanye noMfanekiso 2.26.1. Lesi sithombe sibonisa isakhiwo samakhemikhali sezinhlobo ze-R kanye ne-S ze-thalidomide yesidakamizwa. Unxantathu omnyama umelela leso sibopho esiza kuwe siphuma ekhasini, kanti unxantathu onamachashazi umelela leso sibopho esisuka kuwe siye ekhasini. Umuthi ungashintsha ngokuzenzakalelayo phakathi kwalezi zinhlobo ezimbili. Ucabanga ukuthi lokho kuthinta kanjani umsebenzi wezidakamizwa?
answer23: Lawa ama-enantiomer (izithombe zesibuko). Ingxube yazo zombili ama-enantiomer ingase ingasebenzi kahle kunefomu elimsulwa le-enantiomer eyodwa, noma ibe yingozi, ngoba lezi zinhlobo ezimbili zingasabela ngendlela ehlukile.
distractor23a: Akukuthinti ukusebenza kwemithi. Lawa angama-enantiomers (izithombe zesibuko) ngakho-ke asabela ngendlela efanayo
distractor23b: Ifomu le-R liyi-trans kanti ifomu le-S liyi-cis. Ifomu le-R lizoba nephuzu lokuncibilika eliphakeme ngakho-ke ngeke limuncwe kahle njengefomu le-S.
distractor23c: Ifomu le-R liyi-trans kanti ifomu le-S liyi-cis. Ifomu le-S lizoncintisana ne-cholesterol futhi liphazamise isakhiwo se-membrane yamaseli, okubangela imiphumela emibi.

chapterContent: Ama-enantiomer angama-molecule abelana ngesakhiwo esifanayo samakhemikhali kanye nezibopho zamakhemikhali kodwa ahlukile ekubekweni kwama-athomu okunezinhlangothi ezintathu ukuze abe yizithombe zesibuko. Njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.28, isibonelo se-amino acid alanine, lezi zakhiwo ezimbili azinakunqotshwa. Emvelweni, yizinhlobo ze-L zama-amino acid kuphela ezisetshenziselwa ukwenza amaprotheni. Ezinye izinhlobo ze-D zama-amino acid zibonakala ezindongeni zamaseli zamagciwane, kodwa azibonakali kumaprotheni azo. Ngokufanayo, uhlobo lwe-D lwe-glucose luwumkhiqizo oyinhloko we-photosynthesis futhi uhlobo lwe-L lwe-molecule aluvamile ukubonakala emvelweni.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 2. Isisekelo Samakhemikhali Sokuphila | 2.3 Ikhabhoni | Amaqembu Asebenzayo
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 2. The Chemical Foundation of Life | 2.3 Carbon | Functional Groups
chapterContent:
Amaqembu asebenzayo amaqembu ama-athomu atholakala ngaphakathi kwama-molecule futhi anikeza lawo ma-molecule izakhiwo ezithile zamakhemikhali. Zitholakala eceleni komgogodla wekhabhoni” wama-macromolecule. Lo mgogodla wekhabhoni wakhiwa ngamaketanga kanye/noma amasongo ama-athomu ekhabhoni ngokushintshana ngezikhathi ezithile kwento efana ne-nitrogen noma i-oxygen. Ama-molecule anezinye izakhi kumgogodla wawo wekhabhoni angama-hydrocarbon athathelwe indawo.

 Amaqembu asebenzayo ku-macromolecule avame ukunamathela kumgogodla wekhabhoni endaweni eyodwa noma ngaphezulu ehlukile eceleni kwesakhiwo sawo seketanga kanye/noma sendandatho. Uhlobo ngalunye lwezinhlobo ezine zama-macromolecule—amaprotheni, ama-lipid, ama-carbohydrate, nama-nucleic acid—lunesethi yalo yezimpawu zamaqembu asebenzayo anikela kakhulu ezicini zalo zamakhemikhali ezihlukene kanye nomsebenzi walo ezintweni eziphilayo.

 Iqembu elisebenzayo lingabamba iqhaza ekuphenduleni kwamakhemikhali athile. Amanye amaqembu abalulekile asebenzayo kuma-molecule ebhayoloji aboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.29; afaka: i-hydroxyl, i-methyl, i-carbonyl, i-carboxyl, i-amino, i-phosphate, kanye ne-sulfhydryl. La maqembu adlala indima ebalulekile ekwakhiweni kwama-molecule afana ne-DNA, amaprotheni, ama-carbohydrate, nama-lipid. Amaqembu asebenzayo avame ukuhlukaniswa njenge-hydrophobic noma i-hydrophilic kuye ngokuthi zisebenza kanjani i-charge noma i-polarity. Isibonelo seqembu elinomoya obandayo yi-non-polar methyl molecule. Phakathi kwamaqembu asebenzayo e-hydrophilic kukhona iqembu le-carboxyl elitholakala kuma-amino acid, kwamanye amaketanga aseceleni e-amino acid, kanye nama-fatty acid akha ama-triglycerides nama-phospholipid. Leli qembu le-carboxyl liyayi-ion ukuze likhiphe ama-ion e-hydrogen (H+) eqenjini le-COOH okuholela eqenjini le-COO- elinomoya ongcolile; lokhu kunegalelo esimweni se-hydrophilic sanoma yiliphi i-molecule elitholakala kulo. Amanye amaqembu asebenzayo, njengeqembu le-carbonyl, ane-athomu ye-oxygen enommoya ongcolile engakha izibopho ze-hydrogen nama-molecule amanzi, okwenza futhi i-molecule ibe nomoya obandayo kakhulu.

 Izibopho ze-hydrogen phakathi kwamaqembu asebenzayo (ngaphakathi kwe-molecule efanayo noma phakathi kwama-molecule ahlukene) zibalulekile ekusebenzeni kwama-macromolecule amaningi futhi ziwasiza ukuthi agoqeke kahle futhi agcine isimo esifanele sokusebenza. Izibopho ze-hydrogen nazo zihilelekile ezinqubweni ezahlukene zokuqaphela, njengokuhlanganiswa kwesisekelo se-DNA kanye nokubopha i-enzyme ku-substrate yayo, njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 2.30

chapterContent:
2.1 Ama-Athomu, Ama-Isotope, Ama-Ion, Nama-Molecule: Amabhulokhi Okwakha
I-Matter yinoma yini ethatha isikhala futhi enobunzima. Yakhiwe yizinto. Zonke izinto ezingu-98 ezenzeka ngokwemvelo zinezimfanelo ezihlukile ezizivumela ukuthi zihlangane ngezindlela ezahlukene ukuze zenze ama-molecule, wona ahlangana ukuze akhe amaseli, izicubu, izinhlelo zezitho, kanye nezinto eziphilayo. Ama-Athomu, aqukethe ama-proton, ama-neutron, nama-electron, angamayunithi amancane kakhulu e-element agcina zonke izakhiwo zaleso sici. Ama-electron angadluliselwa, abelwane, noma abangele ukungafani kweshaja phakathi kwama-athomu ukuze adale izibopho, kufaka phakathi izibopho ze-ionic, i-covalent, kanye ne-hydrogen, kanye nokusebenzisana kwe-van der Waals.

 2.2 Amanzi
Amanzi anezakhiwo eziningi ezibalulekile ekugcineni impilo. Yi-molecule ye-polar, evumela ukwakheka kwezibopho ze-hydrogen. Izibopho ze-hydrogen zivumela ama-ion namanye ama-molecule e-polar ukuthi ancibilike emanzini. Ngakho-ke, amanzi ayi-solvent enhle kakhulu. Izibopho ze-hydrogen phakathi kwama-molecule amanzi zibangela amanzi ukuba abe nomthamo wokushisa ophezulu, okusho ukuthi kuthatha ukushisa okwengeziwe ukuphakamisa izinga lokushisa lawo. Njengoba izinga lokushisa likhuphuka, izibopho ze-hydrogen phakathi kwamanzi zihlala ziphuka futhi zakheke kabusha. Lokhu kuvumela ukuthi izinga lokushisa lilonke lihlale lizinzile, yize amandla engezwa ohlelweni. Amanzi aphinde abonise ukushisa okuphezulu kokuhwamuka, okuyisihluthulelo sendlela izinto eziphilayo ezizipholisa ngayo ngokuhwamuka kokujuluka. Amandla amanzi ahlanganayo avumela isici sokucindezeleka kobuso, kanti izakhiwo zawo zokunamathela zibonakala njengoba amanzi ekhuphuka ngaphakathi kwamapayipi e-capillary. Inani le-pH liyisilinganiso sokuhlushwa kwe-hydrogen ion esixazululweni futhi lingenye yezici eziningi zamakhemikhali ezilawulwa kakhulu ezintweni eziphilayo nge-homeostasis. Ama-asidi nezisekelo zingashintsha amanani e-pH, kodwa ama-buffers avame ukunciphisa izinguquko ezibangelayo. Lezi zakhiwo zamanzi zixhumene kakhulu nezinqubo ze-biochemical nezomzimba ezenziwa izinto eziphilayo, futhi impilo ibizohluka kakhulu uma lezi zakhiwo zishintshwa, uma ngabe zikhona nhlobo.

 2.3 I-Carbon
Izakhiwo ezihlukile ze-carbon zenza kube yingxenye ephakathi yama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo. I-Carbon ibopha umoya-mpilo, i-hydrogen, kanye ne-nitrogen ndawonye ukuze yakhe ama-molecule amaningi abalulekile ekusebenzeni kwamaseli. I-Carbon inama-electron amane egobolondweni layo langaphandle futhi ingakha izibopho ezine. I-Carbon kanye ne-hydrogen kungakha amaketanga noma amasongo e-hydrocarbon. Amaqembu asebenzayo amaqembu ama-athomu anikeza izakhiwo ezithile kumaketanga noma amasongo e-hydrocarbon (noma afakelwe esikhundleni se-hydrocarbon) achaza izici zawo zamakhemikhali kanye nomsebenzi wawo.
answer1: Noma yini ethatha isikhala futhi enobunzima

question31: Yiliphi inani elikhulu lama-athomu noma ama-molecule i-athomu eyodwa yekhabhoni engahlangana nawo?

question37: Kungani izibopho ze-hydrogen kanye nokusebenzisana kwe-van der Waals kudingeka kumaseli?
answer37: Izibopho ze-hydrogen kanye nokusebenzisana kwe-van der Waals kwakha ubudlelwano obubuthakathaka phakathi kanye/noma ngaphakathi kwama-molecule, okunikeza ukuma kanye nesakhiwo esidingekayo se-DNA namaprotheni ukuze kusebenze emzimbeni.

answer40: Ama-buffer amunca ama-ion e-hydrogen kanye ne-hydroxide amaningi ukuvimbela ukwanda noma ukwehla kwe-pH. Isibonelo uhlelo lwe-bicarbonate emzimbeni womuntu

question41: Yiziphi izibonelo ezintathu zendlela izici zamanzi ezibaluleke ngayo ekulondolozeni impilo?
answer41: Okokuqala, ukuminyana okuphansi kwamanzi njengezinto eziqinile uma kuqhathaniswa noketshezi kuvumela iqhwa ukuthi lintante, kwakha ungqimba oluvikelayo lwezinto eziphilayo zasemanzini. question42: Chaza isikali se-pH nokuthi sihlobana kanjani nezinhlelo eziphilayo. Nikeza isibonelo sokuthi izinguquko ezinkulu ze-pH zivinjelwa kanjani ezinhlelweni eziphilayo

question43: Yisiphi isici sekhabhoni esenza sibe yinto ebalulekile empilweni yezinto eziphilayo?
answer43: I-Carbon ingakha izibopho ezine ze-covalent, okuyenza ikwazi ukwakha izintambo ze-carbon

question44: Yisiphi isici se-carboxyl esenza ama-molecule aqukethe i-carboxyl abe manzi futhi athande ukuba manzi? Yimaphi ama-macromolecule aqukethe i-carboxyl?
answer44: Amaqembu e-carboxyl akhipha i-H+, okwenza i-molecule yayo engumzali ithande ukuba manzi. Itholakala kuma-amino acid nama-fatty acid

question45: Qhathanisa futhi uqhathanise amafutha agcwele kanye nalawo angagcwali
answer45: Amafutha agcwele aqukethe izibopho ezilodwa futhi ayizinto eziqinile ekushiseni kwegumbi, kuyilapho amafutha angagcwele aqukethe izibopho eziphindwe kabili futhi ayizinto eziwuketshezi ekushiseni kwegumbi.

distractor45b: Amafutha agcwele aqukethe ama-single bond futhi ayizinto eziwuketshezi ekushiseni kwegumbi, kuyilapho amafutha angagcwele aqukethe ama-double bond futhi ayizinto eziqinile ekushiseni kwegumbi.
distractor45c: Amafutha agcwele aqukethe ama-bond amabili futhi ayizinto eziwuketshezi ekushiseni kwegumbi, kuyilapho amafutha angagcwele aqukethe i-bond eyodwa futhi ayizinto eziqinile ekushiseni kwegumbi.
question46: Kungani amanzi angaba yisivikelo esihle emzimbeni wezilwane ezinegazi elifudumele?
question47:
Izakhiwo zamanzi eziyingqayizivele zibalulekile ezinqubweni zezinto eziphilayo. Ngezakhiwo ezintathu ezilandelayo zamanzi, chaza isici bese unikeza isibonelo esisodwa sendlela isici esithinta ngayo izinto eziphilayo:

 ukuhlangana
ukunamathela
ukushisa okukhulu kokuhwamuka
answer47: Ukuhlangana kuyinto ekhangayo phakathi kwama-molecule amanzi, okusiza ekudaleni ukucindezeleka kobuso. Izinambuzane zingahamba phezu kwamanzi ngenxa yokuhlangana. Ukunamathela kuyinto ekhangayo phakathi kwama-molecule amanzi namanye ama-molecule. Amanzi asuka ezimpandeni zezitshalo aye emaqabunga ngenxa yesenzo se-capillary kungenxa yokunamathela. Ukushisa kokuhwamuka yinani lamandla adingekayo ukuguqula uketshezi lube yigesi. Lesi sici sisiza abantu ukuba balondoloze i-homeostasis yokushisa komzimba ngokuhwamuka.

Ukudla kunikeza umzimba izakhamzimba ozidingayo ukuze uphile. Eziningi zalezi zakhamzimba ezibalulekile ziyi-macromolecules eziphilayo, noma ama-molecule amakhulu, adingekayo futhi akhiwe yizinto eziphilayo. Isibonelo, ama-amino acid atholakala kumaprotheni ayadingeka ukwakha amathambo nemisipha enempilo. Umzimba usebenzisa ama-molecules amafutha ukwakha amaseli amasha, ukugcina amandla, kanye nokugaya kahle. Ama-carbohydrate angumthombo oyinhloko wamandla omzimba. Ama-Nucleic acid aqukethe ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo.

 Ngenkathi zonke izinto eziphilayo, okuhlanganisa nabantu, zidinga ama-macromolecules ekudleni kwazo kwansuku zonke, ukungalingani kwanoma iyiphi yazo kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo. Isibonelo, ukudla amafutha amaningi kakhulu kungaholela ezinkingeni zenhliziyo, kanti amaprotheni amaningi kakhulu angaholela ezinkingeni ngezinso. Abanye abantu bacabanga ukuthi ukususa okusanhlamvu okuphelele, njengokolweni, ekudleni komuntu kungaba wusizo. Kodwa-ke, ososayensi bathole ukuthi lokho akulungile kubantu abaningi. Eqinisweni, okuphambene nalokho kungaba yiqiniso, ngoba ukolweni ophelele uqukethe i-fiber yokudla eningi kunezinye izinhlobo zokusanhlamvu.

chapterContent:
Izinto eziphilayo zidinga ukudla ukuze ziphile njengoba kuqukethe izakhamzimba ezibalulekile ngesimo sama-macromolecule ezinto eziphilayo. Lawa ma-molecule amakhulu akhiwa ikakhulukazi yizinto eziyisithupha—i-sulfur, i-phosphorus, i-oxygen, i-nitrogen, i-carbon, ne-hydrogen (SPONCH)—ngobuningi nokuhlelwa okuhlukene. Ama-polymer ayinkimbinkimbi akhiwa ngokuhlanganiswa kwama-monomers amancane ngokwenziwa kokuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni, ukusabela kwamakhemikhali lapho i-molecule yamanzi isuswa khona phakathi kwama-monomers amabili axhumanisayo. (Cabanga ngesitimela: inqola ngayinye, okuhlanganisa ne-caboose, imele i-monomer, kanti isitimela sonke siyi-polymer.) Ngesikhathi sokugaya, ama-polymer angahlukaniswa yi-hydrolysis, noma ukungezwa kwamanzi. Kokubili ukusabela kokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni kanye ne-hydrolysis emaselini kuqhutshwa yi-enzyme ethile. Ukusabela kokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni ngokuvamile kudinga ukutshalwa kwezimali kwamandla ukuze kwakhiwe izibopho ezintsha, kanti ukusabela kwe-hydrolysis kuvame ukukhulula amandla angasetshenziswa ukunika amandla izinqubo zamaseli. Izigaba ezine zama-macromolecule ama-carbohydrate, ama-lipid, amaprotheni, nama-nucleic acid. Ubufakazi busekela isimangalo sososayensi sokuthi izandulela zezinto eziphilayo zala ma-molecule ezinto eziphilayo zazikhona eMhlabeni wasendulo.

chapterContent:
Njengoba usufundile, ama-macromolecule ezinto eziphilayo angama-molecule amakhulu, adingekayo empilweni, akhiwe ngama-molecule amancane ezinto eziphilayo. Kunezinhlobo ezine ezinkulu zama-macromolecule ezinto eziphilayo (ama-carbohydrate, ama-lipid, amaprotheni, nama-nucleic acid); ngalinye liyingxenye ebalulekile yeseli futhi lenza imisebenzi eminingi. Uma lihlanganisiwe, la ma-molecule akha iningi lesisindo esomile seseli (khumbula ukuthi amanzi akha iningi lesisindo salo esiphelele). Ama-macromolecule ezinto eziphilayo ayizinto eziphilayo, okusho ukuthi aqukethe ikhabhoni futhi aboshwe yi-hydrogen, futhi angase aqukathe umoya-mpilo, i-nitrogen, kanye nezinye izinto ezincane ezengeziwe.

 Ama-macromolecule amaningi enziwa ngama-subunit angawodwa, noma amabhlogo okwakha, abizwa ngokuthi ama-monomers. Ama-monomers ahlangana esebenzisa izibopho ze-covalent ukwakha ama-molecule amakhulu aziwa ngokuthi ama-polymers. Ngokwenza kanjalo, ama-monomers akhipha ama-molecule amanzi njengemikhiqizo elandelanayo. Lolu hlobo lokusabela lwaziwa ngokuthi ukuhlanganiswa kokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni, okusho ukuhlanganisa ngenkathi ulahlekelwa amanzi.

 Ekusabeleni kokwenziwa kokuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni (Isithombe 3.2), i-hydrogen ye-monomer eyodwa ihlangana neqembu le-hydroxyl lenye i-monomer, ikhipha i-molecule yamanzi. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ama-monomer abelana ngama-electron futhi akha izibopho ze-covalent. Njengoba ama-monomer engeziwe ehlangana, lolu chungechunge lwama-monomer aphindaphindayo lwakha i-polymer. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-monomer zingahlangana ngezindlela eziningi, ziveze iqembu elihlukahlukene lama-macromolecule. Ngisho nohlobo olulodwa lwe-monomer lungahlangana ngezindlela ezahlukene ukuze lwakhe ama-polymer amaningana ahlukene: isibonelo, ama-monomer e-glucose ayizakhi zesitashi, i-glycogen, ne-cellulose.
