chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | 3.1 Ukwenziwa Kwama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | I-Hydrolysis
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.1 Synthesis of Biological Macromolecules | Hydrolysis
chapterContent:
Ama-polymer ahlukaniswa abe ama-monomer enqubweni eyaziwa ngokuthi i-hydrolysis, okusho ukuhlukana ngamanzi.” I-Hydrolysis iyindlela yokusabela lapho kusetshenziswa khona i-molecule yamanzi ngesikhathi sokuqhekeka kwenye i-compound (Isithombe 3.3). Phakathi nalezi zindlela zokusabela, i-polymer ihlukaniswa ibe yizingxenye ezimbili: ingxenye eyodwa ithola i-athomu ye-hydrogen (H+) kanti enye ithola i-molecule ye-hydroxyl (OH–) evela ku-molecule yamanzi ehlukanisiwe.

 Ukusabela kokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni kanye ne-hydrolysis kuyathuthukiswa, noma kusheshiswe,” ngama-enzyme athile; ukusabela kokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni kuhilela ukwakheka kwezibopho ezintsha, ezidinga amandla, kuyilapho ukusabela kwe-hydrolysis kuphula izibopho futhi kukhulule amandla. Lokhu kusabela kufana kuma-macromolecule amaningi, kodwa ukusabela ngakunye kwe-monomer kanye ne-polymer kukhethekile ngokwesigaba sako. Isibonelo, emizimbeni yethu, ukudla kuyathuthukiswa, noma kuhlukaniswe, kube ama-molecule amancane ngama-enzyme e-catalytic ohlelweni lokugaya ukudla. Lokhu kuvumela ukumuncwa kalula kwezakhamzimba ngamaseli asemathunjini. I-macromolecule ngayinye ihlukaniswe yi-enzyme ethile. Isibonelo, ama-carbohydrate ahlukaniswa yi-amylase, i-sucrase, i-lactase, noma i-maltase. Amaprotheni ahlukaniswa yi-enzymes i-pepsin ne-peptidase, kanye ne-hydrochloric acid. Ama-lipid ahlukaniswa yi-lipases. Ukuhlukaniswa kwala ma-macromolecule kunikeza amandla emisebenzini yamaseli.

chapterContent: Abantu abaningi bayazibuza ukuthi impilo yakheka kanjani eMhlabeni. Ngo-1953, uStanley Miller noHarold Urey bakha umshini ofana nalowo oboniswe kuMfanekiso 3.4 ukuze babonise izimo zakuqala emhlabeni. Babefuna ukuhlola ukuthi ama-molecule ezinto eziphilayo angakheka yini kusukela kuma-molecule alula okwakukholelwa ukuthi akhona ekuqaleni komlando woMhlaba. Basebenzisa amanzi abilayo ukulingisa izilwandle zakuqala zoMhlaba. Umusi ovela olwandle `wahlanganiswa ne-methane, i-ammonia, namagesi e-hydrogen avela emkhathini wasekuqaleni koMhlaba futhi wavezwa yizinhlansi zikagesi ukuze usebenze njengombani. Njengoba ingxube yegesi iphola futhi iqina, kwatholakala ukuthi iqukethe i-organic com amakhilogremu, njenge-amino acid nama-nucleotide. Ngokusho kwethiyori ye-abiogenesis, la ma-molecule ezinto eziphilayo ahlangana ukuze akhe uhlobo lokuqala lokuphila eminyakeni engaba yizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-3.5 edlule. (ikhredithi: Yassine Mrabet)

Ama-carbohydrate ahlinzeka ngamandla esisele kanye nokusekelwa kwesakhiwo ezitshalweni, isikhunta, kanye ne-arthropod njengezinambuzane, izicabucabu, kanye nama-crustacean. Aqukethe i-carbon, i-hydrogen, kanye ne-oxygen ngesilinganiso se-CH2O noma i-carbon hydrated ngamanzi, ama-carbohydrate ahlukaniswa njengama-monosaccharides, ama-disaccharides, kanye nama-polysaccharides kuye ngenani lama-monomers kuma-macromolecule. Ama-monosaccharides axhunyaniswa yizibopho ze-glycosidic ezakha ngenxa yokwenziwa kokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni. I-glucose, i-galactose, ne-fructose yi-isomer monosaccharides evamile, kanti i-sucrose noma ushukela wetafula kuyi-disaccharide. Izibonelo zama-polysaccharides zifaka i-cellulose kanye nesitashi ezitshalweni kanye ne-glycogen ezilwaneni. Nakuba ukugcina i-glucose ngesimo sama-polymers njengesitashi noma i-glycogen kwenza kube lula ukutholakala kwe-metabolism, lokhu kuyivimbela ekuphumeni kwamaseli noma ekudaleni ingcindezi ephezulu ye-osmotic engabangela ukumuncwa kwamanzi ngokweqile yiseli. Izinambuzane zine-skeleton yangaphandle eqinile eyenziwe nge-chitin, i-polysaccharide eyingqayizivele equkethe i-nitrogen.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyisiwe esigabeni zisekela imiqondo kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 4 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.2 Carbohydrates | Molecular Structures
chapterContent:
Iningi labantu lijwayelene nama-carbohydrate, uhlobo olulodwa lwe-macromolecule, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngalokho esikudlayo. Ukuze banciphise isisindo, abanye abantu banamathela ekudleni okunama-carbohydrate aphansi. Ngokuphambene, abadlali bavame ukudla ama-carbohydrate ngaphambi kwemincintiswano ebalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi banamandla anele okuncintisana ezingeni eliphezulu. Ama-carbohydrate, empeleni, ayingxenye ebalulekile yokudla kwethu; okusanhlamvu, izithelo, nemifino konke kuyimithombo yemvelo yama-carbohydrate. Ama-carbohydrate anikeza umzimba amandla, ikakhulukazi nge-glucose, ushukela olula oyingxenye yesitashi kanye nesithako ekudleni okuningi okuyisisekelo. Ama-carbohydrate aneminye imisebenzi ebalulekile kubantu, ezilwaneni, nasezitshalweni.

 Ama-carbohydrate angamelwa yifomula ye-stoichiometric (CH2O)n, lapho i-n iyinani lama-carbon ku-molecule. Ngamanye amazwi, isilinganiso se-carbon kuya ku-hydrogen kuya ku-oxygen siyi-1:2:1 kuma-molecule ama-carbohydrate. Le fomula ichaza futhi umsuka wegama elithi `carbohydrate`: izingxenye ziyi-carbon (carbohydrate) kanye nezingxenye zamanzi (ngakho-ke, i-hydrate). Ama-carbohydrate ahlukaniswe ngamaqembu amathathu: ama-monosaccharides, ama-disaccharides, nama-polysaccharides.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | 3.2 Ama-carbohydrate | Izakhiwo Zama-Molecular | Ama-Monosaccharides
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.2 Carbohydrates | Molecular Structures | Monosaccharides
chapterContent:
Ama-monosaccharide (i-mono- = eyodwa”; i-sacchar- = emnandi”) ushukela olula, ovame kakhulu kuwo yi-glucose. Kuma-monosaccharide, inani lama-carbon livame ukusuka kwamathathu kuya kwayisikhombisa. Amagama amaningi ama-monosaccharide aphela ngesijobelelo -ose. Uma ushukela uneqembu le-aldehyde (iqembu elisebenzayo elinesakhiwo i-R-CHO), waziwa njenge-aldose, futhi uma uneqembu le-ketone (iqembu elisebenzayo elinesakhiwo i-RC(=O)R), waziwa njenge-ketose. Kuye ngenani lama-carbon kushukela, angase aziwe nangokuthi ama-triose (ama-carbon amathathu), ama-pentoses (ama-carbon amahlanu), kanye noma ama-hexoses (ama-carbon ayisithupha). Bheka Umfanekiso 3.5 ukuze uthole umfanekiso wama-monosaccharide.

 Ifomula yamakhemikhali ye-glucose yi-C6H12O6. Kubantu, i-glucose iwumthombo obalulekile wamandla. Ngesikhathi sokuphefumula kwamaseli, amandla akhishwa ku-glucose, futhi lawo mandla asetshenziswa ukusiza ekwenzeni i-adenosine triphosphate (ATP). Izitshalo zenza i-glucose zisebenzisa i-carbon dioxide namanzi, bese kuthi i-glucose yona isetshenziswe ezidingweni zamandla esitshalweni. I-glucose eningi ivame ukugcinwa njengesitashi esiguqulwa sibe yi-catabol (ukuwohloka kwama-molecule amakhulu ngamaseli) ngabantu nezinye izilwane ezidla izitshalo.

 I-Galactose (ingxenye ye-lactose, noma ushukela wobisi lwezilwane) kanye ne-fructose (etholakala ku-sucrose, ezithelweni) ezinye i-monosaccharides ezivamile. Nakuba i-glucose, i-galactose, ne-fructose zonke zinefomula efanayo yamakhemikhali (C6H12O6), ziyahlukahluka ngokwesakhiwo nangamakhemikhali (futhi zaziwa ngokuthi ama-isomers) ngenxa yokuhlelwa okuhlukile kwamaqembu asebenzayo azungeze ikhabhoni engalingani; wonke lawa ma-monosaccharides anekhabhoni engalingani engaphezu kweyodwa (Isithombe 3.6).

 I-glucose, i-galactose, ne-fructose yi-isomeric monosaccharides (i-hexoses), okusho ukuthi zinefomula efanayo yamakhemikhali kodwa zinezakhiwo ezihlukile kancane. I-glucose ne-galactose yi-aldoses, kanti i-fructose iyi-ketose.

 Ama-monosaccharide angaba khona njengochungechunge oluqondile noma njengama-molecule amise okwendandatho; ezixazululweni zamanzi avame ukutholakala ezinhlotsheni zendandatho (Isithombe 3.7). I-glucose esesimweni sendandatho ingaba nokuhleleka okubili okuhlukile kweqembu le-hydroxyl (OH) elizungeze ikhabhoni ye-anomeric (ikhabhoni 1 eba yi-asymmetric enkambisweni yokwakheka kwendandatho). Uma iqembu le-hydroxyl lingaphansi kwenombolo yekhabhoni 1 kushukela, kuthiwa lisendaweni ye-alpha (α), futhi uma lingaphezu kwendiza, kuthiwa lisendaweni ye-beta (β).

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | 3.2 Ama-carbohydrate | Izakhiwo Zama-Molecular | Ama-Disaccharides
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.2 Carbohydrates | Molecular Structures | Disaccharides
chapterContent:
Ama-Disaccharides (di- = amabili”) akheka lapho ama-monosaccharides amabili ebhekana nokusabela kokuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni (okwaziwa nangokuthi ukusabela kokuncipha kwamanzi emzimbeni noma ukwenziwa kokuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni). Phakathi nale nqubo, iqembu le-hydroxyl le-monosaccharide eyodwa lihlangana ne-hydrogen yenye i-monosaccharide, likhipha i-molecule yamanzi futhi lenze i-covalent bond. I-covalent bond eyakhiwe phakathi kwe-molecule ye-carbohydrate nenye i-molecule (kulokhu, phakathi kwama-monosaccharides amabili) yaziwa ngokuthi i-glycosidic bond (Isithombe 3.8). Ama-Glycosidic bonds (abizwa nangokuthi ama-glycosidic linkages) angaba uhlobo lwe-alpha noma lwe-beta.

 Ama-disaccharides avamile afaka i-lactose, i-maltose, ne-sucrose (Isithombe 3.9). I-Lactose iyi-disaccharide equkethe i-monomers glucose ne-galactose. Itholakala ngokwemvelo obisini lwezilwane. I-Maltose, noma ushukela we-malt, iyi-disaccharide eyakhiwe ukusabela kokuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni phakathi kwama-molecule amabili e-glucose. I-disaccharide evame kakhulu yi-sucrose, noma ushukela wetafula, owakhiwa yi-monomers glucose ne-fructose.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | 3.2 Ama-carbohydrate | Izakhiwo Zama-Molecular | Ama-Polysaccharides
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.2 Carbohydrates | Molecular Structures | Polysaccharides
chapterContent:
Uchungechunge olude lwama-monosaccharide axhunywe yizibopho ze-glycosidic lwaziwa ngokuthi i-polysaccharide (poly- = many”). Uchungechunge lungaba namagatsha noma lungagatshani, futhi lungaqukatha izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-monosaccharide. Isisindo sama-molecule singaba ama-dalton ayi-100,000 noma ngaphezulu kuye ngenani lama-monomer ahlanganisiwe. Isitashi, i-glycogen, i-cellulose, ne-chitin yizibonelo eziyinhloko zama-polysaccharide.

 Isitashi siwuhlobo olugciniwe lukashukela ezitshalweni futhi sakhiwe ngengxube ye-amylose ne-amylopectin (zombili ama-polymer e-glucose). Izitshalo ziyakwazi ukukhiqiza i-glucose, kanti i-glucose eningi, ngaphezu kwezidingo zamandla ezisheshayo zesitshalo, igcinwa njengesitashi ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zezitshalo, kufaka phakathi izimpande nembewu. Isitashi esisembewini sinikeza ukudla kwe-embryo njengoba ihluma futhi singasebenza njengomthombo wokudla kwabantu nezilwane. Isitashi esidliwa ngabantu sihlukaniswa ngama-enzyme, njenge-salivary amylases, sibe ama-molecule amancane, njenge-maltose ne-glucose. Amaseli angabe esemunca i-glucose.

 Isitashi sakhiwe ngama-monomer e-glucose ahlanganiswe yi-α 1-4 noma i-α 1-6 glycosidic bonds. Izinombolo 1-4 kanye no-1-6 zibhekisela enombolweni yekhabhoni yezinsalela ezimbili ezihlangene ukwakha isibopho. Njengoba kuboniswe kuMfanekiso 3.10, i-amylose isitashi esakhiwe ngamaketanga angahlanganisiwe ama-monomer e-glucose (kuphela ama-linkages e-α 1-4), kanti i-amylopectin iyi-polysaccharide enamagatsha (ama-linkages e-α 1-6 ezindaweni zamagatsha).

 I-Glycogen iyindlela yokugcina i-glucose kubantu nakwezinye izilwane ezinomgogodla futhi yakhiwe ngama-monomer e-glucose. I-Glycogen ilingana nesitashi sesilwane futhi iyi-molecule enamagatsha amaningi evame ukugcinwa emangqamuzaneni esibindi nemisipha. Noma nini lapho amazinga e-glucose egazini ehla, i-glycogen iyaphulwa ukuze ikhiphe i-glucose enqubweni eyaziwa ngokuthi i-glycogenolysis.

 I-Cellulose iyi-biopolymer yemvelo etholakala kakhulu. Udonga lweseli lwezitshalo lwenziwe kakhulu i-cellulose; lokhu kunikeza ukwesekwa kwesakhiwo kuseli. Izinkuni nephepha ikakhulukazi ziyi-cellulosic ngokwemvelo. I-Cellulose yakhiwe ngama-monomer e-glucose axhunywe yizibopho ze-β 1-4 glycosidic (Isithombe 3.11).

 Njengoba kuboniswe kuSithombe 3.11, yonke eminye i-monomer ye-glucose ku-cellulose iyaphendulwa, futhi ama-monomer ahlanganiswe ngokuqinile njengamaketanga amade anwetshiwe. Lokhu kunikeza i-cellulose ukuqina kwayo kanye namandla aphezulu okunamathela—okubaluleke kakhulu ekutshaleni amaseli. Ngenkathi ukuxhumana kwe-β 1-4 kungenakuhlukaniswa ngama-enzyme okugaya abantu, izilwane ezidla utshani ezifana nezinkomo, ama-koala, nama-buffalo ziyakwazi, ngosizo lwezitshalo ezikhethekile esiswini sazo, ukugaya izinto zezitshalo ezicebile ku-cellulose futhi ziyisebenzise njengomthombo wokudla. Kulezi zilwane, izinhlobo ezithile zamabhaktheriya nama-protist zihlala ohlelweni lokugaya utshani lwezilwane ezidla utshani futhi zikhiphe i-enzyme i-cellulase. Isithasiselo sezilwane ezidla utshani siqukethe namabhaktheriya agaya i-cellulose, okwenza kube nendima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokugaya utshani zezinye izilwane ezidla utshani. Ama-cellulase angaphula i-cellulose abe ama-monomer e-glucose angasetshenziswa njengomthombo wamandla yisilwane. Ama-termite nawo ayakwazi ukuphula i-cellulose ngenxa yokuba khona kwezinye izinto eziphilayo emizimbeni yazo ezikhipha ama-cellulase.

 Ama-carbohydrate asebenza imisebenzi eyahlukene ezilwaneni ezahlukene. Ama-arthropod (izinambuzane, ama-crustacean, nabanye) anohlaka lwangaphandle, olubizwa ngokuthi i-exoskeleton, oluvikela izingxenye zomzimba wawo wangaphakathi (njengoba kubonwe enyosini kuMfanekiso 3.12). Le exoskeleton yenziwe nge-biological macromolecule chitin, okuyi-polysaccharide equkethe i-nitrogen. Yenziwe ngamayunithi aphindaphindayo e-N-acetyl-β-d-glucosamine, ushukela oguquliwe. I-Chitin nayo iyisici esiyinhloko sezindonga zamaseli e-fungal; isikhunta asizona izilwane noma izitshalo futhi sakha umbuso wazo endaweni ye-Eukarya.

 Ukuxhumana Komsebenzi
Izazi Zokudla Ezibhalisiwe
Izazi Zokudla Ezibhalisiwe zisiza ukuhlela ukudla okunempilo amagremu ukuze abantu ngabanye ezindaweni ezahlukene. Bavame ukusebenza neziguli ezindaweni zokunakekelwa kwempilo, beklama izinhlelo zokudla ukuze belaphe futhi bavimbele izifo. Isibonelo, ochwepheshe bezokudla bangafundisa isiguli esinesifo sikashukela ukuthi singaphatha kanjani amazinga kashukela egazini ngokudla izinhlobo ezifanele kanye namanani ama-carbohydrate. Ochwepheshe bezokudla bangasebenza nasezindlini zokunakekela asebekhulile, ezikoleni, kanye nasezikhungweni zangasese.

 Ukuze ube yisazi sokudla esibhalisiwe, umuntu udinga ukuthola okungenani iziqu ze-bachelor kwezokwelapha, ezokudla okunempilo, ubuchwepheshe bokudla, noma insimu ehlobene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ochwepheshe bezokudla ababhalisiwe kumele baqedele uhlelo lokuqeqeshwa oluqondisiwe futhi baphumelele isivivinyo sikazwelonke. Labo abaphishekela imisebenzi kwezokwelapha bathatha izifundo kwezokudla okunempilo, ikhemistri, i-biochemistry, i-biology, i-microbiology, kanye ne-physiology yabantu. Ochwepheshe bezokudla kumele babe ochwepheshe kwezekhemistri kanye ne-physiology (imisebenzi yezinto eziphilayo) yokudla (amaprotheni, ama-carbohydrate, namafutha)

chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.2 Carbohydrates | Molecular Structures | Benefits of Carbohydrates
chapterContent:
Ingabe ama-carbohydrate akulungele? Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi ama-carbohydrate ayingozi kubo futhi kufanele agwenywe. Ezinye izindlela zokudla ziyakwenqabela ngokuphelele ukudla ama-carbohydrate, zithi ukudla okunama-carbohydrate aphansi kusiza abantu ukuba banciphise isisindo ngokushesha. Kodwa-ke, ama-carbohydrate abe yingxenye ebalulekile yokudla kwabantu izinkulungwane zeminyaka; izinto zobuciko ezivela empucukweni yasendulo zibonisa ukuba khona kukakolweni, ilayisi, nommbila ezindaweni zokugcina zokhokho bethu.

 Ama-carbohydrate kufanele afakwe amaprotheni, amavithamini, namafutha ukuze abe yingxenye yokudla okulinganiselayo. Ngokwe-calorie, igremu lama-carbohydrate linikeza i-4.3 Kcal. Uma kuqhathaniswa, amafutha ahlinzeka nge-9 Kcal/g, isilinganiso esingathandeki kangako. Ama-carbohydrate aqukethe izakhi ezincibilikayo nezingenakuncibilika; ingxenye engancibiliki yaziwa ngokuthi i-fiber, okuyi-cellulose ikakhulukazi. I-fibre inezindlela eziningi zokusetshenziswa; ikhuthaza ukunyakaza kwamathumbu njalo ngokungeza inqwaba, futhi ilawula izinga lokusetshenziswa kwe-glucose egazini. I-fibre iyasiza futhi ekususeni i-cholesterol eningi emzimbeni: i-fibre ibopha i-cholesterol emathunjini amancane, bese inamathela ku-cholesterol futhi ivimbele izinhlayiya ze-cholesterol ukuthi zingangeni egazini, bese i-cholesterol iphuma emzimbeni ngendle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukudla okuqukethe okusanhlamvu okuphelele nemifino kunikeza umuzwa wokugcwala. Njengomthombo wamandla osheshayo, i-glucose iyaqhekeka ngesikhathi senqubo yokuphefumula kwamaseli, ekhiqiza i-ATP, uhlobo lwamandla lweseli. Ngaphandle kokusetshenziswa kwama-carbohydrate, ukutholakala kwamandla okusheshayo” kuzoncishiswa. Ukususa ama-carbohydrate ekudleni kungadingeka kwabanye abantu, kodwa isinyathelo esinjalo singase singabi nempilo kuwo wonke umuntu.

chapterContent:
Ama-lipid nawo ayimithombo yamandla anika amandla izinqubo zamaseli. Njengama-carbohydrate, ama-lipid akhiwa yi-carbon, i-hydrogen, kanye nomoya-mpilo, kodwa lawa ma-athomu ahlelwe ngendlela ehlukile. Ama-lipid amaningi awayona i-polar futhi awathandi amanzi. Izinhlobo ezinkulu zifaka amafutha namafutha, ama-waxes, ama-phospholipid, nama-steroids. Amafutha ajwayelekile aqukethe ama-fatty acid amathathu ahlanganiswe ne-molecule eyodwa ye-glycerol, akha ama-triglycerides noma ama-triacylglycerols. Ama-fatty acid angase agcwaliswe noma angagcwalisiwe, kuye ngokuba khona noma ukungabikho kwezibopho ezimbili ku-hydrocarbon chain; i-fatty acid egcwaliswe inenani elikhulu lama-athomu e-hydrogen ahlanganiswe ne-carbon, ngakho-ke, izibopho ezilodwa kuphela. Ngokuvamile, amafutha aketshezi ekushiseni kwegumbi (isb., uwoyela we-canola) avame ukuba angagcwalisiwe kakhulu kunamafutha aqinile ekushiseni kwegumbi. Embonini yokudla, amafutha afakwa i-hydrogen yokwenziwa ukuze awenze afaneleke kakhulu ngamakhemikhali ukusetshenziswa ekudleni okucutshunguliwe. Phakathi nale nqubo ye-hydrogenation, izibopho ezimbili ku-cis-conformation ku-hydrocarbon chain zingaguqulwa zibe izibopho ezimbili ku-trans-conformation; Ngeshwa, amafutha e-trans aboniswe ukuthi anegalelo ezifweni zenhliziyo. Ama-phospholipid awuhlobo olukhethekile lwe-lipid oluhlotshaniswa nolwelwesi lwamaseli futhi ngokuvamile anomgogodla we-glycerol (noma i-sphingosine) lapho kunamathele khona amaketanga amabili e-fatty acid kanye neqembu eliqukethe i-phosphate. Ngenxa yalokho, ama-phospholipid abhekwa njenge-amphipathic ngoba anezingxenye ze-hydrophobic kanye ne-hydrophilic. (Ezahlukweni 4 no-5 sizohlola ngokuningiliziwe ukuthi imvelo ye-phospholipids e-plasma cell membranes isiza kanjani ukulawula ukudlula kwezinto zingene futhi ziphume eseli.) Nakuba izakhiwo zama-molecule zama-steroid zihlukile kweze-triglycerides kanye ne-phospholipids, ama-steroids ahlukaniswa njenge-lipids ngokusekelwe ezicini zawo ze-hydrophobic. I-cholesterol uhlobo lwe-steroid e-plasma membrane yamaseli ezilwane. I-cholesterol nayo iyisandulela sama-hormone e-steroid njenge-testosterone.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | 3.3 Ama-Lipid | Amafutha Namafutha
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.3 Lipids | Fats and Oils
chapterContent:
Ama-lipid ahlanganisa iqembu elihlukahlukene lama-com amakhilogremu angawona anombala ophansi kakhulu. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi angama-hydrocarbon ahlanganisa kakhulu amabhondi e-carbon–carbon noma i-carbon–hydrogen angewona aphansi kakhulu. Ama-molecule angewona ama-polar ahlala e-hydrophobic (esaba amanzi), noma awancibiliki emanzini. Ama-lipid enza imisebenzi eminingi ehlukene esitokisini. Amaseli agcina amandla okusetshenziswa isikhathi eside ngesimo samafutha. Ama-lipid aphinde ahlinzeke ngokuvikela izitshalo nezilwane (Isithombe 3.13). Isibonelo, isimo sawo sokungathandi amanzi singasiza ukugcina izinyoni zasemanzini nezilwane ezincelisayo zomile ngokwenza ungqimba oluvikelayo phezu koboya noma izimpaphe. Ama-lipid nawo ayizakhi zama-hormone amaningi futhi ayisici esibalulekile sazo zonke izingqimba zamaseli. Ama-lipid afaka amafutha, ama-waxes, ama-phospholipid, nama-steroids.

 I-molecule yamafutha iqukethe izingxenye ezimbili eziyinhloko—i-glycerol nama-fatty acid. I-Glycerol iyinhlanganisela yezinto eziphilayo (utshwala) enama-carbon amathathu, ama-hydrogen amahlanu, namaqembu amathathu e-hydroxyl (OH). Ama-fatty acid anochungechunge olude lwama-hydrocarbon lapho kunamathiselwe khona iqembu le-carboxyl, yingakho igama libizwa ngokuthi i-fatty acid.” Inani lama-carbon ku-fatty acid lingasukela ku-4 kuya ku-36; Ezivame kakhulu yilezo eziqukethe amakhabhoni angu-12-18. Ku-molecule yamafutha, ama-fatty acid anamathele ku-carbon ngayinye yamathathu e-glycerol molecule enesibopho se-ester nge-athomu ye-oxygen (Isithombe 3.14).

 Ngesikhathi sokwakheka kwesibopho se-ester, kukhishwa ama-molecule amathathu amanzi. Ama-fatty acid amathathu ku-triacylglycerol angase afane noma angafani. Amafutha abizwa nangokuthi ama-triacylglycerols noma ama-triglycerides ngenxa yesakhiwo sawo samakhemikhali. Amanye ama-fatty acid anamagama avamile achaza imvelaphi yawo. Isibonelo, i-palmitic acid, i-fatty acid egcwalisiwe, itholakala emthini wesundu. I-Arachidic acid itholakala ku-Arachis hypogea, igama lesayensi lamantongomane noma amantongomane.

 Ama-fatty acid angase agcwaliswe noma angagcwalisiwe. Ku-fatty acid chain, uma kunezibopho ezilodwa kuphela phakathi kwama-carbon angomakhelwane ku-hydrocarbon chain, i-fatty acid kuthiwa igcwalisiwe. Ama-fatty acid agcwalisiwe agcwaliswe nge-hydrogen; Ngamanye amazwi, inani lama-athomu e-hydrogen anamathele ku-carbon skeleton liyandiswa kakhulu. I-Stearic acid iyisibonelo se-saturated fatty acid (Isithombe 3.15).

 Uma uchungechunge lwe-hydrocarbon lune-double bond, kuthiwa i-fatty acid ayi-unsaturated. I-oleic acid iyisibonelo se-unsaturated fatty acid (Isithombe 3.16).

 Amafutha amaningi angasaturated alula emazingeni okushisa asekamelweni futhi abizwa ngamafutha. Uma kukhona i-double bond eyodwa ku-molecule, khona-ke yaziwa njengamafutha angasaturated (isb., uwoyela womnqumo), futhi uma kune-double bond engaphezu kweyodwa, khona-ke yaziwa njengamafutha angasaturated (isb., uwoyela we-canola).

 Uma i-fatty acid ingenabo i-double bonds, yaziwa njenge-saturated fatty acid ngoba akukho hydrogen eyengeziwe engangezwa kuma-athomu e-carbon e-chain. Amafutha angase aqukathe ama-fatty acid afanayo noma ahlukene anamathele ku-glycerol. Ama-fatty acid amade aqondile anezibopho ezilodwa avame ukupakishwa ngokuqinile futhi aqinile ekamelweni lokushisa. Amafutha ezilwane ane-stearic acid kanye ne-palmitic acid (evamile enyameni) kanye namafutha ane-butyric acid (evamile ebhotela) ayizibonelo zamafutha agcwele. Izilwane ezincelisayo zigcina amafutha kumaseli akhethekile abizwa ngokuthi ama-adipocytes, lapho ama-globules amafutha ethatha ingxenye enkulu yomthamo weseli. Ezitshalweni, amafutha noma uwoyela agcinwa ezinhlanyelweni eziningi futhi asetshenziswa njengomthombo wamandla ngesikhathi sokukhula kwezithombo. Amafutha noma uwoyela ongagcwalisiwe ngokuvamile avela ezitshalweni futhi aqukethe ama-cis unsaturated fatty acid. I-Cis kanye ne-trans zibonisa ukwakheka kwe-molecule ezungeze isibopho esiphindwe kabili. Uma ama-hydrogen ekhona endizeni efanayo, kubizwa ngokuthi amafutha e-cis; uma ama-athomu e-hydrogen esezindizeni ezimbili ezihlukene, kubizwa ngokuthi amafutha e-trans. Isibopho esiphindwe kabili se-cis sibangela ukugoba noma ukugoba” okuvimbela ama-fatty acid ukuthi angapaki kahle, okuwagcina emanzi ekamelweni lokushisa (Isithombe 3.17). Amafutha omnqumo, uwoyela wommbila, uwoyela we-canola, kanye namafutha esibindi se-cod kuyizibonelo zamafutha angagcwali. Amafutha angagcwali asiza ukwehlisa amazinga e-cholesterol egazini kanti amafutha agcwali angase abe nomthelela ekwakhekeni kwe-plaque emithanjeni yegazi.

Embonini yokudla, amafutha afakwa i-hydrogen yokwenziwa ukuze aqine kancane futhi abe nokuvumelana okufiselekayo emikhiqizweni eminingi yokudla okucutshungulwayo. Kalula nje, igesi ye-hydrogen ifakwa emafutheni ukuze iqine. Phakathi nale nqubo ye-hydrogenation, izibopho ezimbili ze-cis-conformation ku-hydrocarbon chain zingaguqulwa zibe izibopho ezimbili ku-trans-conformation.

 I-Margarine, ezinye izinhlobo zebhotela lamantongomane, kanye nokufinyeza kuyizibonelo zamafutha e-trans afakwe i-hydrogen yokwenziwa. Izifundo zakamuva zibonise ukuthi ukwanda kwamafutha e-trans ekudleni kwabantu kungaholela ekwandeni kwamazinga e-low-density lipoproteins (LDL), noma i-cholesterol embi, okungaholela ekubekweni kwe-plaque emithanjeni yegazi, okuholela esifweni senhliziyo. Izindawo zokudlela eziningi zokudla okusheshayo zisanda kuvimbela ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha e-trans, futhi amalebula okudla ayadingeka ukuze kuboniswe okuqukethwe kwamafutha e-trans.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Ama-Lipid angu-3.3 | Amafutha Namafutha | Ama-Omega Fatty Acids
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.3 Lipids | Fats and Oils | Omega Fatty Acids
chapterContent:
Ama-fatty acid abalulekile angama-fatty acid adingekayo kodwa awakhiqizwa ngumzimba womuntu. Ngenxa yalokho, kufanele afakwe ngokudla. Ama-fatty acid e-Omega-3 (njengalawo aboniswe kuMfanekiso 3.18) awela kulesi sigaba futhi angenye yama-fatty acid amabili kuphela aziwa ngabantu (enye iyi-fatty acid e-omega-6). Lawa angama-fatty acid e-polyunsaturated futhi abizwa ngokuthi i-omega-3 ngoba ikhabhoni yesithathu evela ekugcineni kochungechunge lwe-hydrocarbon ixhunywe ku-carbon eseduze nayo ngesibopho esiphindwe kabili.

 Ikhabhoni ekude kakhulu neqembu le-carboxyl ibalwa njengekhabhoni ye-omega (ω), futhi uma isibopho esiphindwe kabili siphakathi kwekhabhoni yesithathu neyesine kusukela kuleyo njongo, yaziwa njenge-fatty acid e-omega-3. Okubaluleke kakhulu ngokomsoco ngoba umzimba awuzenzi, ama-fatty acid e-omega-3 afaka i-alpha-linoleic acid (ALA), i-eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA), kanye ne-docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), konke okuyi-polyunsaturated. I-Salmon, i-trout, kanye ne-tuna kuyimithombo emihle yama-fatty acid e-omega-3. Ucwaningo lubonisa ukuthi ama-omega-3 fatty acid anciphisa ingozi yokufa ngokuzumayo ngenxa yokuhlaselwa yinhliziyo, anciphise ama-triglycerides egazini, anciphise umfutho wegazi, futhi avimbele i-thrombosis ngokuvimbela ukujiya kwegazi. Aphinde anciphise ukuvuvukala, futhi angasiza ekunciphiseni ingozi yeminye imidlavuza ezilwaneni.

 Njengama-carbohydrate, amafutha athole ukudalulwa okubi kakhulu. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi ukudla ukudla okuthosiwe ngokweqile kanye nokunye ukudla okunamafutha kuholela ekuzuzeni isisindo. Kodwa-ke, amafutha anemisebenzi ebalulekile. Amavithamini amaningi ayancibilika emafutheni, futhi amafutha asebenza njengendlela yokugcina ama-fatty acid isikhathi eside: umthombo wamandla. Aphinde ahlinzeke ngokuvikela umzimba. Ngakho-ke, amafutha anempilo ngamanani aphakathi kufanele adliwe njalo

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | 3.3 Ama-Lipid | Amafutha Namafutha | Ama-Phospholipid
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.3 Lipids | Fats and Oils | Phospholipids
chapterContent:
Ama-phospholipid ayizinto ezibalulekile ze-plasma membrane, ungqimba olungaphandle lwawo wonke amaseli aphilayo. Njengamafutha, akhiwe ngamaketanga e-fatty acid axhunywe kumgogodla we-glycerol noma we-sphingosine. Esikhundleni sama-fatty acid amathathu axhunywe njengakuma-triglycerides, nokho, kune-fatty acid ezimbili ezakha i-diacylglycerol, kanti ikhabhoni yesithathu yomgogodla we-glycerol ihlalwa yiqembu le-phosphate eliguquliwe (Isithombe 3.20). Iqembu le-phosphate lodwa elixhunywe ku-diacylglycerol alifaneleki njenge-phospholipid; liyi-phosphatidate (diacylglycerol 3-phosphate), eyandulela ama-phospholipid. Iqembu le-phosphate liguqulwa yi-alcohol. I-Phosphatidylcholine kanye ne-phosphatidylserine yi-phospholipids ezimbili ezibalulekile ezitholakala kuma-plasma membranes.

 I-phospholipid iyi-molecule ye-amphipathic, okusho ukuthi inengxenye ye-hydrophobic kanye ne-hydrophilic. Amaketanga e-fatty acid awakwazi ukusebenzisana namanzi, kanti iqembu eliqukethe i-phosphate lithanda ukusebenzisana namanzi futhi lisebenzisana namanzi (Isithombe 3.21).

 Ikhanda liyingxenye ethanda ukusebenzisana namanzi, kanti umsila uqukethe ama-fatty acid angathandi ukusebenzisana namanzi. Kulwelwesi, ungqimba lwe-bili yama-phospholipids lwakha i-matrix yesakhiwo, imisila ye-fatty acid yama-phospholipids ibheke ngaphakathi, kude namanzi, kanti iqembu le-phosphate libheke ohlangothini lwamanzi olungaphandle (Isithombe 3.21).

 Ama-Phospholipids anesibopho semvelo eguquguqukayo yelwelwesi le-plasma. Uma ithonsi le-phospholipids lifakwa emanzini, lakha ngokuzenzekelayo isakhiwo esaziwa ngokuthi i-micelle, lapho amakhanda e-hydrophilic phosphate ebheke ngaphandle futhi ama-fatty acid ebheke ngaphakathi kwalesi sakhiwo.

 Ukuxhumana Kwansuku Zonke Kwezifundo ze-AP®
Bheka Isithombe 3.22. Amafutha angama-molecule ahlala emanzini. Ngamanye amazwi, umsila omude we-hydrocarbon awuthandi amanzi, kanti ingxenye ye-glycerol ye-molecule ayithandi amanzi. Uma isemanzini, amafutha azohlela abe yibhola elibizwa ngokuthi i-micelle ukuze amakhanda athanda amanzi abe sendaweni engaphandle, kanti imisila ethanda amanzi ibe ngaphakathi lapho ivikeleke khona emanzini azungezile.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | 3.3 Ama-Lipid | Amafutha Namafutha | Ama-Steroids
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.3 Lipids | Fats and Oils | Steroids
chapterContent:
Ngokungafani nama-phospholipid namafutha okukhulunywe ngawo ngaphambili, ama-steroid anesakhiwo sendandatho ehlanganisiwe. Nakuba engafani namanye ama-lipid, ahlanganiswe nawo ngoba nawo awakwazi ukungena emanzini futhi awancibiliki emanzini. Wonke ama-steroid anezindandatho ezine zekhabhoni ezixhunyiwe futhi eziningana zazo, njenge-cholesterol, zinomsila omfushane (Isithombe 3.23). Ama-steroid amaningi nawo aneqembu elisebenzayo le--OH, eliwabeka esigabeni sotshwala (ama-sterol).

 I-cholesterol iyi-steroid evame kakhulu. I-cholesterol yenziwa kakhulu esibindini futhi iyisandulela sama-hormone amaningi e-steroid njenge-testosterone ne-estradiol, akhishwa yi-gonads kanye nezindlala ze-endocrine. Futhi iyisandulela se-Vitamin D. I-cholesterol nayo iyisandulela se-bile salts, esiza ekuhlanganiseni amafutha kanye nokumuncwa kwawo okulandelayo ngamaseli. Nakuba i-cholesterol ivame ukukhulunywa ngayo ngamagama amabi ngabantu abavamile, iyadingeka ekusebenzeni kahle komzimba. Iyingxenye ye-plasma membrane yamaseli ezilwane futhi itholakala ngaphakathi kwe-phospholipid bilayer. Njengoba iyisakhiwo esingaphandle kakhulu emangqamuzaneni ezilwane, i-plasma membrane inesibopho sokuthuthwa kwezinto kanye nokuqashelwa kwamaseli futhi ihilelekile ekuxhumaneni kweseli neseli.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | 3.4 Amaprotheni | Ukuxhumana Kwezifundo ze-AP®
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.4 Proteins | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Amaprotheni ayimiketanga emide yezindlela ezahlukene zama-amino acid angu-20 ngalinye eliqukethe iqembu lama-amino (-NH2), iqembu le-carboxyl (-COOH), kanye neqembu eliguquguqukayo. (Cabanga ngokuthi mangaki amagama eprotheni angenziwa ngezinhlamvu zama-amino acid angu-20). I-amino acid ngayinye ixhunyaniswe nomakhelwane wayo ngesibopho se-peptide esakhiwe ukusabela kokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni. Uchungechunge olude lwama-amino acid lwaziwa ngokuthi i-polypeptide. Amaprotheni akhonza imisebenzi eminingi emaseli. Asebenza njengama-enzyme avuselela ukusabela kwamakhemikhali, anikeze ukwesekwa kwesakhiwo, alawule ukudlula kwezinto kulo lonke ulwelwesi lweseli, avikele ezifweni, futhi axhumanise izindlela zokubonisana kwamaseli. Isakhiwo samaphrotheni sihlelwe emazingeni amane: okuyinhloko, okwesibili, okwesithathu, kanye nokwe-quaternary. Isakhiwo esiyinhloko ukulandelana okuhlukile kwama-amino acid. Ushintsho ku-amino acid eyodwa kuphela lungashintsha isakhiwo nomsebenzi weprotheni. Isibonelo, i-sickle cell anemia ibangelwa ukufakwa kwe-amino acid eyodwa kuphela kumolekyuli ye-hemoglobin equkethe ama-amino acid angu-574. Isakhiwo sesibili siqukethe ukugoqwa kwendawo kwe-polypeptide ngokwakhiwa kwesibopho se-hydrogen; okuholela ekubumbeni kweshidi eligobile le-α helix kanye ne-β. Esimweni sesithathu, ukusebenzisana okuhlukahlukene, isib. izibopho ze-hydrogen, izibopho ze-ionic, izixhumanisi ze-disulfide, kanye nokusebenzisana kwe-hydrophobic phakathi kwamaqembu e-R, kunegalelo ekugoqweni kwe-polypeptide ibe yizimo ezahlukene zezinhlangothi ezintathu. Ama-enzyme amaningi asesimweni sesithathu. Uma iphrotheni iguquliwe, ilahlekelwa ukuma kwayo kwezinhlangothi ezintathu, ingase ingasasebenzi. Izimo zemvelo ezifana nokushisa kanye ne-pH zingaguquguqula amaprotheni. Amanye amaprotheni, njenge-hemoglobin, akhiwa ngama-polypeptide amaningana, futhi ukusebenzisana kwala ma-subunit kwakha isakhiwo se-quaternary samaprotheni.

 Ulwazi oluveziwe kanye nezibonelo eziqokonyiswe esigabeni, imiqondo yokusekela kanye nezinhloso zokufunda ezichazwe ku-Big Idea 4 yohlaka lwekharikhulamu ye-AP® Biology. Izinhloso zokufunda ezibalwe kuhlaka lwekharikhulamu zinikeza isisekelo esicacile senkambo ye-AP® Biology, ulwazi lwelabhorethri olusekelwe ekuphenyweni, imisebenzi yokufundisa, kanye nemibuzo yokuhlolwa kwe-AP®. chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | 3.4 Amaprotheni | Izinhlobo Nemisebenzi Yamaprotheni
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.4 Proteins | Types and Functions of Proteins
chapterContent:
Amaprotheni angenye yama-molecule amaningi kakhulu ezinto eziphilayo ezinhlelweni eziphilayo futhi anemisebenzi eyahlukahlukene kakhulu yawo wonke ama-macromolecule. Amaprotheni angaba ngesakhiwo, aqondisayo, abambeke, noma avikele; angasebenza ekuthuthweni, ekugcinweni, noma ema-membrane; noma angaba ubuthi noma ama-enzyme. Iseli ngalinye ohlelweni oluphilayo lingaqukatha izinkulungwane zamaprotheni, ngalinye linomsebenzi ohlukile. Izakhiwo zawo, njengemisebenzi yawo, ziyahlukahluka kakhulu. Nokho, wonke angama-polymer ama-amino acid, ahlelwe ngokulandelana okuqondile.

 Ama-enzyme, akhiqizwa amaseli aphilayo, angama-catalyst ekusabeleni kwamakhemikhali (njengokugaya) futhi ngokuvamile angama-protein ayinkimbinkimbi noma ahlanganisiwe. I-enzyme ngayinye ikhethekile nge-substrate (i-reactant ebopha ku-enzyme) esebenza kuyo. I-enzyme ingasiza ekuqhekekeni, ekuhleleni kabusha, noma ekusabeleni. Ama-enzyme aphula ama-substrate awo abizwa ngokuthi ama-enzyme e-catabolic, ama-enzyme akha ama-molecule ayinkimbinkimbi kakhulu kusuka kuma-substrate awo abizwa ngokuthi ama-enzyme e-anabolic, kanti ama-enzyme athinta izinga lokusabela abizwa ngokuthi ama-enzyme e-catalytic. Kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi wonke ama-enzyme andisa izinga lokusabela, ngakho-ke, abhekwa njengama-catalysts e-organic. Isibonelo se-enzyme yi-salivary amylase, e-hydrolyze i-substrate yayo i-amylose, ingxenye yesitashi.

 Ama-hormone angama-molecule abonisa amakhemikhali, ngokuvamile amaprotheni amancane noma ama-steroid, akhishwa amaseli e-endocrine asebenza ukulawula noma ukulawula izinqubo ezithile zomzimba, okuhlanganisa ukukhula, intuthuko, i-metabolism, kanye nokuzala. Isibonelo, i-insulin iyi-hormone yephrotheni esiza ukulawula izinga likashukela egazini. Izinhlobo eziyinhloko nemisebenzi yamaprotheni zibhalwe kuthebula elingezansi.

 Izinhlobo Nemisebenzi Yamaprotheni

 Uhlobo
Izibonelo
Imisebenzi

 Ama-Enzyme Okugaya
I-Amylase, i-lipase, i-pepsin, i-trypsin
Ukusiza ekugayweni kokudla ngokuguqula izakhamzimba zibe amayunithi e-monomeric

Nikeza ukudla okunempilo ekukhuleni kokuqala kwe-embryo kanye nembewu

 Amaprotheni anezimo ezahlukene kanye nesisindo sama-molecule; amanye amaprotheni anesimo esiyindilinga kanti amanye ane-fibrous ngokwemvelo. Isibonelo, i-hemoglobin iyiprotheni eyisiyingi, kodwa i-collagen, etholakala esikhumbeni sethu, iyiprotheni enemicu. Ukuma kweprotheni kubaluleke kakhulu ekusebenzeni kwayo, futhi lesi simo sigcinwa yizinhlobo eziningi ezahlukene zezibopho zamakhemikhali. Izinguquko ekushiseni, i-pH, kanye nokuchayeka kumakhemikhali kungaholela ezinguqukweni ezihlala njalo esimweni seprotheni, okuholela ekulahlekelweni komsebenzi, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-denaturation. Wonke amaprotheni akhiwe ngezinhlelo ezahlukene zezinhlobo ezingama-20 zama-amino acid ezivame kakhulu.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | 3.4 Amaprotheni | Ama-Amino Acids
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.4 Proteins | Amino Acids
chapterContent:
Ama-amino acid yiwona ama-monomer akha amaprotheni. I-amino acid ngayinye inesakhiwo esifanayo esiyisisekelo, esakhiwa i-athomu yekhabhoni ephakathi, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-alpha (α) carbon, ehlanganiswe neqembu lama-amino (NH2), iqembu le-carboxyl (COOH), kanye ne-athomu ye-hydrogen. I-amino acid ngayinye inenye i-athomu noma iqembu lama-athomu elihlanganiswe ne-athomu ephakathi eyaziwa ngokuthi iqembu le-R (Isithombe 3.24).

 Igama elithi amino acid lisuselwa eqinisweni lokuthi aqukethe iqembu lama-amino kanye neqembu le-carboxyl-acid esakhiweni sawo esiyisisekelo. Njengoba kushiwo, kune-amino acids ezivamile ezingama-20 ezikhona kumaprotheni. Eziyisishiyagalolunye zalezi zibhekwa njenge-amino acid ebalulekile kubantu ngoba umzimba womuntu awukwazi ukuzikhiqiza futhi zitholakala ekudleni. Ku-amino acid ngayinye, iqembu le-R (noma uchungechunge oluseceleni) lihlukile (Isithombe 3.25).

 Uhlobo lwamakhemikhali lochungechunge oluseceleni lunquma uhlobo lwe-amino acid (okungukuthi, ukuthi i-acidic, i-basic, i-polar, noma i-nonpolar). Isibonelo, i-amino acid i-glycine ine-athomu ye-hydrogen njengeqembu le-R. Ama-amino acid afana ne-valine, i-methionine, ne-alanine awayona i-polar noma i-hydrophobic ngokwemvelo, kuyilapho ama-amino acid afana ne-serine, i-threonine, ne-cysteine e-polar futhi ane-side chains hydrophilic. Ama-side chains e-lysine ne-arginine ashajeke kahle, ngakho-ke lawa ma-amino acid aziwa nangokuthi ama-amino acid ayisisekelo. I-Proline ineqembu le-R elixhunywe eqenjini lama-amino, lakha isakhiwo esifana nendandatho. I-Proline ihlukile esakhiweni esijwayelekile se-animo acid njengoba iqembu layo lama-amino lingahlukile ku-side chain (Isithombe 3.25).

 Ama-amino acid amelelwa uhlamvu olulodwa oluphezulu noma isifinyezo sezinhlamvu ezintathu. Isibonelo, i-valine yaziwa ngohlamvu V noma uphawu lwezinhlamvu ezintathu i-val. Njengoba nje amanye ama-fatty acid ebalulekile ekudleni, amanye ama-amino acid nawo ayadingeka. Aziwa ngokuthi ama-amino acid abalulekile, futhi kubantu afaka i-isoleucine, i-leucine, kanye ne-cysteine. Ama-amino acid abalulekile abhekisela kulawo adingekayo ekwakheni amaprotheni emzimbeni, yize engakhiqizwa ngumzimba; ukuthi yimaphi ama-amino acid abalulekile ahlukahluka kuye ngomzimba.

 Ukulandelana kanye nenani lama-amino acid ekugcineni kunquma ukuma, usayizi, kanye nomsebenzi wamaprotheni. I-amino acid ngayinye inamathele kwenye i-amino acid ngesibopho se-covalent, esaziwa ngokuthi isibopho se-peptide, esakhiwa ukusabela kokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni. Iqembu le-carboxyl le-amino acid eyodwa kanye neqembu lama-amino le-amino acid engenayo ziyahlangana, zikhipha i-molecule yamanzi. Isibopho esiphumelayo yisibopho se-peptide (Isithombe 3.26).

 Imikhiqizo eyakhiwe yizixhumanisi ezinjalo ibizwa ngokuthi ama-peptide. Njengoba ama-amino acid amaningi ehlangana nalolu chungechunge olukhulayo, uchungechunge oluphumelayo lwaziwa ngokuthi i-polypeptide. I-polypeptide ngayinye ineqembu lama-amino lamahhala ekugcineni. Lesi siphetho sibizwa ngokuthi i-N terminal, noma i-amino terminal, kanti esinye isiphetho sineqembu le-carboxyl yamahhala, elaziwa nangokuthi i-C noma i-carboxyl terminal. Ngenkathi amagama athi i-polypeptide kanye ne-protein ngezinye izikhathi esetshenziswa ngokushintshana, i-polypeptide ngobuchwepheshe iyi-polymer yama-amino acid, kanti igama elithi i-protein lisetshenziselwa i-polypeptide noma ama-polypeptide ahlangene ndawonye, avame ukubopha amaqembu okufakelwa angewona ama-peptide, anesimo esihlukile, futhi anomsebenzi oyingqayizivele. Ngemva kokwenziwa kwamaprotheni (ukuhumusha), amaprotheni amaningi ayaguqulwa. Lawa aziwa ngokuthi ukuguqulwa kwangemva kokuhumusha. Angase ahlukaniswe noma ahlukaniswe, noma angadinga ukwengezwa kwamanye amaqembu amakhemikhali. Kuphela ngemva kwalokhu kuguqulwa lapho i-protein isebenza ngokuphelele.

 Ukuxhumana Kokuziphendukela Kwemvelo
Ukubaluleka Kokuziphendukela Kwemvelo kwe-Cytochrome c
I-Cytochrome c iyisici esibalulekile seketanga lokuthuthwa kwama-electron, ingxenye yokuphefumula kwamaseli, futhi ivame ukutholakala ku-organelle yeselula, i-mitochondrion. Le phrotheni ineqembu le-heme prosthetic, kanti i-ion ephakathi ye-heme incishiswa futhi i-oxidized ngokushintshana ngesikhathi sokudluliselwa kwama-electron. Ngenxa yokuthi indima yale phrotheni ebalulekile ekukhiqizeni amandla eseli ibalulekile, ishintshe kancane kakhulu eminyakeni eyizigidi. Ukulandelana kwamaprotheni kukhombisile ukuthi kunenani elikhulu le-cytochrome c amino acid sequence homology phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene; ngamanye amazwi, ubudlelwano bokuziphendukela kwemvelo bungahlolwa ngokulinganisa ukufana noma umehluko phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-DNA noma i-protein sequences.

 Ososayensi bathole ukuthi i-cytochrome c yomuntu iqukethe ama-amino acid angu-104. Ku-molecule ngayinye ye-cytochrome c evela ezintweni eziphilayo ezahlukene ezibe zilandelanisiwe kuze kube manje, ama-amino acid angu-37 abonakala endaweni efanayo kuzo zonke izibonelo ze-cytochrome c. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi kwakukhona ukhokho ofanayo. Uma kuqhathaniswa ukulandelana kwamaprotheni omuntu nowe-chimpanzee, akukho mehluko wokulandelana owatholakala. Lapho kuqhathaniswa ukulandelana kwamaprotheni omuntu nowe-rhesus, umehluko owodwa owatholakala wawuku-amino acid eyodwa. Kokunye ukuqhathanisa, ukulandelana kwemvubelo komuntu kukhombisa umehluko endaweni yama-44

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | 3.4 Amaprotheni | Isakhiwo Samaprotheni (esiyinhloko, esesibili, esesithathu, ese-quaternary)
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.4 Proteins | Protein Structure (primary, secondary, tertiary, quaternary)
chapterContent:
Njengoba kuxoxwe ngakho ngaphambilini, ukuma kweprotheyini kubalulekile emsebenzini wayo. Isibonelo, i-enzyme ingabopha i-substrate ethile endaweni eyaziwa ngokuthi indawo esebenzayo. Uma le ndawo esebenzayo ishintshwa ngenxa yezinguquko zendawo noma izinguquko esakhiweni seprotheyini iyonke, i-enzyme ingase ingakwazi ukubopha i-substrate. Ukuze siqonde ukuthi iprotheyini ithola kanjani isimo sayo sokugcina noma ukwakheka kwayo, sidinga ukuqonda amazinga amane esakhiwo seprotheyini: eyinhloko, yesibili, yesithathu, kanye ne-quaternary.

 Isakhiwo Esiyinhloko
Ukulandelana okuyingqayizivele kwama-amino acid ku-polypeptide chain kuyisakhiwo sayo esiyinhloko. Isibonelo, i-pancreatic hormone insulin inamaketanga amabili e-polypeptide, u-A no-B, futhi axhunyaniswa ndawonye ngamaketanga e-disulfide. I-N terminal amino acid ye-A chain yi-glycine, kanti i-C terminal amino acid iyi-asparagine (Isithombe 3.27). Ukulandelana kwama-amino acid kumaketanga e-A no-B kuhlukile ku-insulin.

 Ukulandelana okuhlukile kweprotheyini ngayinye ekugcineni kunqunywa yi-gene efaka ikhodi kuprotheyini. Ushintsho ochungechungeni lwe-nucleotide lwesifunda sokubhala ikhodi yezakhi zofuzo lungaholela ekufakweni kwe-amino acid ehlukile kuchungechunge lwe-polypeptide olukhulayo, okubangela ushintsho esakhiweni nasekusebenzeni kweprotheyini. Ku-sickle cell anemia, uchungechunge lwe-hemoglobin β (ingxenye encane yalo eboniswe kuMfanekiso 3.28) lunokufakwa kwe-amino acid eyodwa, okubangela ushintsho esakhiweni nasekusebenzeni kweprotheyini. Ngokukhethekile, i-amino acid glutamic acid ithathelwa indawo yi-valine kuchungechunge lwe-β. Okuphawuleka kakhulu okufanele kucatshangelwe ukuthi i-molecule ye-hemoglobin yakhiwe ngamaketanga amabili e-alpha kanye namaketanga amabili e-beta ngalinye elinama-amino acid angaba ngu-150. Ngakho-ke, i-molecule inama-amino acid angaba ngu-600. Umehluko wesakhiwo phakathi kwe-molecule evamile ye-hemoglobin kanye ne-molecule ye-sickle cell—enciphisa kakhulu isikhathi sokuphila—yi-amino acid eyodwa yama-600. Okuphawuleka nakakhulu ukuthi lawo ma-amino acid angu-600 afakwe ama-nucleotide amathathu ngalinye, futhi ukuguqulwa kubangelwa ushintsho olulodwa lwesisekelo (ukuguqulwa kwamaphuzu), isisekelo esisodwa kwezingu-1800.

 Ngenxa yalolu shintsho lwe-amino acid eyodwa ku-chain, ama-molecule e-hemoglobin akha imicu emide ephambukisa amangqamuzana abomvu egazi abizwa ngokuthi i-biconcave, noma amise okwe-disc, futhi abangele ukuthi athathe isimo se-crescent noma i-sickle”, okuvala imithambo yegazi (Isithombe 3.29). Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni eziningi zempilo ezingathi sína njengokuphelelwa umoya, isiyezi, ikhanda elibuhlungu, kanye nobuhlungu besisu kulabo abathintekile yilesi sifo.

 Isakhiwo Sesibili
Ukugoqeka kwendawo kwe-polypeptide kwezinye izindawo kubangela isakhiwo sesibili seprotheyini. Okuvame kakhulu yizakhiwo zeshidi le-α-helix kanye ne-β-pleated (Isithombe 3.30). Zombili izakhiwo zibanjwe ndawonye ngezibopho ze-hydrogen. Esakhiweni se-α-helix, izibopho ze-hydrogen zakha phakathi kwe-athomu ye-oxygen eqenjini le-carbonyl ku-amino acid eyodwa kanye nenye i-amino acid engama-amino acid amane kude nochungechunge.

 Ukujika ngakunye kwe-helical ku-alpha helix kunezinsalela ze-amino acid ezingu-3.6. Amaqembu e-R (amaqembu ahlukahlukene) e-polypeptide aphuma ku- uchungechunge lwe-α-helix. Eshidini elinezimbobo ze-β, izimbobo zakhiwa ngokubopha kwe-hydrogen phakathi kwama-athomu emhlane we-polypeptide chain. Amaqembu e-R anamathele kuma-carbon futhi anwebeka ngaphezulu nangaphansi kwezimbobo ze-pleat. Izingxenye ezinezimbobo ziqondanisa ngokulingana noma ngokungahambisani, futhi izibopho ze-hydrogen zakha phakathi kwe-athomu ye-hydrogen ene-partial positive eqenjini lama-amino kanye ne-partial negative oxygen athomu eqenjini le-carbonyl lomgogodla we-peptide. Izakhiwo zeshidi ze-α-helix kanye ne-β-pleated zitholakala kumaprotheni amaningi e-globular kanye ne-fibrous futhi zidlala indima ebalulekile yokwakha.

 Isakhiwo Sesithathu
Isakhiwo esiyingqayizivele esinezimbobo ezintathu se-polypeptide yisakhiwo sayo sesithathu (Isithombe 3.31). Lesi sakhiwo sibangelwa ngokwengxenye ukusebenzisana kwamakhemikhali okusebenza kuchungechunge lwe-polypeptide. Ngokuyinhloko, ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamaqembu e-R kudala isakhiwo sesithathu esiyinkimbinkimbi seprotheyini. Uhlobo lwamaqembu e-R atholakala kuma-amino acid ahilelekile lungamelana nokwakheka kwezibopho ze-hydrogen ezichazwe ezakhiweni zesibili ezijwayelekile. Isibonelo, amaqembu e-R anamacala afanayo ayaxoshwana futhi lawo anamacala angafani ayakhangwa (izibopho ze-ionic). Lapho kwenzeka ukugoqwa kwamaprotheni, amaqembu e-R angama-hydrophobic ama-amino acid angewona ama-polar ahlala ngaphakathi kweprotheyini, kuyilapho amaqembu e-R angama-hydrophilic alala ngaphandle. Izinhlobo zangaphambili zokuxhumana zaziwa nangokuthi ukuhlangana kwama-hydrophobic. Ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamaketanga aseceleni e-cysteine kwakha ukuxhumana kwe-disulfide lapho kukhona umoya-mpilo, okuwukuphela kwesibopho se-covalent esakha ngesikhathi sokugoqwa kwamaprotheni.

 Konke lokhu kuxhumana, okubuthakathaka futhi okunamandla, kunquma ukuma kokugcina kweprotheyini okunezinhlangothi ezintathu. Lapho iphrotheyini ilahlekelwa ukuma kwayo okunezinhlangothi ezintathu, ingase ingasasebenzi.

 Isakhiwo Se-Quaternary
Ngokwemvelo, amanye amaprotheni akhiwa ngama-polypeptide amaningana, aziwa nangokuthi ama-subunit, futhi ukusebenzisana kwala ma-subunit kwakha isakhiwo se-quaternary. Ukusebenzisana okubuthakathaka phakathi kwama-subunit kusiza ekuqiniseni isakhiwo sonke. Isibonelo, i-insulin (iphrotheni eyisiyingi) inenhlanganisela yezibopho ze-hydrogen kanye nezibopho ze-disulfide ezibangela ukuthi ihlanganiswe kakhulu ibe yisimo sebhola. I-insulin iqala njenge-polypeptide eyodwa futhi ilahlekelwa ezinye izilandelaniso zangaphakathi lapho kukhona ukuguqulwa kwangemva kokuhumusha ngemuva kokwakheka kwezixhumanisi ze-disulfide ezibamba izintambo ezisele ndawonye. Nokho, isilika (iphrotheni enezintambo), inesakhiwo seshidi esinezingxenyana ze-β esiwumphumela wokubopha kwe-hydrogen phakathi kwezintambo ezahlukene.

chapterContent:
Iphrotheni ngayinye inokulandelana kwayo okuhlukile kanye nesimo sayo esibanjwe ndawonye ngokusebenzisana kwamakhemikhali. Uma iphrotheni ingashintsha ekushiseni, izinguquko ku-pH, noma ukuchayeka kumakhemikhali, isakhiwo sephrotheni singashintsha, silahlekelwe isimo saso ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa ukulandelana kwayo okuyinhloko kulokho okwaziwa ngokuthi i-denaturation. I-denaturation ivame ukuguqulwa ngoba isakhiwo esiyinhloko se-polypeptide sigcinwa kule nqubo uma i-denaturation agent isusiwe, okuvumela iphrotheni ukuthi iqale kabusha umsebenzi wayo. Ngezinye izikhathi i-denaturation ayinakuguqulwa, okuholela ekulahlekelweni komsebenzi. Isibonelo esisodwa se-denaturation yephrotheni engenakuguqulwa yilapho iqanda lithosiwe. Iphrotheni ye-albumin ku-egg white ewuketshezi iyaguqulwa uma ifakwa epanini elishisayo. Akuwona wonke amaprotheni aguqulwa emazingeni okushisa aphezulu; isibonelo, amabhaktheriya asinda emithonjeni eshisayo anamaprotheni asebenza emazingeni okushisa aseduze nokubila. Isisu siphinde sibe ne-acid kakhulu, sine-pH ephansi, kanye namaprotheni aguqulwa njengengxenye yenqubo yokugaya; noma kunjalo, ama-enzyme okugaya esiswini agcina umsebenzi wawo ngaphansi kwalezi zimo.

 Ukugoqa amaprotheni kubalulekile emsebenzini wawo. Ekuqaleni kwakucatshangwa ukuthi amaprotheni ngokwawo ayenesibopho senqubo yokugoqa. Muva nje kutholakale ukuthi avame ukuthola usizo enqubweni yokugoqa kubasizi bamaprotheni abaziwa ngokuthi ama-chaperones (noma ama-chaperonin) ahlotshaniswa neprotheyini eqondiwe ngesikhathi senqubo yokugoqa. Asebenza ngokuvimbela ukuhlangana kwama-polypeptide akha isakhiwo esiphelele samaprotheni, futhi ayahlukana neprotheyini uma iprotheyini eqondiwe isigoqiwe.

chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.5 Nucleic Acids | Connection for AP® Courses
chapterContent:
Ama-Nucleic acid (i-DNA ne-RNA) akha iqembu lesine lama-macromolecule ebhayoloji futhi aqukethe i-phosphorus (P) ngaphezu kwe-carbon, i-hydrogen, i-oxygen, ne-nitrogen. Alondolozwe ngokuziphendukela kwemvelo kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo, ama-nucleic acid agcina futhi adlulisele ulwazi oluvela ku-gene. Njengoba kuzohlolwa kabanzi eZahlukweni 14-17, i-DNA iqukethe imiyalelo yokwenziwa kwamaprotheni ngokuyalela ukulandelana kwama-amino acid kuma-polypeptide ngezinqubo ezaziwa ngokuthi i-transcription and translation. Ama-nucleic acid akhiwa ama-nucleotide; wona, i-nucleotide ngayinye iqukethe ushukela we-pentose (i-deoxyribose ku-DNA kanye ne-ribose ku-RNA), isisekelo se-nitrogenous (i-adenine, i-cytosine, i-guanine, kanye ne-thymine noma i-uracil), kanye neqembu le-phosphate. I-DNA iphethe uhlelo lwezakhi zofuzo lweseli oludluliselwa kusuka kumzali kuya enzalweni ngokuhlukaniswa kweseli. I-DNA inesakhiwo esiphindwe kabili esinezintambo ezimbili ezigijima ngezindlela eziphambene (ezingafani), ezixhunywe yizibopho ze-hydrogen futhi ezihambisanayo. Ku-DNA, ama-purine ahambisana nama-pyrimidines: i-adenine ihambisana ne-thymine (A-T), kanti i-cytosine ihambisana ne-guanine (C-G). Ku-RNA, i-uracil ithatha indawo ye-thymine ukuze ihambisane ne-adenine (U-A). I-RNA nayo ihlukile ku-DNA ngoba ine-strand eyodwa futhi inezinhlobo eziningi, njenge-messenger RNA (mRNA), i-ribosomal RNA (rRNA), kanye ne-transfer RNA (tRNA) zonke ezihlanganyela ekwakhiweni kwamaprotheni. Ama-MicroRNA (ama-miRNA) alawula ukusetshenziswa kwe-mRNA. Ukugeleza kolwazi lwezakhi zofuzo ngokuvamile kuyi-DNA → RNA → protein, eyaziwa nangokuthi yi-Central Dogma of Life.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | Ama-Nucleic Acids angu-3.5 | I-DNA ne-RNA
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.5 Nucleic Acids | DNA and RNA
chapterContent:
Ama-Nucleic acid angama-macromolecule abaluleke kakhulu ekuqhubekeni kokuphila. Aphethe uhlelo lwezakhi zofuzo lweseli futhi aphethe imiyalelo yokusebenza kweseli.

 Izinhlobo ezimbili eziyinhloko zama-nucleic acid yi-deoxyribonucleic acid (i-DNA) kanye ne-ribonucleic acid (i-RNA). I-DNA iyinto yezakhi zofuzo etholakala kuzo zonke izinto eziphilayo, kusukela kubhaktheriya oneseli elilodwa kuya ezincelisayo eziningi. Itholakala ku-nucleus yama-eukaryotes kanye nama-organelles, ama-chloroplast, kanye ne-mitochondria. Kuma-prokaryotes, i-DNA ayivalelwe emvilophini we-membranous.

 Okuqukethwe kwezakhi zofuzo kweseli kwaziwa ngokuthi i-genome yayo, kanti ucwaningo lwama-genome luyi-genomics. Kumaseli e-eukaryotic kodwa hhayi kuma-prokaryotes, i-DNA yakha inhlanganisela enamaprotheni e-histone ukwakha i-chromatin, into yama-chromosome e-eukaryotic. I-chromosome ingaqukatha amashumi ezinkulungwane zama-gene. Ama-gene amaningi aqukethe ulwazi lokwenza imikhiqizo yamaprotheni; amanye ama-gene code emikhiqizo ye-RNA. I-DNA ilawula yonke imisebenzi yamaseli ngokuvula noma ukuvala izakhi zofuzo

Olunye uhlobo lwe-nucleic acid, i-RNA, luhileleke kakhulu ekwakhiweni kwamaprotheni. Ama-molecule e-DNA awalokothi asuke ku-nucleus kodwa kunalokho asebenzisa umlamuleli ukuxhumana nalo lonke iseli. Lo mlamuleli yi-messenger RNA (mRNA). Ezinye izinhlobo ze-RNA—njenge-rRNA, i-tRNA, kanye ne-microRNA—zihilelekile ekwakhiweni kwamaprotheni kanye nokulawulwa kwawo.

 I-DNA ne-RNA zakhiwe ngama-monomer aziwa ngokuthi ama-nucleotide. Ama-nucleotide ahlangana ukuze akhe i-polynucleotide, i-DNA noma i-RNA. I-nucleotide ngayinye yakhiwe yizingxenye ezintathu: isisekelo se-nitrogenous, ushukela we-pentose (i-carbon emihlanu), kanye neqembu le-phosphate (Isithombe 3.33). Isisekelo ngasinye se-nitrogenous ku-nucleotide sinamathele ku-molecule kashukela, enamathele eqenjini elilodwa noma ngaphezulu le-phosphate.

 Izisekelo ze-nitrogen, izingxenye ezibalulekile zama-nucleotide, zingama-molecule e-organic futhi zibizwa kanjalo ngoba ziqukethe ikhabhoni ne-nitrogen. Ziyizisekelo ngoba ziqukethe iqembu lama-amino elinamandla okubopha i-hydrogen eyengeziwe, ngaleyo ndlela kunciphisa ukugcwala kwama-ion e-hydrogen endaweni yayo, okwenza kube lula kakhulu. I-nucleotide ngayinye ku-DNA iqukethe esinye sezisekelo ezine ze-nitrogen ezingaba khona: i-adenine (A), i-guanine (G) i-cytosine (C), kanye ne-thymine (T).

 I-Adenine ne-guanine zihlukaniswa njenge-purine. Isakhiwo esiyinhloko se-purine yizindandatho ezimbili ze-carbon-nitrogen. I-Cytosine, i-thymine, kanye ne-uracil zihlukaniswa njenge-pyrimidines ezinendandatho eyodwa ye-carbon-nitrogen njengesakhiwo sazo esiyinhloko (Isithombe 3.33). Indandatho ngayinye yalezi zisekelo ze-carbon-nitrogen eziyisisekelo inamaqembu ahlukene asebenzayo anamathele kuyo. Ku-molecule biology, izisekelo ze-nitrogenous zaziwa kalula ngezimpawu zazo u-A, T, G, C, no-U. I-DNA iqukethe u-A, T, G, no-C kanti i-RNA iqukethe u-A, U, G, no-C.

 Ushukela we-pentose ku-DNA yi-deoxyribose, kanti ku-RNA, ushukela yi-ribose (Isithombe 3.33). Umehluko phakathi koshukela ukuba khona kweqembu le-hydroxyl ku-carbon yesibili ye-ribose kanye ne-hydrogen ku-carbon yesibili ye-deoxyribose. Ama-athomu ekhabhoni e-molecule kashukela abalwa ngo-1′, 2′, 3′, 4′, kanye no-5′ (1′ ifundwa njenge-prime eyodwa). I-phosphate residue inamathele eqenjini le-hydroxyl le-carbon engu-5′ yoshukela owodwa kanye neqembu le-hydroxyl le-carbon engu-3′ yoshukela we-nucleotide elandelayo, eyakha ukuxhumana kwe-phosphodiester okungu-5′–3′. Ukuxhumana kwe-phosphodiester akwenziwa ngokusabela okulula kokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni njengezinye izixhumanisi ezixhumanisa ama-monomers kuma-macromolecule: ukwakheka kwayo kuhilela ukususwa kwamaqembu amabili e-phosphate. I-polynucleotide ingaba nezinkulungwane zezixhumanisi ezinjalo ze-phosphodiester.

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ebhayoloji | Ama-Nucleic Acids angu-3.5 | Isakhiwo se-DNA Double-Helix
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.5 Nucleic Acids | DNA Double-Helix Structure
chapterContent:
I-DNA inesakhiwo se-double-helix (Isithombe 3.34). Ushukela ne-phosphate kulele ngaphandle kwe-helix, kwakha umgogodla we-DNA. Izisekelo ze-nitrogenous zibekwe ngaphakathi, njengezinyathelo zezitebhisi, ngamabili; amabhangqa aboshelwe komunye nomunye ngezibopho ze-hydrogen. Wonke amabhangqa esisekelo ku-double helix ahlukaniswe ne-base pair elandelayo ngo-0.34 nm. Izintambo ezimbili ze-helix zihamba ngezindlela eziphambene, okusho ukuthi ukuphela kwekhabhoni engu-5′ kwentambo eyodwa kuzobhekana ne-3′ carbon end yentambo yayo ehambisanayo. (Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukuqondiswa okungalingani futhi kubalulekile ekuphindaphindweni kwe-DNA kanye nasekusebenzisaneni okuningi kwe-nucleic acid.)

 Kuvunyelwe izinhlobo ezithile kuphela zokubhangqa kwesisekelo. Isibonelo, i-purine ethile ingabhangqana ne-pyrimidine ethile kuphela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-A can ibhangqana no-T, kanye no-G ingabhangqana no-C, njengoba kuboniswe ku-Figure 3.35. Lokhu kwaziwa njengomthetho ohambisanayo wesisekelo. Ngamanye amazwi, izintambo ze-DNA ziyahambisana. Uma ukulandelana kwentambo eyodwa kuyi-AATTGGCC, intambo ehambisanayo izoba nokulandelana kwe-TTAACCGG. Ngesikhathi sokuphindaphindwa kwe-DNA, intambo ngayinye iyakopishwa, okuholela ku-DNA yendodakazi ephindwe kabili equkethe intambo eyodwa ye-DNA yomzali kanye nentambo esanda kuhlanganiswa.
answer1: I-helix ephindwe kabili

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ebhayoloji | Ama-Nucleic Acids angu-3.5 | I-RNA
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.5 Nucleic Acids | RNA
chapterContent:
I-Ribonucleic acid, noma i-RNA, ihileleke kakhulu enqubweni yokwenziwa kwamaprotheni ngaphansi kwesiqondiso se-DNA. I-RNA ivame ukuba nentambo eyodwa futhi yenziwe ngama-ribonucleotide axhunywe ngamabhondi e-phosphodiester. I-ribonucleotide eketangeni le-RNA iqukethe i-ribose (ushukela we-pentose), enye yezisekelo ezine ze-nitrogenous (A, U, G, kanye ne-C), kanye neqembu le-phosphate.

 Kunezinhlobo ezine ezinkulu ze-RNA: i-messenger RNA (mRNA), i-ribosomal RNA (rRNA), i-transfer RNA (tRNA), kanye ne-microRNA (miRNA). Eyokuqala, i-mRNA, ithwala umyalezo ovela ku-DNA, olawula yonke imisebenzi yeselula esitokisini. Uma iseli lidinga iphrotheni ethile ukuze lenziwe, i-gene yalo mkhiqizo iyavulwa” bese i-RNA yesithunywa ihlanganiswa ku-nucleus. Uchungechunge lwesisekelo se-RNA luhambisana nochungechunge lokubhala ikhodi lwe-DNA lapho ikopishwe khona. Kodwa-ke, ku-RNA, isisekelo i-T asikho futhi i-U ikhona esikhundleni salokho. Uma umucu we-DNA une-sequence AATTGCGC, uchungechunge lwe-RNA ehambisanayo yi-UUAACCGG. Ku-cytoplasm, i-mRNA isebenzisana nama-ribosomes kanye neminye imishini yeselula (Isithombe 3.36).

 I-mRNA ifundwa ngamaqoqo ezisekelo ezintathu ezaziwa ngokuthi ama-codons. I-codon ngayinye ikhiqiza i-amino acid eyodwa. Ngale ndlela, i-mRNA iyafundwa futhi umkhiqizo wephrotheni wenziwa. I-Ribosomal RNA (rRNA) iyisakhi esiyinhloko sama-ribosomes lapho i-mRNA ibopha khona. I-rRNA iqinisekisa ukuhambisana okufanele kwe-mRNA nama-ribosomes; i-rRNA ye-ribosome nayo inomsebenzi we-enzyme (i-peptidyl transferase) kanye ikhuthaza ukwakheka kwezibopho ze-peptide phakathi kwama-amino acid amabili aqondanisiwe. I-RNA yokudlulisa (i-tRNA) ingenye yezinhlobo ezincane kakhulu ze-RNA ezine, ngokuvamile ama-nucleotide angu-70-90 ubude. Ithwala i-amino acid efanele endaweni yokwenziwa kwamaprotheni. Yindlela yokuhlanganisa isisekelo phakathi kwe-tRNA ne-mRNA evumela ukuthi kufakwe i-amino acid efanele ku-polypeptide chain. Ama-microRNA angama-molecule amancane kakhulu e-RNA futhi indima yawo ihilela ukulawulwa kokubonakaliswa kwezakhi zofuzo ngokuphazamisa ukubonakaliswa kwemiyalezo ethile ye-mRNA. Ithebula elingezansi lifingqa izici ze-DNA ne-RNA.

 Ngisho noma i-RNA i-stranded eyodwa, izinhlobo eziningi ze-RNA zibonisa ukuhlangana okubanzi kwesisekelo sangaphakathi kwama-molecule phakathi kokulandelana okuhambisanayo, okudala isakhiwo esibikezelwayo esinezinhlangothi ezintathu esibalulekile emsebenzini wazo.

 Njengoba usufundile, ukugeleza kolwazi emzimbeni kwenzeka kusuka ku-DNA kuya ku-RNA kuya kuphrotheni. I-DNA ilawula isakhiwo se-mRNA enqubweni eyaziwa ngokuthi i-transcription, kanti i-RNA ilawula isakhiwo sephrotheni enqubweni eyaziwa ngokuthi i-translation. Lokhu kwaziwa ngokuthi i-Central Dogma of Life, eyiqiniso kubo bonke izinto eziphilayo; nokho, kwenzeka okuhlukile kulo mthetho maqondana nokutheleleka ngegciwane

isakhiwo sesibili esitholakala kumaprotheni lapho ama-pleats” akhiwa khona ngokubopha i-hydrogen phakathi kwama-athomu emhlane we-polypeptide chain

chapterName: 1. I-Chemistry Yokuphila | 3. Ama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo | 3.7 Isifinyezo Sesahluko
chapterNameEnglish: 1. The Chemistry of Life | 3. Biological Macromolecules | 3.7 Chapter Summary
chapterContent:
3.1 Ukwenziwa Kwama-Macromolecule Ezinto Eziphilayo
Amaprotheni, ama-carbohydrate, ama-nucleic acid, kanye nama-lipid yizigaba ezine ezinkulu zama-macromolecule ezinto eziphilayo—ama-molecule amakhulu adingekayo empilweni akhiwe ngama-molecule amancane ezinto eziphilayo. Ama-Macromolecule akhiwa amayunithi angawodwa aziwa ngokuthi ama-monomers ahlanganiswe yizibopho ze-covalent ukwakha ama-polymer amakhulu. I-polymer ingaphezu kwesamba sezingxenye zayo: ithola izici ezintsha, futhi iholela ekucindezelweni kwe-osmotic okuphansi kakhulu kunalokho okwakhiwa izithako zayo; lokhu kuyinzuzo ebalulekile ekugcinweni kwezimo ze-osmotic zamaseli. I-monomer ihlangana nenye i-monomer ngokukhululwa kwe-molecule yamanzi, okuholela ekwakhekeni kwesibopho se-covalent. Lezi zinhlobo zokusabela zaziwa ngokuthi ukusabela kokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni noma ukuhlangana. Lapho ama-polymer ehlukaniswa abe amayunithi amancane (ama-monomers), i-molecule yamanzi isetshenziselwa isibopho ngasinye esiphulwa yilezi zimpendulo; ukusabela okunjalo kwaziwa ngokuthi ukusabela kwe-hydrolysis. Ukusabela kokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni kanye ne-hydrolysis kufana kuwo wonke ama-macromolecule, kodwa ukusabela kwe-monomer kanye ne-polymer ngayinye kuqondene nesigaba sayo. Ukusabela kokuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni ngokuvamile kudinga ukutshalwa kwezimali kwamandla ukuze kwakheke isibopho esisha, kuyilapho ukusabela kwe-hydrolysis kuvame ukukhulula amandla ngokuphula izibopho.

 3.2 Ama-carbohydrate
Ama-carbohydrate ayiqembu lama-macromolecule angumthombo wamandla obalulekile weseli futhi ahlinzeka ngokusekelwa kwesakhiwo kumaseli ezitshalo, isikhunta, kanye nawo wonke ama-arthropod afaka ama-lobster, izinkalankala, ama-shrimp, izinambuzane, kanye nezicabucabu. Ama-carbohydrate ahlukaniswa njengama-monosaccharides, ama-disaccharides, nama-polysaccharides kuye ngenani lama-monomers ku-molecule. Ama-monosaccharides axhunyaniswa yizibopho ze-glycosidic ezakhiwe ngenxa yokusabela kokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni, zakha ama-disaccharides nama-polysaccharides ngokuqedwa kwe-molecule yamanzi yesibopho ngasinye esakhiwe. I-glucose, i-galactose, ne-fructose yi-monosaccharides evamile, kanti ama-disaccharides avamile afaka i-lactose, i-maltose, ne-sucrose. Isitashi ne-glycogen, izibonelo zama-polysaccharides, yizinhlobo zokugcina i-glucose ezitshalweni nasezilwaneni, ngokulandelana. Amaketanga amade e-polysaccharide angahlukaniswa noma angahlukaniswanga. I-Cellulose iyisibonelo se-polysaccharide engakagaywa, kanti i-amylopectin, eyingxenye yesitashi, iyi-molecule enamagatsha amaningi. Ukugcinwa kwe-glucose, ngesimo sama-polymers afana nesitashi se-glycogen, kwenza kube lula ukuyithola ku-metabolism; noma kunjalo, lokhu kuyivimbela ekuphumeni kweseli noma ukudala ingcindezi ephezulu ye-osmotic engabangela ukumuncwa kwamanzi ngokweqile yiseli.

 3.3 Ama-Lipids
Ama-Lipids ayisigaba sama-macromolecules angewona ama-polar futhi angathandi amanzi. Izinhlobo ezinkulu zifaka amafutha namafutha, ama-waxes, ama-phospholipids, nama-steroids. Amafutha ayifomu lamandla agciniwe futhi aziwa nangokuthi ama-triacylglycerols noma ama-triglycerides. Amafutha akhiwe ngama-fatty acids kanye ne-glycerol noma i-sphingosine. Ama-fatty acids angase angagcwali noma agcwali, kuye ngokuba khona noma ukungabikho kwama-double bonds ku-hydrocarbon chain. Uma kukhona ama-single bonds kuphela, aziwa ngokuthi ama-saturated fatty acids. Ama-fatty acid angagcwalisiwe angaba nesibopho esisodwa noma ngaphezulu esixukwini se-hydrocarbon. Ama-Phospholipid akha i-matrix yama-membrane. Ane-glycerol noma i-sphingosine backbone lapho kunamathele khona amaketanga amabili e-fatty acid kanye neqembu eliqukethe i-phosphate. Ama-steroid ayisigaba selinye lama-lipid. Isakhiwo sawo esiyisisekelo sinezindandatho ezine ze-carbon ezihlanganisiwe. I-cholesterol iwuhlobo lwe-steroid futhi iyisakhi esibalulekile se-plasma membrane, lapho isiza khona ukugcina uhlobo loketshezi lwe-membrane. Futhi iyisandulela sama-hormone e-steroid njenge-testosterone.

 3.4 Amaprotheni
Amaprotheni ayisigaba sama-macromolecule enza imisebenzi eyahlukahlukene yeseli. Asiza ekusetshenzisweni kwe-metabolism ngokunikeza ukwesekwa kwesakhiwo nangokusebenza njengama-enzyme, abathwali, noma ama-hormone. Amabhulokhi okwakha amaprotheni (ama-monomers) angama-amino acid. I-amino acid ngayinye ine-carbon ephakathi exhunywe neqembu lama-amino, iqembu le-carboxyl, i-athomu ye-hydrogen, kanye neqembu le-R noma i-side chain. Kunezinhlobo ezingama-20 zama-amino acid ezivame ukuvela, ngayinye ehlukile eqenjini le-R. I-amino acid ngayinye ixhunyaniswe nomakhelwane bayo ngesibopho se-peptide. Uchungechunge olude lwama-amino acid lwaziwa ngokuthi i-polypeptide.

 Amaprotheni ahlelwe emazingeni amane: i-quaternary eyinhloko, eyesibili, eyesithathu, kanye (ongakukhetha). Isakhiwo esiyinhloko ukulandelana okuhlukile kwama-amino acid. Ukugoqwa kwendawo kwe-polypeptide ukwakha izakhiwo ezifana ne-α helix kanye neshidi elinoqweqwe lwe-β kwakha isakhiwo sesibili. Isakhiwo esiphelele esinezinhlangothi ezintathu yisakhiwo sesithathu. Lapho ama-polypeptide amabili noma ngaphezulu ehlangana ukwakha isakhiwo esiphelele seprotheyini, ukucushwa kwaziwa njengesakhiwo se-quaternary seprotheyini. Ukuma nomsebenzi weprotheyini kuxhunyaniswe ngendlela eyinkimbinkimbi; noma yiluphi ushintsho esimweni olubangelwa izinguquko ekushiseni noma i-pH lungaholela ekuwohlokeni kweprotheyini kanye nokulahlekelwa umsebenzi.

 3.5 Ama-Nucleic Acids
Ama-Nucleic acid angama-molecule enziwe ngama-nucleotide aqondisa imisebenzi yamaseli njengokuhlukaniswa kwamaseli kanye nokwakheka kwamaprotheni. I-nucleotide ngayinye yakhiwe ushukela we-pentose, isisekelo se-nitrogen, kanye neqembu le-phosphate. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili zama-nucleic acid: i-DNA ne-RNA. I-DNA iphethe uhlelo lwezakhi zofuzo lweseli futhi idluliselwa kusuka kubazali kuya enzalweni (ngendlela yama-chromosome). Inesakhiwo esiphindwe kabili esinezintambo ezimbili ezigijima ngezindlela eziphambene, ezixhunywe yizibopho ze-hydrogen, futhi ezihambisanayo. I-RNA inezintambo eyodwa futhi yenziwe ushukela we-pentose (ribose), isisekelo se-nitrogen, kanye neqembu le-phosphate. I-RNA ihilelekile ekwakhiweni kwamaprotheni kanye nokulawulwa kwawo. I-Messenger RNA (mRNA) ikopishwa kusuka ku-DNA, ithunyelwa kusuka ku-nucleus iye ku-cytoplasm, futhi iqukethe ulwazi lokwakhiwa kwamaprotheni. I-Ribosomal RNA (rRNA) iyingxenye yama-ribosomes endaweni yokwenziwa kwamaprotheni, kanti i-transfer RNA (tRNA) ithwala i-amino acid endaweni yokwenziwa kwamaprotheni. I-MicroRNA ilawula ukusetshenziswa kwe-mRNA kokwenziwa kwamaprotheni

distractor89c: I-Arginine inganamathela ngqo ku-lysine futhi igobe uchungechunge lweprotheni
question90: Yini engenzeka uma ngisho ne-amino acid eyodwa ithathelwa indawo enye ku-polypeptide?
answer90: Ukushintsha kungase kube nomthelela omncane noma kungashintsha kakhulu isakhiwo kanye nomsebenzi weprotheyini, njengoba kubonakala esifweni se-sickle cell
distractor90a: Ushintsho ngeke lube nomthelela esakhiweni noma emsebenzini weprotheyini.
distractor90b: Izinguquko ezinjalo zihlala zandisa ukugoba kanye nezihibe, njengasesifo sokuzalwa sikaLeber
distractor90c: Ukushintsha okunjalo kuhlala kwenza amaprotheni angasebenzi nhlobo
question91: I-HIV iyigciwane le-RNA elisakazeka ngokushesha ngenxa yayiphi indlela?
question92: Abacwaningi babonise kanjani ukuthi i-DNA, hhayi iphrotheni, iphethe ulwazi oludluliselwa ngofuzo?
answer92: Babhale i-DNA neprotheni yegciwane ngama-isotopes ahlukene futhi babonisa ukuthi yi-DNA kuphela engena esitokisini somsingathi.
distractor92b: Babhale iprotheni yegciwane futhi babonisa ukuthi ingena esitokisini somsingathi.
distractor92c: Bahlela i-DNA yegciwane ngemuva kokutheleleka futhi baphetha ngokuthi kumele kube yizinto ezizuzwa njengefa.
question93: Uchungechunge lwe-DNA luyashintsha kusuka ku-ATC/GTT/GAA/CTG/TAG/GAT/AAA luye ku-ATC/GTT/GTA/CTG/TAG/GAT/AAA. Hlobo luni loguquko oluye lwenzeka?
answer93: Ukufaka esikhundleni sika-T esikhundleni sika-A, ukushintsha ikhodi yekhodi yesithathu
distractor93a: Ukufakwa kwe-C okushintsha yonke ikhodi ngemva kokuguqulwa
distractor93b: Ukususwa kwe-A okunciphisa umucu we-DNA futhi kushintsha yonke i-codon elandelayo
distractor93c: Akukho shintsho olwenzekile ngoba isisekelo esifanayo sazithathela indawo
question94: Kungani ukuguqulwa kwe-DNA kuvame ukuba nemiphumela ehlala isikhathi eside kunokuguqulwa kwe-RNA?
answer94: I-DNA iyaphindaphindwa futhi idluliselwe kumaseli endodakazi, okwenza ushintsho lube yinto ehlala njalo
distractor94a: Ukuguqulwa kwe-RNA kuhlala kuyingozi ngoba kubangela ukujikeleza kwempendulo yezinto eziphilayo
distractor94b: Ukuguqulwa kwe-DNA ngokuvamile akunangozi ngoba ukulungiswa kwe-DNA kuhlala kukulungisa
distractor94c: Noma yikuphi ukuguquka kwe-DNA ngokushesha kubangela ukuthi iseli lidlule ku-apoptosis
